faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: What is the minimum cutoff of ICT Mumbai for BTech in 2024?
faqs.answer: ICT Mumbai offers admission to BTech specialisations on the basis of JEE Main ranks. The cutoff for the above BTech specialisations varied between 25192 and 46061, for the General AI category candidates. faqs.question: Can I take admission in ICT Mumbai MBA without MAH MBA CET?
faqs.answer: No, ICT Mumbai MBA admissions are purely entry-based. Thus, students seeking admission to this programme must have a valid MAH MBA CET score. Based on these scores, students are ranked and allocated a seat.

college_info.intro:
ICT Mumbai offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes across multiple streams such as Engineering, Technology, Pharmaceutical Science, Allied Sciences, and Mathematics. BTech and MPharma are the flagship programmes at ICT Mumbai. These programmes are provided in full-time mode in several specialisations. Some of the popular BTech specialisations are Chemical Engineering, Dystuff Technology, Fibres and Textile Processing Technology and Food Engineering and Technology. ICT Mumbai MPharma programme is accredited by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI). Candidates seeking admission to these courses at the Institute of Chemical Technology, Mumbai, must meet the eligibility criteria. reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: ICT: The best college for chemical engineering.

review_content.Placements: ICT Mumbai has a record of offering 100% placement to students in the bachelor of chemical engineering courses. The highest package offered this year (2024) was 20 LPA by Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL). The average package is in the range of 13-14 LPA for the B. Chem. engineering course. Top recruiting companies are BPCL, HPCL, Reliance Industries, Sun Pharma, Pidilite Industries, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities are excellent as far as academics are concerned. There are well-equipped labs for research. College Wi-Fi is made available after registration. Hostel facilities are available if the student lives more than 70km away from campus. The mess is available along with the Hostel.

reviews_list.batch_info: Integrated M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering (Food Engineering and Technology) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Institute of Chemical Technology, Marathwada Campus.

review_content.Placements: Almost 50% of the students have been placed in various companies. To date, the highest salary package offered is 21 lakhs, while the lowest is 6 lakhs. The top recruiting companies include Whole Truth Foods, Keva Flavor and Foods, Henkel, and BARC. Nearly every batch has secured placements with these companies. For internships, around 3 to 4 students are typically selected for top roles, including production manager, research and development positions, and chemical engineers.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has 24/7 Wi-Fi, well-established labs, and classrooms have a mike, project speakers, and a blackboard with each AC. The mess and canteen have good food the mess is cooperative. The hostel also has Wi-Fi 24/7, and a cleaning lady is there washing machine good hostel. We also have sports events teach events, and cultural events.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Oils, Oleochemicals and Surfactants Technology - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Not just any other college, institute of culture, or institute of tradition.

review_content.Placements: I believe over the years, placements have increased. The majority of students prefer to go outside India to pursue a master's Ph.D. Big companies like Godrej, Nerolac Paints, Asian Paints, and PPG come for campus placements. Over the years, the institute has been working towards achieving better placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped and have all the amenities. The most important is the lab. There is no lab facility like what ICT have. The hostel has all amenities including washing machines. The cleaning staff is also good and very supportive. It is one of the most comfortable stays.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Fibres and Textile Processing Technology - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: A Very Underrated Government College.

review_content.Placements: Placements are average, not up to expectations. The highest package for Textile 2024 was 16 LPA, and 2-3 people got it. Top recruiters are Trident, Arvind, and more. Almost all 3rd and 4th year students get internships. This is the textile processing branch; they teach textile chemistry here.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are good for the textile department. Labs for the textile department are good, not very good. Hostel facilities are good, mess food is okay, also cheap. Fees are only 36,000 for the year. There's a snooker table at the hostel and a turf to play cricket, and also basketball and volleyball courts.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Fibres and Textile Processing Technology - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Review on Institute of Chemical Technology.

review_content.Placements: 50% students get placed, and the rest go for higher studies. The highest is 16 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Recruiting companies are Trident, Bitra, Archroma, Aditya Birla, Reliance, BSaf, Siyaram, Vardhman, etc. Roles offered can range from marketing to shop floor work.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms have air-conditioning and projectors. The library is well-equipped with books and journals. The food quality at the hostel is bad. Sports and games facilities are available. Hostel rooms are affordable, although they are quite small in size. The canteen food menu is limited, and the food is oily.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Good for aspirants who are willing to do research or opt for higher studies.

review_content.Placements: The eligibility for placement is that you have to clear all subjects, and in the 7th semester, companies hire students based on performance in mock group discussions and interviews. The average placement offer is between 3-5 LPA. Companies like Glatt and Sun Pharma hire B Pharma students based on their requirements.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, and Wi-Fi is accessible once you get admission to ICT. The labs are top-notch; you will get different sections of labs in the pharma department, such as general labs, pharmacology labs, and pharmacetics labs. In the ICT campus, there are four hostels. UG students are admitted in hostel number 5, which is the best hostel among others based on facilities.

review_summary.college_name: ICT Mumbai Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: ICT: The best college for chemical engineering.

content.Placements: ICT Mumbai has a record of offering 100% placement to students in the bachelor of chemical engineering courses. The highest package offered this year (2024) was 20 LPA by Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL). The average package is in the range of 13-14 LPA for the B. Chem. engineering course. Top recruiting companies are BPCL, HPCL, Reliance Industries, Sun Pharma, Pidilite Industries, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are excellent as far as academics are concerned. There are well-equipped labs for research. College Wi-Fi is made available after registration. Hostel facilities are available if the student lives more than 70km away from campus. The mess is available along with the Hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering (Food Engineering and Technology) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Review of Institute of Chemical Technology, Marathwada Campus.

content.Placements: Almost 50% of the students have been placed in various companies. To date, the highest salary package offered is 21 lakhs, while the lowest is 6 lakhs. The top recruiting companies include Whole Truth Foods, Keva Flavor and Foods, Henkel, and BARC. Nearly every batch has secured placements with these companies. For internships, around 3 to 4 students are typically selected for top roles, including production manager, research and development positions, and chemical engineers.
content.Infrastructure: The college has 24/7 Wi-Fi, well-established labs, and classrooms have a mike, project speakers, and a blackboard with each AC. The mess and canteen have good food the mess is cooperative. The hostel also has Wi-Fi 24/7, and a cleaning lady is there washing machine good hostel. We also have sports events teach events, and cultural events.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Oils, Oleochemicals and Surfactants Technology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Not just any other college, institute of culture, or institute of tradition.

content.Placements: I believe over the years, placements have increased. The majority of students prefer to go outside India to pursue a master's Ph.D. Big companies like Godrej, Nerolac Paints, Asian Paints, and PPG come for campus placements. Over the years, the institute has been working towards achieving better placements.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped and have all the amenities. The most important is the lab. There is no lab facility like what ICT have. The hostel has all amenities including washing machines. The cleaning staff is also good and very supportive. It is one of the most comfortable stays.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Fibres and Textile Processing Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A Very Underrated Government College.

content.Placements: Placements are average, not up to expectations. The highest package for Textile 2024 was 16 LPA, and 2-3 people got it. Top recruiters are Trident, Arvind, and more. Almost all 3rd and 4th year students get internships. This is the textile processing branch; they teach textile chemistry here.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are good for the textile department. Labs for the textile department are good, not very good. Hostel facilities are good, mess food is okay, also cheap. Fees are only 36,000 for the year. There's a snooker table at the hostel and a turf to play cricket, and also basketball and volleyball courts.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Fibres and Textile Processing Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review on Institute of Chemical Technology.

content.Placements: 50% students get placed, and the rest go for higher studies. The highest is 16 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Recruiting companies are Trident, Bitra, Archroma, Aditya Birla, Reliance, BSaf, Siyaram, Vardhman, etc. Roles offered can range from marketing to shop floor work.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms have air-conditioning and projectors. The library is well-equipped with books and journals. The food quality at the hostel is bad. Sports and games facilities are available. Hostel rooms are affordable, although they are quite small in size. The canteen food menu is limited, and the food is oily.

The admission process for ICT Mumbai is a multi-step process inclusive of application, appearance in the selection rounds and counselling process. A step-by-stepICT Mumbai admission processis as follows:
Step 1: ICT Mumbai Application Process

The admission process begins with filling out an online application form on the official website of the Institute of Chemical Technology (after clearing the entrance exam for respective courses). Candidates can apply for the course of their choice along with paying an application fee.
Step 2: ICT Mumbai Other Selection Rounds

Admission to ICT Mumbai courses is entrance-based. For entrance-based admission, candidates are required to qualify for entrance exams for the respective courses. Further, there are other selection rounds such as GDPI conducted as part of the selection process. For the MSc course, the ICT also conduct admission tests.
Step 3: ICT Mumbai Counselling Process/ Merit Release
Based on the scores in the respective entrance exams, past academic records and performance of candidates in other selection rounds, the university releases a merit list.
Step 4: Provisional Admission Notice

After the release of the merit list, a provisional admission notice will be sent to the selected candidates. Later on, candidates can proceed with the other admission formalities such as fee payment and document verification (if required). For more details about the final admission process, candidates may visit the official website of ICT Mumbai.

library.description: Institute of Chemical Technology's library has a collection of 77102 books, bound volumes and reports, 4848 theses, 125 journals (printed) and 5 databases. It performs a dual role of an academic library as well as a research library. It is housed in a separate ground plus two-storied building and follows a completely open-access concept. The library is fully computerized using the library management software called Libsys. It can be termed as a hybrid library with the best collection of printed and digital documents. The library is also a member of E-ShodhSindhu Consortium. The library has a facility of circulation service, reference and referral service, current awareness service, bibliographic service, photocopying service, user orientation programs, e-resources training programs and book bank service.

reviews.review_heading: ICT: The best college for chemical engineering.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are excellent as far as academics are concerned. There are well-equipped labs for research. College Wi-Fi is made available after registration. Hostel facilities are available if the student lives more than 70km away from campus. The mess is available along with the Hostel.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Institute of Chemical Technology, Marathwada CampusReviewed on 16 Feb 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Review of Institute of Chemical Technology, Marathwada Campus.
reviews.review_text: The college has 24/7 Wi-Fi, well-established labs, and classrooms have a mike, project speakers, and a blackboard with each AC. The mess and canteen have good food the mess is cooperative. The hostel also has Wi-Fi 24/7, and a cleaning lady is there washing machine good hostel. We also have sports events teach events, and cultural events.

reviews.review_heading: Not just any other college, institute of culture, or institute of tradition.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-equipped and have all the amenities. The most important is the lab. There is no lab facility like what ICT have. The hostel has all amenities including washing machines. The cleaning staff is also good and very supportive. It is one of the most comfortable stays.

reviews.review_heading: A Very Underrated Government College.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are good for the textile department. Labs for the textile department are good, not very good. Hostel facilities are good, mess food is okay, also cheap. Fees are only 36,000 for the year. There's a snooker table at the hostel and a turf to play cricket, and also basketball and volleyball courts.

reviews.review_heading: Review on Institute of Chemical Technology.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have air-conditioning and projectors. The library is well-equipped with books and journals. The food quality at the hostel is bad. Sports and games facilities are available. Hostel rooms are affordable, although they are quite small in size. The canteen food menu is limited, and the food is oily.

reviews.review_heading: Good for aspirants who are willing to do research or opt for higher studies.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, and Wi-Fi is accessible once you get admission to ICT. The labs are top-notch; you will get different sections of labs in the pharma department, such as general labs, pharmacology labs, and pharmacetics labs. In the ICT campus, there are four hostels. UG students are admitted in hostel number 5, which is the best hostel among others based on facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Institute of Chemical Technology, Marathwada CampusReviewed on 25 Sep 2024)
reviews.review_heading: The college for fortunate students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very poor because the actual campus of ICT Jalna college is under construction, so, at the moment, the college infrastructure is not that good and is rental. Although it's good if you're more focused on education instead of infrastructure. Regarding labs and classrooms, they are very good; all labs are equipped, and all the instruments are new and good. Classrooms are also good, with ACs and digital classroom logistics.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for chemical engineering fields.
reviews.review_text: Quality of the food in the mess is quite good as compared to other college's mess, and the canteen is even better and also not too expensive. For sports, basketball, volleyball, Badminton court is there and also turf is there for football. As such medical facilities are not there.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for Masters in pharma.
reviews.review_text: The college  infrastructure and campus is really cool. We have many labs in the college along with a new incubation centre which was developed this year. 24 hours Wi-Fi service is available in the college. They also provide a digital library which can be accessed from any location. College hostel has limited seats providing triple sharing rooms having separate beds, tables, fans, and water filter facilities. Mess food was decent in quality but the canteen’s food is really good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by IndianOil Odisha Campus, Bhubaneswar, Institute of Chemical Technology, MumbaiReviewed on 16 Apr 2024)
reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are of top level with 24 hrs electricity and Wi-Fi availability. The classrooms, library, and the labs are fully air conditioned Hostels provides room with 4 students sharing each room having attach washrooms. Washing machines are provided for washing clothes. Food quality is also good in the mess. Our college is tied up with KIIMS for medical facilities. There are issues with outdoor games like cricket and basketball as we are currently in a temporary campus and do not have access to...

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and great college.
reviews.review_text: Life on campus is lively, with a good social life and many clubs to join. The infrastructure was really good, with a well-stocked library and big classrooms. We have an annual fest called Vortex. Many enjoyable moments and events are held here. The hostel needs to be good; the accommodation is average and the food is also not good. Management needs to take care of these things.

reviews.review_heading: About My Masters from ICT Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: The campus and classes were clean and green, but the campus area was small. For many events, management is done by seniors; every month we have at least one event. Wi-Fi facilities are provided, and a library is present in the college. We can bring any book from there. The hostel is big, but getting admission is challenging, given the merit list. As a South Indian here, food is different, but I have no other option.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Institute of Chemical Technology Mumbai (ICT).
reviews.review_text: The campus houses numerous clubs and societies. Several events are conducted throughout the year that benefit students in terms of sports. The ICT campus has badminton, cricket, and football courts. The hostel rooms are very clean and properly equipped with two, three, or four beds. Mess food is good in quality.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for research in Chemical Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent when it comes to classrooms, but other facilities like labs, libraries, and research centers are excellent. It has a huge library where students can also access the books online through their portals. If you are genuinely interested in research in the chemical domain, this is heaven for you. Also recently, the M Mokashi incubation center was inaugurated, where you can work on your startup ideas. The sports and games facility, mess and canteen are good.

reviews.review_heading: I have done my masters in chemistry. I am fully satisfied with my college, which includes facilities
reviews.review_text: 24 hour Wi-Fi facility is available, and there are 4 hostels, and every hostel has an individual study room and a 2nd floor library full of all required books and journals. The hostel facility is so far so good. We all know Mumbai is so costly, so accommodation is the big issue, so yes, it is a bit congested.

The BTech, BArch and MTech programmes offered at MNIT Jaipur, are very popular among students. The institute provides a four-year BTech programme and a two-year MTech programme in numerous branches. MNIT Jaipur aims at the holistic development of students and helps them to develop technical competencies as well as various soft skills required to target core-industry roles.
The industry-institute relations established by MNIT Jaipur provide students with the opportunity to undergo many training programs organised by industry partners. MNIT Jaipur also offers placement assistance to students and helps them get placed in good companies. review_summary.college_name: MNIT Jaipur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: MNIT is the best college.

content.Placements: Almost 80 percent of students got placed on this campus. The highest package offered is 64 LPA. The lowest package offered is 10 LPA. The average package offered is 15 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Qualcomm, Flipkart, Amazon, etc. Almost 50 percent of students got internships in their 3rd year.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is so good. 24-hour Wi-Fi is provided. Labs and classrooms are big enough. The library is so big and so many books are available related to general knowledge and others. The quality is acceptable. The food in the mess is good, but South people cannot accept the food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It is a very good college. Excellent infrastructure and facilities provided here.

content.Placements: 60 percent of the students got placed in Civil Engineering. The highest was 20 LPA, the lowest I don't know, and the average is 8 LPA. JPMC: ten percent got into JPMC, and 5 percent got into project planning and design. Management programs were offered as well.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available, but only LAN Wi-Fi is available in the hostel of the first-year students (i.e., Arawali Hostel), and wireless Wi-Fi is available for other students. The library is also very good recently built with top-notch infrastructure and good seating capacity, but it doesn't open at night. Mess food is average and okayish, but there is also a night canteen in Hostel 7 that has recently opened. Sports facilities are very good and provide all sports facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: MNIT Jaipur – College of national importance.

content.Placements: Almost 85–90 percent of students from this Mechanical Engineering batch got placed, the highest package offered is 24 LPA, the median and average package is around 10 LPA, the minimum package is 5–6 LPA, students who get on-campus internships are very few, almost 18–20 percent, and the top recruiters are BPCL, HPCL, JPMC, BNY, and Amazon.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities available are quite good in terms of Wi-Fi, electricity, classrooms, and libraries, but for hostels the mess is the worst part as the food is of very low standard and we have to manage by taking food from the canteen sometimes, although some government hostels are good in terms of food quality.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Highly impressed by the faculty members.

content.Placements: Around 96 students are placed out of 108 students enrolled last time. The highest package offered is by JPMC, which offered a package of 27 LPA, while the average stood at 13 LPA with the lowest at 4.6 LPA. Top recruiters include JPMC, L&T, Honda, Tata, etc., and other PSUs like BPCL, HPCL, BEL, etc.
content.Infrastructure: We had a nice infrastructure as this institute is an institute of national interest. The most famous building includes Vivekananda Lecture Theatre Complex (VLTC), which is also Asia's biggest lecture theatre. All labs are advanced in my department with certain labs for conventional manufacturing too. You will find a 24*7 Wi-Fi facility in the whole campus. Hostel forms another joy of life. We had a lot of fun in the hostel. Food in hostel is around average, but friendship is a must to order food from outside.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: MNIT Jaipur is the best NIT in North India.

content.Placements: Almost 80% of students get placed in our college. The highest package is 1 crore, the lowest package is 12 LPA, and the average package is 20 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Amazon, Flipkart, Qualcomm, and others. Almost 40% of students get internships.
content.Infrastructure: Our hostels are old but look okay. The infrastructure is very good. There are many classrooms and one big library that contains a lot of books related to subjects and others. There are almost 17 hostels for both boys and girls.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT is the best college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is so good. 24-hour Wi-Fi is provided. Labs and classrooms are big enough. The library is so big and so many books are available related to general knowledge and others. The quality is acceptable. The food in the mess is good, but South people cannot accept the food.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college. Excellent infrastructure and facilities provided here.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available, but only LAN Wi-Fi is available in the hostel of the first-year students (i.e., Arawali Hostel), and wireless Wi-Fi is available for other students. The library is also very good recently built with top-notch infrastructure and good seating capacity, but it doesn't open at night. Mess food is average and okayish, but there is also a night canteen in Hostel 7 that has recently opened. Sports facilities are very good and provide all sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT Jaipur – College of national importance.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available are quite good in terms of Wi-Fi, electricity, classrooms, and libraries, but for hostels the mess is the worst part as the food is of very low standard and we have to manage by taking food from the canteen sometimes, although some government hostels are good in terms of food quality.

reviews.review_heading: Highly impressed by the faculty members.
reviews.review_text: We had a nice infrastructure as this institute is an institute of national interest. The most famous building includes Vivekananda Lecture Theatre Complex (VLTC), which is also Asia's biggest lecture theatre. All labs are advanced in my department with certain labs for conventional manufacturing too. You will find a 24*7 Wi-Fi facility in the whole campus. Hostel forms another joy of life. We had a lot of fun in the hostel. Food in hostel is around average, but friendship is a must to order food...

reviews.review_heading: MNIT Jaipur is the best NIT in North India.
reviews.review_text: Our hostels are old but look okay. The infrastructure is very good. There are many classrooms and one big library that contains a lot of books related to subjects and others. There are almost 17 hostels for both boys and girls.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT Jaipur- The best NIT.
reviews.review_text: The classes are very big with a capacity of more than 120 students. College infrastructure is from 19th century so it might look as old but the buildings are stronger than the present ones. Hostel mess and canteens are available including a night canteen.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT is the best NIT in India.
reviews.review_text: Here the classrooms are very big with a capacity of 120 students. Labs are also big. The library is very big with many books related to the course and general knowledge. Facilities in the hostel are good. Hostel mess and canteen are available. 24/7 medical facilities are also available. The grounds are very big for every sport.

reviews.review_heading: Campus with the best college life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, a lush green campus with separate departments and a big hall for lectures, and it has Asia's biggest lecture hall. When it comes about hostels, they are good enough, but the food in the hostels is not at all good, the worst food.

reviews.review_heading: Great college if you want both great placements and a good college life.
reviews.review_text: We get free Wi-Fi everywhere, infrastructure is great, our lecture complex is very huge, in fact, the biggest in Asian, hostel facilities are great as well, with high speed internet and single rooms from the second year onwards. There are ample sports facilities as well.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT, Jaipur - The top NIT in northern part of India.
reviews.review_text: Here, there are so many facilities like library, labs, and classrooms. Hostel, canteens, and night canteen are also available. The quality of the food is okay, and the taste of the food does not satisfy Southern people. There are so many clubs related to sports, dance, and finance.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT Jaipur is one of the Best NITs in India.
reviews.review_text: As the college was built in the 2000s, the infrastructure is from ancient times, but the buildings are stronger than the new ones. The food in the hostel and canteens is okay, but it doesn't satisfy the taste of Southern people. They have to adjust. There are so many clubs for dance, finance, sports, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with college and faculty, good placements. Infrastructure and maintenance are good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and college facilities are good. You would be given Ethernet in the hostel and common Wi-Fi in college. It's totally a veg campus. The food in some of the hostels is not good. The infrastructure in the hostels is good. New hostels are in process. Got a large cricket and football ground.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT is one of the best colleges.
reviews.review_text: The labs are big enough. The classrooms are very large, and the library is also very big. The food quality in both the mess and canteen is excellent, but it can't satisfy the taste of the South side. Every week, a doctor is available. There are so many clubs related to sports, skills, dance, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in Rajasthan.
reviews.review_text: MNIT Jaipur has the largest lecture theatre complex in Asian known as VLTC, which provides digital classroom facilities with air-conditioning and projectors. There are many hostels for students. Quality of food is also very good, and mostly sports are available at the college.

reviews.review_heading: Value of money and many things to explore .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good with all the basic need available in college. The only problem in hot summer, the hostel is good but mess ***, sport facility are awesome and medical facilities are also decent the hostel is good but bathroom need to improved .

faqs.answer: A:    Apart from NMAT scores, UPES Dehradun offers admission to the MBA course based on XAT scores. As per the XAT 2023 cutoff, candidates having a minimum of 50 Percentile for the General category All India Quota were eligible for UPES Dehradun admissions.UPES Dehradun offers MBA in International Business (International Business Law and Negotiation), Operations Management, Aviation Management (Aviation Enterprise Management), Power Management (Power Business and Regulations), Oil and Gas Management (Petroleum Marketing and Business Development), Business Analytics (Energy Analytics), Logistics and Supply Chain Management (Business Process in Supply Chain) and Marketing Management.
faqs.question: Can I get UPES Dehradun with XAT Percentile of 60?

faqs.answer: A:    Yes, UPES Dehradun does accept CAT scores for MBA admissions. Students with a valid CAT score of 50 percentile or above are eligible to apply for the course. Eligible students have to appear for the Group Discussion and Personal Interview rounds for final selection.
faqs.question: Does UPES accept CAT scores?

faqs.answer: A:    UPES MBA fee is between INR 1.5 lakh and INR 15.7 lakh as per an unofficial source. The fee is calculated based on tuition fee and does not includes other components. Students are required to pay course fee after completion of all selection rounds to confirm their seats. The selection to MBA course will be based on national and university level entrance exams like CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, UPESMET, etc., followed by group discussion and personal interview round. In case a candidate is unable to pay fee within the specified time, his or her admission will stand cancelled. Aspirants will also need to pay a registration fee to apply for admission. The application fee for MBA course is INR 1,350. They can pay the registration fee via any of online payment mode.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Applied Petroleum Engineering (Intelligent Petroleum Systems) - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely I am satisfied because of good culture, faculty, and good placement in 2025.

review_content.Placements: About 95 percent of students are placed in the year 2025, the highest package is about 35 LPA, the average is about 11 LPA, and the top recruiters for our branch are Cairn Oil & Gas, Vedanta Ltd, ONGC, Adani Gas, HP, Oil India Limited, GAIL, and many more.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good, we have a common library, the campus is divided into blocks in which classes are conducted, sports facilities are also good, the college hostel has a limited number of seats so I would prefer an off-campus hostel, but the food in the campus is good.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBA in Finance Management - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Knowledgeable faculty and support.

review_content.Placements: 99% are placed. 6 LPA is the lowest package, and 33 LPA is the highest, but placement records are good, and everyone is getting placements somewhere else, and students are also supportive. Zepto, blinkit, EY, KPMG ITC, Indigo, Aadani Airpot, ONGC and all are recruiting. 100% got internships. Manager and Consulting roles are offered. placements are also good.
review_content.Infrastructure: Everything has Wi-Fi, a good connection, good college life and a view. Hostel life is amazing and has to be seen, and the night view and jamming sessions are the point of attraction.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security and Digital Forensics) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: The college can improve on the placement records.

review_content.Placements: A smaller number of student placement records have been shown this year, and I heard about the fact that Microsoft banned this college from entering for placements due to an internal issue. The placements average at 7 to 10LPA, that too if you are qualified with a good amount of knowledge in the field.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities are fair, sports facilities can be improved, and there are frequent Wi-Fi problems. I went inside the on campus hostel and noticed the rooms are smaller but ventilated well with a good mess. There needs to be more events based on communities outside the college.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Cloud Computing and Virtualization Technology) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Career prospects are strong, though classrooms can feel average.

review_content.Placements: UPES has excellent placement opportunities, especially in CSE. Around 90-95% students are placed with the highest package going above 50 LPA, and the average is 8 LPA. Opportunities are there, but for top performers. Core roles are limited, and many companies offer mass recruitment profiles.
review_content.Infrastructure: UPES has one of the best infrastructures among private universities in India, but classrooms should have AC. Hostel and cafeteria are decent, the view from hostel is epic. Wi-Fi-enabled labs are advanced, well-stocked libraries. Sometimes you feel crowded in hostel.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Graphics and Gaming) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure, overcrowded for B.Tech students, and placement is average.

review_content.Placements: I am in second year so no one is placed in my batch. But the senior gets package which is well and good. The highest package is around 60 LPA in my course, and average is 12 LPA. Some top recruiting companies are TCS, Microsoft, Amazon, and others. Internship is mandatory in our course so everyone gets an internship.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has all the facilities like Wi-Fi, computers, and labs. I live off campus so I don't have an idea of the hostel on campus. In sports, we have basketball, football, volleyball, badminton, cricket, and many others. We also have tournaments and all to encourage students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Applied Petroleum Engineering (Energy Systems and Storage) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: So basically, if you are willing to have good placements and be successful.

review_content.Placements: So basically, in my course, the strength of the students is not that much, which means the competition criteria is not very high, resulting in good placements. I'm currently in batch 1, and the total batches in my passing stream are 3. The eligibility criteria to sit for placements is 8+ CGPA, which every student should have for their own benefit. The highest package in my college is recorded as 50 LPA, which is recently offered in 2024, whereas the average top package is 17 LPA, which I think is good for a beginner.
review_content.Infrastructure: So TBH, I am not living in the campus hostel as the campus hostel serves non-veg food, and I have been a vegan from birth. So I avoid living inside the college campus. But I have seen some facilities and also heard more from my friends, like good infrastructure with good-speed Wi-Fi, properly furnished rooms with no smelly gallery, separate balconies, and many more. Medical facilities and other curricular activities are also available on campus in different places with different rules.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Applied Petroleum Engineering (Intelligent Petroleum Systems) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely I am satisfied because of good culture, faculty, and good placement in 2025.

content.Placements: About 95 percent of students are placed in the year 2025, the highest package is about 35 LPA, the average is about 11 LPA, and the top recruiters for our branch are Cairn Oil & Gas, Vedanta Ltd, ONGC, Adani Gas, HP, Oil India Limited, GAIL, and many more.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good, we have a common library, the campus is divided into blocks in which classes are conducted, sports facilities are also good, the college hostel has a limited number of seats so I would prefer an off-campus hostel, but the food in the campus is good.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Finance Management - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Knowledgeable faculty and support.

content.Placements: 99% are placed. 6 LPA is the lowest package, and 33 LPA is the highest, but placement records are good, and everyone is getting placements somewhere else, and students are also supportive. Zepto, blinkit, EY, KPMG ITC, Indigo, Aadani Airpot, ONGC and all are recruiting. 100% got internships. Manager and Consulting roles are offered. placements are also good.
content.Infrastructure: Everything has Wi-Fi, a good connection, good college life and a view. Hostel life is amazing and has to be seen, and the night view and jamming sessions are the point of attraction.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security and Digital Forensics) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college can improve on the placement records.

content.Placements: A smaller number of student placement records have been shown this year, and I heard about the fact that Microsoft banned this college from entering for placements due to an internal issue. The placements average at 7 to 10LPA, that too if you are qualified with a good amount of knowledge in the field.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are fair, sports facilities can be improved, and there are frequent Wi-Fi problems. I went inside the on campus hostel and noticed the rooms are smaller but ventilated well with a good mess. There needs to be more events based on communities outside the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Cloud Computing and Virtualization Technology) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Career prospects are strong, though classrooms can feel average.

content.Placements: UPES has excellent placement opportunities, especially in CSE. Around 90-95% students are placed with the highest package going above 50 LPA, and the average is 8 LPA. Opportunities are there, but for top performers. Core roles are limited, and many companies offer mass recruitment profiles.
content.Infrastructure: UPES has one of the best infrastructures among private universities in India, but classrooms should have AC. Hostel and cafeteria are decent, the view from hostel is epic. Wi-Fi-enabled labs are advanced, well-stocked libraries. Sometimes you feel crowded in hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Graphics and Gaming) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, overcrowded for B.Tech students, and placement is average.

content.Placements: I am in second year so no one is placed in my batch. But the senior gets package which is well and good. The highest package is around 60 LPA in my course, and average is 12 LPA. Some top recruiting companies are TCS, Microsoft, Amazon, and others. Internship is mandatory in our course so everyone gets an internship.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has all the facilities like Wi-Fi, computers, and labs. I live off campus so I don't have an idea of the hostel on campus. In sports, we have basketball, football, volleyball, badminton, cricket, and many others. We also have tournaments and all to encourage students.

description: UPES Dehradun cutoff 2025 for admission to the MBA programme is determined by candidates' performance in the national-level management entrance exams such as CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT, and GMAT. In the meantime, students can refer to the sections below to view the UPES Dehradun cutoff 2024 for different exams, courses, and categories.

Students can refer to the table below to know the UPES Dehradun MBA cutoff based on the NMAT score and MAT percentile. Students can refer to the tables below for the cutoff date for the year 2024, and previous two years, i.e., 2023 and 2022 for various MBA specialisations.

As per UPES Dehradun cut off 2024 for MBA, the minimum NMAT cutoff score is 140. Also, taking into consideration XAT cutoff for MBA in Operations Management, candidates must have an overall percentile of 50 for General All India category students. hostel.description: University of Petroleum and Energy Studies has separate hostel for boys and girls with a capacity of more than 2000 students at Bidholi and Kandoli campuses. All the hostels have wi fi facility for learning.Common room has been provided in each hostel for relaxation and 24*7 power back up and solar power water heaters facility is available.The hostels have mess facility.Air conditioned hostels are also available. UPES has also tied up with private hostels for girls students in the city to offer appropriate accommodation outside the campus. All accommodation is on a triple sharing basis.
facilities: Library: UPES library has a seating capacity of more than 400 students and contains over 73,327 volumes of publications including books, standards, reports, proceedings, and more than 150 national and international journals. reviews.review_heading: So basically, if you are willing to have good placements and be successful.

1: VNIT Nagpur Application Process

Candidates seeking admission at VNIT Nagpur are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. After appearing for the respective entrance exams, candidates have to apply for the counselling process for the final seat allotment.
2: Selection Rounds

For itsflagship BTechcourse, VNIT Nagpur admits students with a valid JEE Main score. Candidates are allotted seats through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required.

placement_data.title: VNIT Nagpur Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: VNIT placement 2025 is ongoing and under process. So far, 666 BTech students registered for placement and 558 students were placed . The BTech placement percentage recorded so far was 83.78%. Other than this, the highest and average package offered stood at I NR 64 LPA and INR 10.70 LPA , respectively. The median package offered stood at INR 8.30 LPA . 593 jobs offers were made. In total, 119 recruiters took part in the hiring process.

In MTech, 186 students registered and 130 students were placed. The highest and average package offered was INR 29.39 LPA and INR 7.98 LPA , respectively. The median package offered was INR 7.25 LPA . Moreover, 137 offers were made and a placement rate of 65.09% was recorded.

For the MSc and BArch courses, the highest packages offered stood at INR 7.25 LPA and INR 6.97 LPA , respectively. The average packages for both the programs were INR 6.88 LPA and INR 5.10 LPA . The median packages offered were INR 6.63 LPA for MSc and INR 5 LPA for BArch.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college for a mechanical engineer, like myself.
reviews.review_text: Typical government hostel, gets cleaned every day. LAN connection is available for all the students. The mess food is average, like you can survive on the food, except on Sunday night. A health centre is available on campus itself, and an ambulance is also available. Good enthusiasm for sports also.

reviews.review_heading: Overall a decent experience with good opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided here are good. For example, you get a Wi-Fi-enabled classroom with the projectors and everything. Hostel facilities are also good. You get a 3 people-sharing room in the first year. The mess food is good and hygienic. You can definitely eat it. There is also a health center that gives you all the required medicine when necessary. The colleges' focus on sports and games is too good like for first year. They have a thing called intramurals in which we compete against each o...

reviews.review_heading: VNIT Nagpur- the man, the myth, the legend.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here is quite decent. There are old buildings dating back to 1980, and also newer buildings. Wi-Fi is available across the campus, except at hostels, where we have a LAN with good speed. There is a well-equipped international-level library. We have three messes. The food is above expectations, but is repetitive. It has one of the best sports facilities among all NITs.

reviews.review_heading: You had to qualify JEE to get into this.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms were very good. Facilities included a fan, two closets, a table, and a bed with a chair. The mess food was not up to the mark, and we had to adjust to it. A mess form had to be submitted. Rooms were allotted based on a lucky dip. Many books were available in the library, so there was no need to buy books from outside. Classrooms had ACs, LCDs, projector screens, and many other facilities. There was a very large ground with different sports facilities. We also had the Institute Gathe...

reviews.review_heading: Solid mechanical engineering experience at VNIT Nagpur.
reviews.review_text: VNIT has solid labs, a huge digital library, and a good sports infrastructure. Classrooms are basic, no AC, and hostels improve as you go from shared to single rooms with LAN connections. Mess food is average, Sports /Medical are excellent, and campus life is vibrant.

reviews.review_heading: The view of VNIT college from the eyes of a sophomore.
reviews.review_text: There is very good infrastructure in the college for most of the programs, specifically for mechanical, there is a Siemens centre of excellence in which VNIT students can take part in certification courses in labs like product design and validation, test and optimization, reverse engineering, and many more. The mechanical engineering department has one smart classroom and many other classes. The only thing to complain about in the hostels is the food.

reviews.review_heading: Visvesvaraya NIT College review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is practical, with good facilities both for sports and academics. You can always use a LAN port for an unlimited public Ethernet connection.

reviews.review_heading: This was the best college for the M.Sc. in Chemistry course.
reviews.review_text: There were good labs, great sports facilities, and a playground. Very big tournaments were organized every year, and coaches were provided for games. There was a hotel office. The hotel was awesome in every way, very clean and lush with lots of trees. The mess food was pretty good. There were large rooms for students. There was a small hotel fee of 750/year.

reviews.review_heading: Great quality of life. Have to compromise a bit on placement.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and hostels are some of the best in NITs. 1st year students mainly get double-seater rooms, and if you report late, you will get triple-seater rooms. From the 2nd year, you have the option to choose either double or single-seater rooms. 3rd and 4th years are fully single-seater. 4th-year students get the newest apartment-class hostels. The mess is manageable, and medical and sports facilities are top class compared to any other NITs.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the opportunities the college gives to students.
reviews.review_text: A continuous LAN network is available in hostel rooms. The library is well-equipped with many books. Hostels are cleaned daily and hygiene is maintained. The food quality in the mess is decent. Medical services provided are very good and free of cost. Sports complex is also robust with so many sports equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Review of VNIT Nagpur  Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: We have a classroom complex with six floors where classes for most departments take place. Each classroom has a smart board and AC. Wi-Fi facility is available in every classroom, and there are more than eight lifts for easy movement. Each department has its own building where practicals are conducted, and the practical infrastructure is excellent. For example, in Metallurgy, there are instruments and machines that cost crores. Overall, the infrastructure is good. In the hostel, students are all...

reviews.review_heading: The college is placement-focused. Hence, there is more focus on academics.
reviews.review_text: Placements were very good. The training and placement cell was very active and alert in providing the best opportunities to aspiring students. The percentage of students getting placed was nearly 93% for the top 3 branches and nearly 85% for the overall college. I aspired to join a semiconductor-based company mainly hiring for the Analog or Digital Design Engineer role.

reviews.review_heading: Norms and strictness are at their peak in 2026.
reviews.review_text: The department of mechanical engineering is at the benchmarked cracking score out of all the departments as it was the first department of the college and the hostel facilities are typical of the South Indian style. Sports facilities are surplus in hostel facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The truth behind B.Arch in VNIT.
reviews.review_text: The best facilities and infrastructure are available on campus, well-equipped with technology, and a library with a wide range of books related to all departments. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus, but sometimes times signal won't be available in hostels, no co-living is allowed on the campus, fewer space rooms and high security on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: A cute and short story about a struggling engineer.
reviews.review_text: The library and classrooms are pretty neat and clean but the department seems old but still it's clean. Our college is actually small. Roads and maintenance are great. Facilities regarding studies are ultimate (pros, library, seniors, Ph.D. students). The hostel is a 10 from 2nd year. 1st year hostel is separate due to ragging problems which is good and safe for freshers. 1st year hostel is old and big which is given to 2 girls per room which looks like a home. Coming to the senior's block so ca...

faqs.answer: A:    The main details regarding entrance exam scores that Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences (SIMATS) accepts for MBA admission are as follows: SIMATS grants admission to MBA programs based on the results of standardized management entrance tests such as CAT, MAT, XAT, ATMA, and CMAT. The necessary percentile scores at a minimum are: 50 percentile of the CAT 60 percentile in MAT 60 percentile in XAT ATMA - 60% of the sample CMAT - 60% of the sample Those who pass any of these admission tests with a valid score can apply to SIMATS' MBA program. A bachelor's degree from an accredited university with a minimum of 50% overall grades is required of applicants in addition to their entrance exam results. Depending on the volume of applications, the exact deadlines for receiving an admission offer may change every year.

overview_faqs.question: Does Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences refund fees?
overview_faqs.answer: Several salient features of Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences' return policy are: The majority of the institute's programs, including MBBS, BDS, B.Tech, and others, have clear return policies. After deducting administrative fees, funds are reimbursed to students who opt to withdraw their acceptance prior to the final day of admission. Usually, 1-2 weeks after classes begin, the deadline for admissions is reached. The following guidelines will apply to refunds in the event that a student departs after the final admissions date: Refundable 75% of fees if departure occurs within 30 days before the deadline (registration expenses excluded). Refundable 50% of fees if departure occurs within 30 to 90 days. If you depart after the final admittance date, you won't get a refund. A refund application must be completed.

placement_data.title: SIMTS Placement Overview 2023
paragraphs: The details for the 2023 drive are not released as of now. However, the NIRF report 2023 is out. According to the report, 108 MBA, 121 LLB/BA LLB/BBA LLB, 30 LLM, 1,080 BTech, 28 MTech, 69 BDS, 40 MDS and 56 MD students were placed during Saveetha University placements 2022. The median package offered to MBA, LLB/BA LLB/BBA LLB and LLM students stood at INR 6.45 LPA, INR 5.8 LPA and INR 6 LPA, respectively. For BTech and MTech courses, the median package offered was INR 3.8 LPA and INR 4.5 LPA. Further, for BDS, MDS and MD students, the median package offered during Saveetha University placements 2022 was INR 3.8 LPA, INR 6 LPA and INR 15.6 LPA, respectively.

faqs.question: How are B.Tech placements at Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences?
faqs.answer: Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences (SIMATS) B.Tech placements might be competitive. Companies such as TCS, Infosys, and others frequently hire graduates from the college, which has a solid track record with placements in the IT and engineering industries. Specific results might vary depending on the programme and individual performance.

faqs.question: How is Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences for MBA in terms of placements?
faqs.answer: The information on Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences' official website and other sources indicate that the school does not offer an MBA program. The institute's main areas of concentration are courses in allied health sciences, engineering, medicine, and dentistry. Major courses provided by Saveetha Institute include the following: BDS MDS MBBS B.Tech in Biotechnology B.Sc. Nursing BPT (Physiotherapy) B.Tech Computer Science Saveetha Institute does not provide an MBA program, hence there are no recruitment or MBA placement statistics available. Neither an MBA degree nor placements reserved for MBA students are provided by the institute.

faqs.question: Are B.Tech placements at Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences good?
faqs.answer: B.Tech degrees are available in a number of engineering specialties at the Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences (SIMATS). Placement Statistics: The institute's data indicates that throughout the 2020–2021 academic year, roughly 70% of B.Tech students were placed. Yet, depending on the particular engineering specialization, the placement rates may change. Employers: A number of businesses have hired SIMATS B.Tech students in the past, including Amazon, Accenture, Capgemini, TCS, HCL, Wipro, Cognizant, and Infosys. Compensation Packages: During placements, B.Tech students often receive compensation packages ranging from 3 to 6 LPA

faqs.question: How many companies participated in Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences placements 2023?
faqs.answer: About 150 organizations, including major recruiters like Infosys, Cognizant, TCS, Wipro, L&T Infotech, HPCL, PayPal, and others, took part in the 2023 B.Tech placements. Regarding MBBS placements: In 2023, almost 60 prestigious medical facilities and corporations hired recent MBBS graduates. Among the top employers were Vasan Healthcare, Apollo Hospitals, Kauvery Hospital, Fortis Healthcare, Manipal Hospitals, and more. For BDS placements: In 2023, Saveetha's BDS graduates were hired by over 40 dental clinics, chains, and hospitals. Apollo White Dental, Clove Dental, Axiss Dental, Sabka Dentist, Tooth Hub Dental Care, etc. were among the principal recruiters. For Paramedical and Nursing: More than 25 large hospitals employed applicants with backgrounds in physiotherapy, nursing.

paragraphs: SIT Pune admission processincludes multiple steps. Candidates need to fulfill the eligibility and selection requirements to get admission in SIT. Check below the  steps to get a seat in the institute:

The mode of application is online. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria can apply online with an application fee ofINR 1,000for each programme. The application fee for SITEEE isINR 2,250per test. The fee for PhD courses is INR 2,150 for General category.

Besides, admission to PhD course is based on GATE/ UGC NET/ CSIR NET/ NET/ SET/ SLET scores.

Besides, aspirants also need to pay an application fee of INR 2,150 in the start for General category. There is relaxation in the fee for reserved category aspirants.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Ph.D at SIT Pune?
faqs.answer: Symbiosis Institute of Technology selects candidates for PhD course based on entrance-exam score. The institute considers GATE/ UGC NET/ CSIR NET/ SET/ SLET for admission to PhD. Aspirants who do not have a valid score in any of the accepted entrance exams can appear for a test conducted by the institute. Selected candidates are further called for a personal interview round.

faqs.question: How much percentile is required for SIT Pune?
faqs.answer: The eligibility criteria includes minimum qualification and aggregate required to apply for any of the UG or PG courses. The basic eligibility is Class 12 for UG and graduation for PG programmes. Below is eligibility requirement for SIT Pune courses:Course NameCommon EligibilityBTechClass 12 in relevant subjects with at least 45% aggregate (40% aggregate in case of candidates belonging to reserved category)MTechBachelor's degree in relevant subjects with at least 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for SC/ ST)PhDMaster's degree in relevant subject with at least 55% aggregate (50% aggregate for SC/ ST)

faqs.question: Who can apply for SIT Pune BTech?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to meet the eligibility criteria to apply for the BTech course. Candidates need to pass Class 12 examination withPhysicsandMathematicsas compulsory subjects along with one ofChemistry/ Computer Science/ Electronics/ Information Technology/ Informatics Practices/ Technical Vocational subject/ Engineering Graphics with at least 45% aggregate (40% aggregate in case of candidates belonging to reserved category) to apply for SIT Pune BTech programme. Aspirants who have passed the DVoc stream in the same or allied sector can also apply.

faqs.question: How do I get a seat at Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune?
faqs.answer: Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune offers a large diversity of courses to students in various fields. SIT Pune admissions are held on the basis of entrance tests. Students seeking course admissions must clear their previous qualifying examination and appear for any of the prescribed entrance exams such as JEE Main and SITEEE., among others. Students can visit the official website to learn more regarding the course-wise eligibility and specialisation details.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune with a JEE Main rank of 249,405?
faqs.answer: JEE Mainis one of the accepting exams for Symbiosis Institute of Technology Pune BTech programme. The score of the candidates is required to take admission in BTech programme. Aspirants along with JEE Main rank need to meet the eligibility criteria. They need to complete Class 12 examination withPhysicsandMathematicsas compulsory subjects along with one ofChemistry/ Computer Science/ Electronics/ Information Technology/ Informatics Practices/ Technical Vocational subject/ Engineering Graphics with at least 45% aggregate (40% aggregate in case of candidates belonging to reserved category) for BTech programme. admission_process.title: SSN College of Engineering Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: The programmes offered by SSNCE are affiliated with Anna University and approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). Admission to the BTech courses is strictly by merit + TNEA counselling. Interested studnets can follow the steps below to complete theSSN College of Engineering admission process:
Application Process 2026

Eligible students can visit the official website of SSN College (ssn.edu.in) to register. After registration, candidates can login using the Login ID and password. The complete application procedure involves online registration, login and application form filling, document upload, application fee payment, and application submission.
Selection Process

Candidates shortlisted forSSNCE BTech course admissionhave to participate in the TNEA counselling for seat allotment. For MTech admissions, valid scores of exams, such as GATE, TANCET are considered for admissions. Students may have to appear for an institute-level interview/ aptitude test as well as per the institute's guidelines.
Release of Merit List

After the conclusion of the application process or the admission test, a merit or selection list is published. It may release a cutoff list for some courses. The names of candidates shortlisted for further selection rounds are mentioned in this list. It can be checked on the official website as well.
Admission Confirmation

Candidates selected for admission shall be intimated over mail or a list can be released for the same. Such students can further confirm their admission by paying the required amount ofSSN College of Engineering fees.

nirf.description:
SSN College of Engineering has been ranked well by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Through the years, the NIRF rankings for SSN College of Engineering indicate the institute's strong performance in crucial areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. These good rankings not only prove the institute's positive reputation but also highlight its excellence across diverse domains, evaluated against the standards established by the NIRF. It has been seen that in the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown a decreasing trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2025, SSN College of Engineering fell 1 rank to #82 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
It has been seen that within the category of 'Engineering', the institute's ranking has fallen when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, SSN College of Engineering fell 1 rank to #47 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.

There are many dedicated blocks, separate ones for workshops, the central library, computer centre, science and humanities, etc. Classrooms are spacious, digitally enabled (projectors, audiovisual aids), and often air-conditioned, facilitating interactive and modern teaching. For all departments (CSE, EEE, ECE, mechanical, civil, chemical, biomedical, etc.), there are well-equipped ...

reviews.review_heading: If your aim is to get a package of 30 or 40LPA or above SSSN is the best choice.
reviews.review_text: SSN is one of the modern and premier institutions in India with a world class infrastructure which is known to all. In case of a hostel it is separate for both genders with unlimited Wi-Fi and Ethernet. Many games are also present with coaches who have served in IPL.

reviews.review_heading: A SSN student in Tamil Nadu.
reviews.review_text: Here, we have the best infrastructure and quality food. We have 24X7 Wi-Fi in labs, classrooms, and well-stocked library with central AC. All are very beautiful. We have sports for day scholars and hostelers. We have canteens and medical facilities are available here.

reviews.review_heading: Helpful faculty, strong research, good facilities, placements, and higher studies opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The college has Wi-Fi, both traditional boards and e-boards to demonstrate concepts and videos. The library is filled with books and is exhaustive in quantity. The tables and rooms are refurbished frequently and are comfortable. Windows are open, letting in fresh breeze. The canteen and mess serve top-quality food with high variety. A first aid kit is kept ready in case of emergencies, and the hostel is really nice with AC and single-room options.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with all aspects such as placements, campus life, and education.
reviews.review_text: The hostel was very spacious and comfortable. The hostel food was very average and they should improve on that.

reviews.review_heading: Sri Sivasubramaniya Nadar College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: We have best infrastructure and labs. We have best AC classrooms. We have a well-stocked library with central AC. We have best hostel rooms, and washrooms are very clean. We have a medical facility available for both hostelers and day boarders. We also have sports available.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are like international colleges, which are extremely good. The library is available. Wi-Fi is present. The quality of facilities available in the hostel is also good. Sports facilities are present in limited editions.

reviews.review_heading: It is a top 1 college for engineering.
reviews.review_text: The quality of mess food is average but the infrastructure is just too awesome. There is a basketball court, cricket ground, canteen, library, canteen and two other food shops which provide hygienic food. There are AC hostels as well as non-AC one can choose according to their needs.

reviews.review_heading: I got a new family in my college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in our college for the mechanical department are very good. The college offers Wi-Fi facilities in classrooms libraries and labs also. They provide labs with essential machines and equipment and safety facilities in our college.

reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with the college and its facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of SSN College of Engineering is so good, with a campus area of 230 acres. The food in the college canteen and hostel mess tastes really good, and the hostel rooms are neatly maintained. The security is very strict.

reviews.review_heading: Disappointed in placements. The placement centre lies to students.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good. Especially many movies and shoots are held on campus. But again my department's infrastructure is poor which is a 2 to 3 decades old building. Overall, the infrastructure is good and facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: College life - Great balance of academics and enjoyment.
reviews.review_text: Library has many resources and books. Wi-Fi facility is also present. There are total 18 ECE labs out of which some are curricular labs and many are research labs. Hostel and mess are also better than many other colleges. Medical clinic is also available on the campus. Sports complex and gym are also available for interested students.

reviews.review_heading: Journey in SSN College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: SSN has the most beautiful campus and their infrastructure is so beautiful. It’s full of greenery, and no college maintains such infrastructure like SSN. I love the campus, and it is very clean and hygienic. They have huge labs which help the students to learn more practically than theoretically. The hostel facilities are also good. The rooms are so clean and are cleaned every day. The washrooms are also very good.

reviews.review_heading: SSN College of Engineering - The best College in Tamil Nadu.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available in SSN College of Engineering are great. We can access the library daily. The library is very good. The infrastructure of the college is very good. The campus has good Wi-Fi facilities. The lab is good. Classrooms are very nice. Mess food is average, but Rishabs and canteen food is very good. Best food ever tasted. Value for money. Sports facilities are very nice. We also have a good GYM.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: It's all about your choice for this MBA course.

review_content.Placements: 67% of pupils received assignments. Furthermore, the greatest package is 12 LPA, while the lowest package is 2 LPA. 60% of students get internships at reputable companies. The faculty and the campus are both rather well-equipped. HSBC, Brain & Company, and EY are the top recruiting companies. This programme covers positions such as marketing manager, finance manager, and so on.
review_content.Infrastructure: All the requirements are there. The tools needed to get it. Classrooms and labs have requirements. Wi-Fi is available on campus and in the hotel. The hotels are very good with facilities. The food in the mess is also very good. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Biotechnology Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Review of LPU - Lovely Professional University.

review_content.Placements: In our college, placements are pretty good, but the competition is very high. Our college received so many admissions this year, which is nearly 50 thousand. There is a scope for our batch that we can get better placements if we work hard. For our course, there are low placements. In biotechnology, there are a few core jobs. If we need a well-paying job, then we need to work so hard.
review_content.Infrastructure: I can't say that the infrastructure is awesome. Our course blocks are clean and well-managed inside. The outside look is average. But the winning facilities are top grade. There is a Good Wi-Fi speed, which is nearly 10 GB per second, but in working hours, it is 2 to 3 GB per second. It is the same in the hostel as well.

reviews_list.batch_info: Integrated BBA + MBA - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: I’m strongly satisfied and worth it.

review_content.Placements: About 70-80%+ students were placed in recent batches of 24-25. The highest package is around 24-30 LPA, the lowest package is 3-4 LPA, and the average package is 12-13 LPA. Capgemini, Accenture, Wipro, TCS, Cognizant, ITC, Flipkart, HDFC, ICICI, DXC Technology, etc., recruited. 55-65% got internships in Decathlon, HUL, KPMG, Deloitte cognizant etc. Marketing analyst, financial analyst, Fintech, Digital analyst, Product manager, sales analyst, etc., roles are offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: 5G Wi-Fi, well-furnished classroom, benches with charging switch, AC, projector and whiteboards. Library with more than 10,000+ books, the latest computer labs, water supplies with a watercooler, garden with sitting benches, greenery flowers, food courts, terrace canteen, malls, sports complex. Hostel rooms are well-established rooms, AC, non-AC (cooler will be there), water cooler in every hostel floor, exercise machines are located in hostel premises, friendly warden, canteen in every hostel, departmental store, mess facilities also available, good food quality, everything is digitally run through UMS, LPU touch app. There are all types of playgrounds.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Best college with a good atmosphere and infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: Good placement, and above 80 percent of students get placed every year, according to the college. There are 100 percent placements with non-tech also, and Google, Microsoft, and IBM are the big companies that appear. The top roles in the robotics industry are offered with a package of 3 crore per annum, and the basic is 4 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: I'm from B.Tech CSE, and the infrastructure and Wi-Fi are fantastic. The classrooms are maintained very well. The library has a good number of books and a good place to study, and also a hostel is very good. All facilities are there, like games, indoor and outdoor. Good mess food, and there is a medical emergency like having a university hospital.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Placements are not up to the mark, huge opportunities available only if you study hard.

review_content.Placements: In my batch there were 100 students on average in campus placements for ECE. They got 20 to 30 people and that too at a very low package and they were not satisfied because if you got one opportunity, you had to take that, otherwise you would get terminated. The highest package in my batch was 8 LPA and the lowest package was 2.5 LPA. Top recruiters were LG, Wipro, Capegemini etc. Out of 100 students, 30 students got placed as Embedded Engineers, Software Engineers and VLSI Engineers etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and the hostel were very good. The hostel security is also good, various food will be served for north and south indians students, whatever they want but bit expensive for the hostel and food. The course and the labs were very good to use.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: LPU, choosing it is up to you.

review_content.Placements: Maximum people get placed in our college, the highest might go till crores. The highest went around 1 CPA and two are placed, one is from Robotics and Automation and the other is M. Tech guy. The lowest would be 3-4 LPA and most get placed through mass recruitment by companies averaging around 5-6 LPA. Companies include Google, TCS, Microsoft, Wipro and many, but the good companies hire the best students’ skills on upper preference as compared to GPA and the others hire Teach Mahindra, Eazy Diner, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs are good, you get Wi-Fi facility at good speed in both college and hostel. Library is amazing, has a lot of books and even a good place to study; silence is a must. Classrooms are decent. Hostel facilities are decent. Rooms get cleaned often. Mess food might be good some days but will start to hate it. Canteen is good. College is really outstanding when it comes to sports. Inter-hostel tournaments happen. Olympic size swimming pool exists. Two big cricket grounds. Sports complex exists where you can play badminton, basketball, boxing, fencing, volleyball, and even martial arts.
