review_summary.college_name: LPU Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It's all about your choice for this MBA course.

content.Placements: 67% of pupils received assignments. Furthermore, the greatest package is 12 LPA, while the lowest package is 2 LPA. 60% of students get internships at reputable companies. The faculty and the campus are both rather well-equipped. HSBC, Brain & Company, and EY are the top recruiting companies. This programme covers positions such as marketing manager, finance manager, and so on.
content.Infrastructure: All the requirements are there. The tools needed to get it. Classrooms and labs have requirements. Wi-Fi is available on campus and in the hotel. The hotels are very good with facilities. The food in the mess is also very good. Medical facilities are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of LPU - Lovely Professional University.

content.Placements: In our college, placements are pretty good, but the competition is very high. Our college received so many admissions this year, which is nearly 50 thousand. There is a scope for our batch that we can get better placements if we work hard. For our course, there are low placements. In biotechnology, there are a few core jobs. If we need a well-paying job, then we need to work so hard.
content.Infrastructure: I can't say that the infrastructure is awesome. Our course blocks are clean and well-managed inside. The outside look is average. But the winning facilities are top grade. There is a Good Wi-Fi speed, which is nearly 10 GB per second, but in working hours, it is 2 to 3 GB per second. It is the same in the hostel as well.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated BBA + MBA - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I’m strongly satisfied and worth it.

content.Placements: About 70-80%+ students were placed in recent batches of 24-25. The highest package is around 24-30 LPA, the lowest package is 3-4 LPA, and the average package is 12-13 LPA. Capgemini, Accenture, Wipro, TCS, Cognizant, ITC, Flipkart, HDFC, ICICI, DXC Technology, etc., recruited. 55-65% got internships in Decathlon, HUL, KPMG, Deloitte cognizant etc. Marketing analyst, financial analyst, Fintech, Digital analyst, Product manager, sales analyst, etc., roles are offered.
content.Infrastructure: 5G Wi-Fi, well-furnished classroom, benches with charging switch, AC, projector and whiteboards. Library with more than 10,000+ books, the latest computer labs, water supplies with a watercooler, garden with sitting benches, greenery flowers, food courts, terrace canteen, malls, sports complex. Hostel rooms are well-established rooms, AC, non-AC (cooler will be there), water cooler in every hostel floor, exercise machines are located in hostel premises, friendly warden, canteen in every hostel, departmental store, mess facilities also available, good food quality, everything is digitally run through UMS, LPU touch app. There are all types of playgrounds.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Best college with a good atmosphere and infrastructure.

content.Placements: Good placement, and above 80 percent of students get placed every year, according to the college. There are 100 percent placements with non-tech also, and Google, Microsoft, and IBM are the big companies that appear. The top roles in the robotics industry are offered with a package of 3 crore per annum, and the basic is 4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: I'm from B.Tech CSE, and the infrastructure and Wi-Fi are fantastic. The classrooms are maintained very well. The library has a good number of books and a good place to study, and also a hostel is very good. All facilities are there, like games, indoor and outdoor. Good mess food, and there is a medical emergency like having a university hospital.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Placements are not up to the mark, huge opportunities available only if you study hard.

content.Placements: In my batch there were 100 students on average in campus placements for ECE. They got 20 to 30 people and that too at a very low package and they were not satisfied because if you got one opportunity, you had to take that, otherwise you would get terminated. The highest package in my batch was 8 LPA and the lowest package was 2.5 LPA. Top recruiters were LG, Wipro, Capegemini etc. Out of 100 students, 30 students got placed as Embedded Engineers, Software Engineers and VLSI Engineers etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and the hostel were very good. The hostel security is also good, various food will be served for north and south indians students, whatever they want but bit expensive for the hostel and food. The course and the labs were very good to use.

admission_overview.title: LPU Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: LPU admission 2026 is mainly entrance-based and a multi-step process starting with application followed by selection rounds, and result declaration. The Lovely Professional University (LPU) offers more than 300 degree and diploma courses at the UG, PG, and doctoral levels along with several distance learning courses via the LPU Centre for Distance & Online Education. The application process for the university can be completed online. LPU conducts LPUNEST as the in-house entrance and scholarship exam for its courses in fileds of Engineering, Agriculture, Management, Law, Design, Pharmacy, Architecture & Planning, and more. While LPUNEST is widely accepted by the university, if students have valid scores of other national-level entrance exams, such JEE Main Part 2, NATA, CAT, MAT, XAT, etc, they are exempted from appearing for LPUNEST for selective courses. Those who want to improve their scholarships can apply for the LPUNEST exam as well.

faqs.question: Will I get a direct admission in LPU with 65 % marks in Class 12?
faqs.answer: LPU does not offer direct admission. However, admission to few courses is merit-based.  Aspirants scoring a 65% aggregate have a good chance of getting admission in LPU. Candidates seeking admission must visit the official website of the university to apply online. To apply for LPU, aspirants need to register for LPUNEST for admission to undergraduate and postgraduate courses. LPU admission to most of the courses is based on LPUNEST score. However, national-level entrance exam scores are also accepted for admission to BA LLB (Hons), MBA, BTech, etc. Candidates must complete Class 12 for UG courses and graduation for PG courses. The selection rounds are followed by counselling and document verification.

faqs.question: Is LPU entrance exam hard?
faqs.answer: LPUNEST is a national-level exam conducted by LPU for admission to various courses. LPUNEST forms the basis of eligibility for some programmes and also for the scholarship programmes. The amount of scholarship is determined by the marks and rank obtained by candidates in the exam. LPUNEST exam pattern elucidates the scheme of the question paper. Candidates seeking admission through LPUNEST must check the exam pattern prior to starting the preparation. LPUNEST exam pattern imparts details like total number of question, subjects, marking scheme, exam duration, etc. The entrance test is neither hard nor easy. Candidates must prepare well to score the qualifying marks in the entrance exam.

faqs.question: What would be the fees if you take a direct admission in the LPU?
faqs.answer: The fee is same for regular and direct admission. LPU fees changes for every course. The top LPU courses along with fee details are mentioned below:Course NameTotal FeeBTechINR 4.5 lakh - INR 16 lakhMBAINR 1.6 lakh - INR 10 lakhBBAINR 3.2 lakh - 9.6 lakhBCAINR 1.5 lakh - 7.2 lakhMCAINR 1.2 lakh - 4.8 lakhNote:This information is gathered from official website and is subject to change.

faqs.question: How can students get admission to LPU directly?
faqs.answer: LPU direct admissions are not possible for many courses. Students who wish to get admission must follow the application process given below:Register yourselfAppear for the LPUNEST exam.Once the results are announced, you have to choose a courseTake part in the counselling session and seat allotment.Perform well in the interview round.Fill the admission form and pay INR 10,000 initially.Submit all the necessary documents and pay the remaining fee.

placement_data.title: Lovely Professional University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The highest package offered during LPU placements 2025 stood at INR 2.5 crore per annum and the second highest package stood at INR 1.03 crore per annum. Both packages were offered to the students of BTech Robotics & Automation batch 2025. The average salary offered to the top 25% students stood at INR 10.23 LPA. More than 2,225 recruiters visited the LPU campus and offered over 6,000 job to the students. The top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Accenture, CISCO, TCS, Capgemini, Cognizant, Autodesk, Infosys, Trident, JP Morgan, E&Y, Bosch , etc.

Earlier, the students of the BTech batch 2024 secured the highest package of INR 53 LPA . A total of 1,611 recruiters participated in the placement process and prsented over 7,400 jobs to the students. Microsoft, Google, Infosys, L&T, Amazon, HCL, IBM, TCS, ICICI Bank, etc were among the top recruiters.

reviews.review_heading: It's all about your choice for this MBA course.
reviews.review_text: All the requirements are there. The tools needed to get it. Classrooms and labs have requirements. Wi-Fi is available on campus and in the hotel. The hotels are very good with facilities. The food in the mess is also very good. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LPU - Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: I can't say that the infrastructure is awesome. Our course blocks are clean and well-managed inside. The outside look is average. But the winning facilities are top grade. There is a Good Wi-Fi speed, which is nearly 10 GB per second, but in working hours, it is 2 to 3 GB per second. It is the same in the hostel as well.

reviews.review_heading: I’m strongly satisfied and worth it.
reviews.review_text: 5G Wi-Fi, well-furnished classroom, benches with charging switch, AC, projector and whiteboards. Library with more than 10,000+ books, the latest computer labs, water supplies with a watercooler, garden with sitting benches, greenery flowers, food courts, terrace canteen, malls, sports complex. Hostel rooms are well-established rooms, AC, non-AC (cooler will be there), water cooler in every hostel floor, exercise machines are located in hostel premises, friendly warden, canteen in every hostel, ...

reviews.review_heading: Best college with a good atmosphere and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: I'm from B.Tech CSE, and the infrastructure and Wi-Fi are fantastic. The classrooms are maintained very well. The library has a good number of books and a good place to study, and also a hostel is very good. All facilities are there, like games, indoor and outdoor. Good mess food, and there is a medical emergency like having a university hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are not up to the mark, huge opportunities available only if you study hard.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and the hostel were very good. The hostel security is also good, various food will be served for north and south indians students, whatever they want but bit expensive for the hostel and food. The course and the labs were very good to use.

reviews.review_heading: LPU, choosing it is up to you.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good, you get Wi-Fi facility at good speed in both college and hostel. Library is amazing, has a lot of books and even a good place to study; silence is a must. Classrooms are decent. Hostel facilities are decent. Rooms get cleaned often. Mess food might be good some days but will start to hate it. Canteen is good. College is really outstanding when it comes to sports. Inter-hostel tournaments happen. Olympic size swimming pool exists. Two big cricket grounds. Sports complex exists wher...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty, good placements in 2022, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the university is in top-notch condition. This is the biggest university in India. All labs and library are well-equipped with air conditioning. Classrooms are well-maintained. Food is ok for South people, but it looks like somewhat difficult to survive on this food. They provide 24X7 medical facility.

reviews.review_heading: Reviewing facts about Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: For my course, the facilities are quite good. The university is providing computer labs, Wi-Fi and big classrooms. The library is also there, which is very huge and consists of a wide range of books. The hostel is also decent, and the rooms are always clean. Mess food is okay. Medical facilities are available at any time.

reviews.review_heading: Very good infrastructure and facilities. Good placements, campus life, and facilities are excellent.
reviews.review_text: Facilities of the classes are very good. Labs are also very good, and library facilities are excellent. Wi-Fi is good, but sometimes, due to the large number of students, the network goes down. Hostel facilities are very good. Mess food and canteen are also very good. Medical support is available 24x7. For sports, we have an auditorium where you can play games and sports.

reviews.review_heading: The best infrastructure this college has, alongwith very good placements.
reviews.review_text: On our campus, all facilities are very good. But sometimes we have Wi-Fi speed issues in some blocks, not in labs. The library is open from 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM. Classrooms are digital for every class, we need a laptop mainly for CSE. Faculty are good. In the hostel, most of the facilities are very good, but a few times we have issues with the electricity bill at the end of the year. The gym is present inside the hostels, which is also free. The mess food is good in taste and unlimited. But the m...

reviews.review_heading: The college has beautiful infrastructure, good facilities, and strong placements.
reviews.review_text: The college had number one facilities and beautiful infrastructure. The classrooms for my course were hygienic and clean. Every block contained a library, and free Wi-Fi was available 24/7. The quality of food was not ideal for South Indian students. But overall, it was very good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college with excellent infrastructure and strong placement support.
reviews.review_text: B.Tech, BBA, MBA, BCA, and MCA courses are offered. Labs are available, and Wi-Fi is available 24/7 in the hostel and college. The library is very good, with seven floors. Each floor can seat 100–120 students. Food is very good, and three types of food are available. South Indian, North Indian, and combined. Non-veg food is not allowed.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Lovely Institute of Technology, PharmacyReviewed on 17 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: You get placed according to your capacity and capabilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, smart classes, libraries, and even a hospital inside the campus. The campus is even bigger and has its own many areas and food courts. It has many facilities, like an indoor stadium, a pool, many grounds, and even a helipad for helicopter landing.

reviews.review_heading: Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Amazed with the college infrastructure as they were offering a number of courses in various sections. For all the sections, 80 percent of seats were enrolled directly and the rest of the enrollment was through management. Fees should vary between direct admission and management quota students. Sports and games were played by us regularly as they were part of our schedule.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LPU  Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: Visiting the hostel rooms seriously made me feel comfortable and much more peaceful in the day to day routine. The perfect environment allowed us to have meaningful college days without any distractions. The fee fixed for all the services was not affordable to all.

paragraphs: NIT Durgapur admissionsare entrance-based for UG and PG courses. The institute offers admission through national-level entrance exams and counselling.BTechis the flagship programme of NIT Durgapur, admission to which is based onJEE Main rankfollowed byJoSAAandCSAB Counselling. MTech admission requiresGATE score.

National Institute of Technology course admissionsare also based on respective counselling bodies. The institute offers BTech, MTech, MSc, MBA, Integrated MSc, etc. at UG and PG levels in Engineering and Science streams.
Students wishing to apply for admission at NIT Durgapur must follow all the steps from registration to counselling.

National Institute of Technology Durgapur, also known asNIT Durgapur, offers UG, PG, dual degree, and PhD admission. Candidates need to qualify a minimum of Class 12 for NIT Durgapur UG courses and graduation for PG programmes. NIT Durgapur admissionsbegin with opening of applications. Since admission to most of the programmes is entrance-based, candidates are required to apply through the entrance exam. Below is the step-wiseNIT Durgapur admission process:
Step 1: NIT Durgapur Application Process 2025

Candidates seeking admission at NIT Durgapur are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. After appearing for the respective entrance exams, candidates have to apply for the counselling process for the final seat allotment. However, candidates seeking admission to MBA and PhD courses need to apply on the official website of the institute.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

For its flagship BTech programme, NIT Durgapur admits students with a valid JEE Main score. Candidates are allotted seats through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly, for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Durgapur MBA admissions are done through CAT score, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.
Step 3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The cutoff for BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The selected candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

reviews.review_heading: Highlights of the National Institute of Technology Durgapur.
reviews.review_text: The academic infrastructure is strong with reliable labs and library access. Hostel life is manageable. Though food quality could be improved, the sports culture is vibrant, and a medical facility is provided. Basic support of the National Institute of Technology.

reviews.review_heading: This college is very satisfying and has good placements for all branches.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the hostel, it is not available in classrooms. There are AC classrooms. There is no problem with Airtel net, it is available in labs, classrooms, and hostel. 3 members per room. A large central library with thousands of volumes is available as a resource.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and placement opportunities with support.
reviews.review_text: The ECE department has a well-equipped campus and a central library with a wide range of technical resources. The hostel provides 24/7 water and electricity, though the mess food is average. Medical assistance is available on campus, and student assistance is available on campus. Students have access to various sports and recreation facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied with college faculty members and there are good placements.
reviews.review_text: We have no Wi-Fi in addition we have jammers to block the network. Labs are well-designed and maintained properly. Classrooms are really good with projectors including clear board, nice ventilation, and very comfortable. Library is also very good having many books.

reviews.review_heading: As in every college, there is something that you will not like, but you have to take.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is well maintained here at NIT Durgapur, I must say, all facilities such as Wi-Fi, labs, classroom, library, and more than what we expect. In my hostel, we got three-seater rooms, but they are spacious and you will definitely love your big room. Washrooms are also well maintained, they keep them clean on a regular basis. Water cooler on each floor, you will have both options for normal water and cold water. Mess food is good, seriously, I personally feel it is good, you can eat it...

reviews.review_heading: My college life and my 4 years.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure for my course is good. My course is Electrical Engineering, and the department is good. The lab infrastructure is also very good, and the hostel is very good. The mess food is good but very much. In my college, we have a sports complex which is good.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Durgapur College review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in our department are good. We have Wi-Fi and the lab equipment is in great shape. Our classrooms are clean, spacious, and equipped with projectors. The library is huge with over 200,000 books. The medical and sports facilities are top-notch. The hostels are a bit old and not great for second-year students but they are okay for most others. The food in the mess which I will honestly rate a 2 out of 5.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, supportive faculty, vibrant campus life with strong extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: NIT Durgapur offers modern infrastructure with smart classrooms. Wi-Fi-enabled labs, a central computer center, and a library with print and digital resources. The campus is 187 acres with advanced research facilities like Utkarsh Bhawan. Hostels provide basic furniture, LAN/Wi-Fi, and common areas. Newer hostels are better maintained, while older ones need renovation. Mess food is average, but canteens provide variety. Medical facilities include a 24/7 health unit with doctors, an ambulance, an...

reviews.review_heading: NIT Durgapur has a really good infrastructure when compared to others, and a decent one.
reviews.review_text: Hostel Wi-Fi is decent enough, and so is the hostel. You have to clean and wash your clothes all by yourself, because they charge a lot of money, like literally a lot of money, if you want to give clothes for cleaning. Medical facilities are good, and so are the sports and games. Mess food is too average and not many options are available, actually.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good and vibrant college life.
reviews.review_text: The hostel at NIT Durgapur is well equipped with all facilities. Mess food is good and hygienic. Laundry service is available on campus. The institute offers excellent sports facilities. Catering to a variety of games and encouraging an active lifestyle. Which is certainly good, but I think you will face some problems in adjusting.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty and worth to join.
reviews.review_text: We have no Wi-Fi, in addition, we have jammers to block the network. The labs are well-designed and maintained properly. The classrooms are really good with projectors included, a clean board, and nice air flow through windows, it is very comfortable. The library is also good with books. They got more books than any college after Githam.

reviews.review_heading: The tale of a student - Good infrastructure, average faculties, good placements, good campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good, I can say. Hostels, academic buildings, and labs are all fully air-conditioned and maintained, except for some of the labs, like the thermodynamics lab. Other core branch labs may not be that well-maintained, but the academic building is. Some classes in the main building don't have proper facilities. CS and hostels from the 3rd year are not so well maintained, but in the 1st and 2nd year, those are the best.

reviews.review_heading: The clear and complete review about 0 to 100 through this review.
reviews.review_text: Library contains maximum all type of books including course and exam syllabus related. Computer labs are newly constructed so they are in good condition. Wi-Fi is a non-wireless connection, and the speed is very good. Canteens are available around the college and inside the college too. The food is good but doesn't contain any spice or salt.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Durgapur honest review.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are moderate. Hostel food is average for the money taken. But Wi-Fi connection is excellent. Classrooms are provided with air conditioning. Course is good. But the time we get for the semesters is very less to study. Overall, the experience is good.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, place for knowledge.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities for M. Tech students are honestly pretty good. We have 24/7 Wi-Fi in the hostel. One thing I really like is that M. Tech students get single rooms. Having your own space makes a big difference, it's peaceful, you can study whenever you want, and you don't have to worry about disturbing anyone. The rooms are clean, reasonably spacious, and regularly maintained.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Silchar Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Beautiful college with good faculty, nice people of Assam, zero ragging, and good sports facilities.

content.Placements: I don't have an idea about how many students get placed, but it is more than 85 percent in electrical engineering, as they go to the core sector and the non-core sector. I do not have an idea about the highest and the lowest packages. Top recruiting companies for our course are Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Infosys, and Cognizant. I do not have an idea about internships. My course students become electrical engineers, and if they go to non-core sectors, then they can become software engineers.
content.Infrastructure: Usually, our phone's internet will not work as well as it does in a Tier 1 city. It provides LAN, which has high-speed, so we can enjoy the internet. Classrooms are okay. It has Asia's largest library. Labs are good. Food is good, as we get both vegetarian and non-vegetarian canteens, so we can enjoy. Medical facilities are available in a hospital. There is a SAC building with a badminton court, so we can learn. To play table tennis, we can go to the sports complex. There are very good sports facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It offers good education and facilities. Placements are better for non-core roles.

content.Placements: 50-60 percent of students got placements in the civil course. The highest package offered last year was 19.90 LPA, and the lowest package was 4 LPA. The average package offered ranges from 6-7 LPA. The top recruiting companies in our course are L&T Construction, Tata Projects, NCC Limited, etc. 70-80 percent of students got internship opportunities. Top roles offered in our course are site engineer, design engineer, quality control engineer, planning engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi on the whole campus. There is a civil lab in the department building and many classrooms. There is a central library which is open from 10 AM to 8 PM. The quality of facilities in our hostel is average, as there are few indoor games and an old building. The quality of the mess is not good in our hostel. The canteen facilities are good. Medical facilities in college are good as they provide the necessary medicine when needed. There are two grounds and many courts that cover almost all sports, and sports facilities are good with respect to other aspects.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: My review about this college.

content.Placements: There is a placement cell which invites a lot of companies and firms for job opportunities. There are also opportunities for those who are willing to be an entrepreneur because students and the college also organize many times of hands-on workshops, research projects, and internships, as well as eminent scientists and professors talk to encourage students. So many companies come to recruit people. Internship fairs are organized by the placement cell of our college, and they recruit students from all courses. Packages vary from company to company, maximum being 12 LPA, and minimum 4 LPA.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Fees are lower compared to other NITs.

content.Placements: Placement of our college is really amazing as compared to all the NITs in India. As this year is 2025, the highest placement stood at 96 LPA from the mechanical engineering department, which is really a great thing. Also, the average placement of our college is 13 LPA, which is really good.
content.Infrastructure: I really loved the playgrounds, as these are huge, and also the inter-branch competition, which is held every year, is very exciting. The hostel facilities are quite good. The mess food is average but adjustable. There is 24/7 internet, no issue with that. The bathroom is well furnished, and housekeeping is really good. They come every morning and clean the staff. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, and it is open for 24 hours. There are many grounds for different sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college and the surroundings are also very good.

content.Placements: In the B.Tech Mechanical Engineering course, around 75–80 percent of students get placed in the latest placement drive. The highest package offered is around 18 LPA. The lowest is 4 LPA. The average package is nearly 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Tata Motors, Mahindra, L&T, JSW, Cummins, Vedanta, Infosys, Wipro, and TCS. Nearly 60 percent of students receive internships, with companies like Tata Steel, JSW, IOCL, HPCL, and L&T offering good opportunities. Top roles offered are Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET), Design Engineer, and Production Engineer.

Candidates need to follow the steps mentioned below to complete the NIT Silchar admission process:
1: Registration for Admissions

The NIT Silchar application process begins with the registration of the candidate for the relevant entrance examination. To register for the accepted entrance exams for NIT Silchar admissions, candidates must visit the official portal for such exams and follow the instructions of the announcement circular. For PhD admissions, candidates are required to register on the official website of NIT Silchar.
2: Selection Rounds

NIT Silchar selects candidates during admissions based on the relevant entrance exam scores. The relevant entrance exam is different for each course. For its flagshipBTech course, NIT Silchar admits students with a validJEE Mainscore. Candidates are allotted seats throughJoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is throughGATE, followed byCCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission,IIT JAMandCCMNCounselling are required. However,NIT Silchar MBA admissionsare done through theCATscore, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.
3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

NIT Silchar cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, forMBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats at NIT Silchar.

reviews.review_text: Usually, our phone's internet will not work as well as it does in a Tier 1 city. It provides LAN, which has high-speed, so we can enjoy the internet. Classrooms are okay. reviews.review_heading: It offers good education and facilities. Placements are better for non-core roles.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi on the whole campus. There is a civil lab in the department building and many classrooms. There is a central library which is open from 10 AM to 8 PM. The quality of facilities in our hostel is average, as there are few indoor games and an old building. The quality of the mess is not good in our hostel. The canteen facilities are good. Medical facilities in college are good as they provide the necessary medicine when needed. There are two grounds and many courts that cover almost ...

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure is different for different hostels. There are 9 hostels for boys in this college and 3 hostels for girls. Mess and canteens are present in every college and have a quite amount of seats, so every student can sit here at one time and eat. Bathrooms are present in sufficient amount. You don't need to take tension for infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Fees are lower compared to other NITs.
reviews.review_text: I really loved the playgrounds, as these are huge, and also the inter-branch competition, which is held every year, is very exciting. The hostel facilities are quite good. The mess food is average but adjustable. There is 24/7 internet, no issue with that. The bathroom is well furnished, and housekeeping is really good. They come every morning and clean the staff. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, and it is open for 24 hours. There are many grounds for different...

reviews.review_heading: The college and the surroundings are also very good.
reviews.review_text: The campus is beautiful, surrounded by greenery and lakes. This gives a calm and refreshing vibe even during stressful exam weeks. The infrastructure is pretty good. It includes well maintained hostels, labs, and sports facilities. The Wi-Fi sometimes tests your patience, but that is part of the fun here.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the placement record in the last 3 years.
reviews.review_text: NIT Silchar was built on a total of 625 acres. A nature-rich campus with more than 20 lakes and 2-3 gardens. Classrooms are digitalised. The infrastructure for the CSE course is good, labs are well managed, and a LAN (Ethernet) is provided to every hostel room. Hostel maintenance is above average, and there are 9 boys' hostels and 4 girls' hostels. Food quality is good, and our college has a good sports management team. We have a dispensary clinic in the college itself.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with staff members.
reviews.review_text: The university covers an area of 15 acres. The building is well-designed and maintained. The classrooms are designed with 4.0 teaching technology and also provide Wi-Fi facilities in every class and hall. The hostel also provides good facilities like fresh food, gym, Wi-Fi, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Good college as a NIT and good placement +.
reviews.review_text: NIT Silchar EE department has decent labs and LAN access, but classrooms lack modern facilities, and teaching quality varies. However, hostel life is vibrant and enjoyable with good mess food, clean rooms, friendly environment, and making campus life memorable.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: College faculty is very good and interested in learning. The chemistry lab is also in campus, which is very clean, and there are many chemical products that help in learning more about it. Exams are also held on campus and are subjected to classes. There are 9 hostels for boys in this college and 3 hostels for girls. The hostel infrastructure is good. Mess facilities, TV room, sports room, and good spacious rooms are there. And it is also very cheap. There are single rooms, double rooms, and tri...

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Course is pretty good and has a lot of focus on practical learning. Every semester, there are 2-3 laboratories of 2 credits each. The institute has taken many research initiatives and has a separate research and innovation cell for these activities. I have opted for and been allotted a hostel since the first year. I got a hostel room which was initially for PG students, so the rooms are great. I got a double room in the 1st year. The rooms and facilities are excellent. Mess food is compensable. ...

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: I have opted for a hostel which is compulsory in our college. I share my hostel room with a fellow colleague of mine. Rooms are quiet with a 24-hour electricity supply. There is a bed, a table, a chair, a wardrobe, and a balcony in the room. The lighting condition is also quite good. The hostel rent is Rs. 15,000 per semester.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Silchar is good in placements and campus life. City life is poor, that's all.
reviews.review_text: Facilities of the hostel and the infrastructure of the Electronics and Instrumentation branch are very good, even EI is known as the coolest branch of NIT Silchar. The food quality of the hostel is above average.  Canteen is good but a little bit cheaper, and vegetarians may face problems.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The quality is not top-notch but the basic facilities like clean drinking water clean washrooms and a bathroom are available, the food qualities are not too bad it can fill your stomach for the 3 times of the day and the snacks are available the canteen foods are good. For the medical facilities. We have a dispensary where basic medicine is available and for the sports. We have football and cricket grounds for the outdoor games and for the indoor games, we have a sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placement ratio in 2025.
reviews.review_text: All classes are digital classrooms. Labs are decent. My department is very good, with enough instruments available for experiments. The Wi-Fi provided by the library is good. However, we have LAN in the hostel, and we don't have a Wi-Fi connection. The mess food is average. There is a medical dispensary right next to the girls' hostel. The sports facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: This is my short review of my campus, NIT Silchar.
reviews.review_text: They provide excellent Wi-Fi, lab, and classroom facilities along with good freedom, but hostels are a bit average. Hostels are built like those from the 80s and 90s, which makes your room feel old. Until the fourth year, you don’t get any privacy in your room as only triple-sharing rooms are allotted.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure is well maintained, and the placements are good, with the average being 11–12 LPA

content.Placements: In my course at BIT Mesra, about 65–70 percent students get placed consistently, but from the past few years it has dropped slightly. The highest package is 19 LPA and the lowest is 3 LPA, and an average of 7.5–8 LPA is common. There are many top companies like Google, Microsoft, and a lot of core companies which visit the campus consistently. 60 percent of students get internships in core companies and tech companies. Roles include site engineer, design engineer, quantity surveyor, trainee engineer, and roles in structural, geotechnical, transportation, and environmental engineering.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Civil maatt lo CSE, mech, ECE, EEE are good options.

content.Placements: The students were placed, but the LPA was not worth it. We have a 4 LPA average in our branch, but according to the price, it is not worth it at all. On top of that, you have to pay such a hefty amount. Go for this branch only if you are interested in government exams or if you want a good NIRF ranking college.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. The campus is big and full of greenery, and it has good vibes in terms of nature. The buildings are also good, but the hostels and their Wi-Fi are not good, as Wi-Fi is down most of the time, due to which I recommend that you take a backup plan for Wi-Fi for yourself.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Amazing campus, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: 75% of students were placed in Civil this year. The highest package was around 16 LPA, the median package was around 8 LPA, and the lowest package was around 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies include IOCL, Deloitte, Accenture, Hindalco, TATA, etc. Top roles include structural engineer, project manager, and urban planner.
content.Infrastructure: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled (around 150 Mbps if you get a strong signal). The hostel Wi-Fi works well most of the time, but sometimes it goes down. The food varies hostel-wise. It is better than other colleges (you won't find insects and all in your food daily).

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good college, hostel facility avg, placements are avg, and lush green campus.

content.Placements: The highest package last year, 2024, was 1.45 crores, and the average package was almost 11.5 LPA. Almost every company has different roles offered here at the college. The placements record of this year has not come out as per true strength, but it is expected that the placements are more or less the same as the previous year.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels are good, but the water in the bathrooms is hard. The hair feels oily after a bath, and despite having a water purifying setup at Mesra, the drinking water is not up to that standard. The Wi-Fi here is not reliable. Sometimes it gets cut due to unnecessary reasons, and gaming on hostel Wi-Fi is restricted. You can't play any game here unless you find a solution. The food quality is decent.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Used to be good, but now it's doomed.

content.Placements: Nearly 60-80 percent of my courses were placed last year. The highest is 50 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average is around 15 LPA. Oracle, Infosys, Texas Instruments, Intel, Microsoft, Google, Goldman Sachs, Atlassian, etc. The roles offered are SDE, hardware engineer, network engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi is good, but is restricted to a limited number of sites. Labs aren't maintained regularly, and the classrooms are enough to accommodate, but not all the teachers are well-equipped to tech. The library is good, but the environment there isn't good. The hostel is just bad. The food is bad. The rooms that are meant to be for one person are currently given to two students.

hostel.description: Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra is completely residential with eleven hostels for boys and three separate ones for girls. All student lodging houses are spacious and beautifully laid out amidst a lot greenery. Each male-student is provided with well-furnished single-accommodation while girls share their accommodation in spacious and adequately furnished rooms. Individual rooms are constructed in a row with a wide veranda for common use running along the length of passage. Common facilities at the hostel include dining halls and common rooms with provision for several indoor games. The reading room in each hostel subscribes to a large number of magazines, periodicals and newspapers. The entertainment hall in each hostel has a color television set. Each hostel has an independent mess, completely run and managed by the students themselves. The hostels are a hub of leisure activities. Students are encouraged to pursue a wide range of extra curricular activities and hobbies in their free time and events both entertaining and competitive are arranged quite frequently. Inter-hostel tournaments of indoor and outdoor games, quizzes, competitions and adventure trips are very popular at BIT Mesra. The 'Hostel Night' organized by resident students is a memorable yearly event where students interact with the faculty members amidst cultural programmes and a lot of fun in a shared mood of festivity.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is well maintained, and the placements are good, with the average being 11–12 LPA
reviews.review_text: Many equipment in the labs are damaged but still being used. The Wi-Fi connection is very good, giving a high-speed network of up to 100 Mbps. The library is quite disappointing as books are in bad condition and there are not enough facilities, and there is no AC in the library.

reviews.review_heading: Civil maatt lo CSE, mech, ECE, EEE are good options.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. The campus is big and full of greenery, and it has good vibes in terms of nature. The buildings are also good, but the hostels and their Wi-Fi are not good, as Wi-Fi is down most of the time, due to which I recommend that you take a backup plan for Wi-Fi for yourself.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing campus, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled (around 150 Mbps if you get a strong signal). The hostel Wi-Fi works well most of the time, but sometimes it goes down. The food varies hostel-wise. It is better than other colleges (you won't find insects and all in your food daily).

reviews.review_heading: Good college, hostel facility avg, placements are avg, and lush green campus.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are good, but the water in the bathrooms is hard. The hair feels oily after a bath, and despite having a water purifying setup at Mesra, the drinking water is not up to that standard. The Wi-Fi here is not reliable. Sometimes it gets cut due to unnecessary reasons, and gaming on hostel Wi-Fi is restricted. You can't play any game here unless you find a solution. The food quality is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Used to be good, but now it's doomed.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is good, but is restricted to a limited number of sites. Labs aren't maintained regularly, and the classrooms are enough to accommodate, but not all the teachers are well-equipped to tech. The library is good, but the environment there isn't good. The hostel is just bad. The food is bad. The rooms that are meant to be for one person are currently given to two students.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, but only recommend for branches like CSE and AIML.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, but there are some restrictions, like the game website is blocked, and the mess food is average, like in a week they give 4-5 good meals. The hostel room is quite small, not for 2 people. The classroom is good with proper projectors. Free medical facilities are also available sports facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good.
reviews.review_text: There is a very good Wi-Fi connection inside the campus, like in the hostel, classrooms, and labs. The classrooms are very clean, with AC, projectors, and well-ventilated. The labs are also good. We have a lab for every course. The hostels are neat and clean. Every day, the hostels are cleaned and the washrooms also, but the hostel rooms are to be cleaned by the students after that particular room.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with above average placement for both circuit and non-circuit branches.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi inside the campus is good, high-speed, but it fluctuates a lot, sometimes it gives 150 mbps and other times it goes down to kbps, so it's unpredictable. Labs have all the required equipment available, some equipment does need changes, and it is either broken or old, but overall, it's good.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members in CSE are good, but for ECE, they are the worst. Good coding culture in college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are very small. In the first year, hostel rooms are still big, but from the second year, their size is very small. In a room, 2 students are present, which is something that I don't like about this college. There are also some three-sharing rooms in the hostel, and they are pretty good, but only a few students get them. Wi-Fi is average, like those students whose rooms are in the corners of the hostel didn't get much access to Wi-Fi. Classrooms are 10/10, like they are very good. La...

reviews.review_heading: A very good college but you have to spend 10 lakhs in 2 years.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, it is having large number of books. Labs are spacious and have all the apparatus used in industry. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. Boys hostel is 4 to 5 km away from the college. Mess food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied and value for money.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided are as follows: 5G Wi-Fi available 24/7, classroom projectors with centralized air conditioning, a very large library with all types of books available, hostel mess food above average, and night canteen available in each hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I will recommend Birla Institute of Technology Mesra.
reviews.review_text: The food menu is decided by the student body living in that. Home-like food in some hostels, like H5, is great. Any problem, we have Dean sir, for student affairs. If anyone is behaving rudely, you can talk to sir, and you do not need any other proof.

reviews.review_heading: Placement varies every year. Infrastructure and environment are good. Faculty depends on the course.
reviews.review_text: Management is questionable but the infrastructure is quite good. Hostel rooms are kind of small for two students but you will get used to them in no time. The Wi-Fi is available all around the campus so its a plus point. Sports facilities are decent. Dispensary provide free medicine.

reviews.review_heading: I am neither dissatisfied nor satisfied, but happy with what I got.
reviews.review_text: The campus is big, but it has great potential to be one of the greatest campuses in India. Many places on the campus are only trees, and all that's good because the AQI is good on the campus. Still, there are places where much infrastructure can be built.

reviews.review_heading: It is good for circuit courses in B.Tech and for mechanical engineering only.
reviews.review_text: The library, playgrounds, and classrooms are good with AC and smartboards. Hostels aren't that good, with quite small rooms, but we would adjust. Food in the mess is okay, and Wi-Fi is decent. Labs are all well-equipped, and we won't face any problem regarding that. Apart from that, the campus is very beautiful and pollution-free with a lot of trees.

review_summary.college_name: Graphic Era University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college has amazing management. There are placement issues for BCA.

content.Placements: Around 60 percent of students get placed, and the remaining students opt for MCA or higher studies. The highest package offered is 8 LPA from BCA, and the lowest package offered is 3 LPA. The average package offered is around 5 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Infosys, Tech Mahindra, etc. There are not many internship opportunities on campus. The top roles offered are senior software developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Graphic Era Deemed to be University has great facilities of labs and the library. Computers in the lab are in very good condition. There are many labs for practice and a huge library in different blocks. Classrooms are amazing. It provides a smart board in each class. The hostel is a little costly but gives amazing infrastructure and services. The food is pretty good. It has space for both indoor and outdoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Operation Theatre - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I am fully satisfied with the university. It has a great environment and a great hospital.

content.Placements: Around seventy percent of students got placed in the top companies. The highest package is 6 LPA. The lowest package is 3.5 LPA. Top role offered in this course is to become an operating theatre technician in the hospital. It is a paramedical course which is a great choice.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is great. I love the information about the graphics its great infrastructure, health care, and living. The food is provided. It has many canteens which provide great taste. It has all the departments. There is a big ground, and it provides a lot of fun.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it's a good college.

content.Placements: Placement record is good. The highest package is 88 LPA so in the aspects of placement it's pretty good. Best placement can be seen in B.Tech courses as they are giving 100% placement guarantee. In comparison with hill it's better. So if we are looking for a college in terms of placement, Graphic Era can be a better option.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is average as it only covers 35 acres. But it's quite large. It seems small as the college has a very large number of students, especially in B.Tech courses. The crowd is quite large. Playground is also below average as it's not that big.

individual_reviews.course: Certificate in Hotel Operations - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: No doubt my college is much better than any other in terms of areas.

content.Placements: Most of the students are sent to companies like Hyatt and Jw Marriott. The college has a lot of good connections with the hospitality industry to place its students. In total, around 95 percent of students got placements from the college, which is more helpful.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities that students got from the Graphic Era Deemed to be University are much better and match our expectations, as we expected them to be the same. The mess serves quite good quality of food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: This college is for those students who are more active in events and fests.

content.Placements: I don't think placements here are good. 70-80 percent of students get placed in my course, as per my knowledge, but packages are not that high. The highest package offered is 10 LPA, and the lowest package offered ranges from 2-4 LPA. Around 60 percent of students got internships in the B.Sc. nursing course. ICU nurse and nurse manager are the top roles offered there.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is excellent. The librarian and the library are also very large. Wi-Fi facilities are also available in the library. Classrooms could be more furnished, but they are good. The mess and canteen are also decent. There are medical facilities. Hostels are a little bit expensive.

paragraphs: Graphic Era University admissionsare open for all courses. Candidates can appear for GECET or provide a score in accepted entrance exam for admission. Check below the steps to get a seat in the university:
1: Graphic EraApplication Process 2026

The Graphic Era University admission process starts with filling the application process in online or offline mode for the respective courses. Candidates who are interested in getting admission to any of the UG & PG courses can apply on the university's official website. The application fees is INR 1,500 for a course.
2: Selection Rounds

The selection to most of the UG & PG courses at the Graphic Era University is merit-based. Candidates are selected based on their merit scores obtained in the last qualifying exam. Aspirants can also get admission based on their national or university-level entrance exam scores in MBA and MDes programmes. The university also conducts an in-house entrance-cum-scholarship test -GECETfor UG and PG courses. Selected candidates also need to come for a personal interview round for admission to some courses such as MBA, MDes, etc.
3: Admission Confirmation

The selected candidates will be notified about the selection via call, email, or post. To confirm admission, candidates must pay theGraphic Era University feesand submit the relevant documents within the stipulated deadline.

reviews.review_heading: The college has amazing management. There are placement issues for BCA.
reviews.review_text: Graphic Era Deemed to be University has great facilities of labs and the library. Computers in the lab are in very good condition. There are many labs for practice and a huge library in different blocks. Classrooms are amazing. It provides a smart board in each class. The hostel is a little costly but gives amazing infrastructure and services. The food is pretty good. It has space for both indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with the university. It has a great environment and a great hospital.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is great. I love the information about the graphics its great infrastructure, health care, and living. The food is provided. It has many canteens which provide great taste. It has all the departments. There is a big ground, and it provides a lot of fun.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's a good college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is average as it only covers 35 acres. But it's quite large. It seems small as the college has a very large number of students, especially in B.Tech courses. The crowd is quite large. Playground is also below average as it's not that big.

reviews.review_heading: No doubt my college is much better than any other in terms of areas.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities that students got from the Graphic Era Deemed to be University are much better and match our expectations, as we expected them to be the same. The mess serves quite good quality of food.

reviews.review_heading: This college is for those students who are more active in events and fests.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent. The librarian and the library are also very large. Wi-Fi facilities are also available in the library. Classrooms could be more furnished, but they are good. The mess and canteen are also decent. There are medical facilities. Hostels are a little bit expensive.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty, infrastructure, etc, but not satisfied with placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. Classes are amazing, and every class has a smart board installed in it. There are many labs inside the campus, which provide better exposure to the practical aspects of the course. There are also many libraries available. The hostel is good, the food is also good and hygienic, and the hostels are disciplined and have high security.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely a good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: If I tell you about facilities, it’s average in my department. I’m not telling about other departments. Quality of hostel I don’t know. Quality of food is good. There are 4-5 canteens where food is available. All things were available and good, like sports, games, and medical facilities too.

reviews.review_heading: Graphic Era University review.
reviews.review_text: Every required facility is available, good food and infrastructure of hostels. We enjoy the services provided in our hostel, and along with that, we have great transportation facilities supported by the hostel and the college. It is a great place to get exposure.

reviews.review_heading: Comprehensive review of my B.Tech ECE program.
reviews.review_text: GU central library reportedly holds over 1,74,700 technical books, many periodicals, and journals. It also has a digital library with more than 1,200 general reading rooms with 300-seat capacity, a book bank, and reference or leading facilities. The campus is described as fully Wi-Fi enabled, as wired and wireless internet access is reported to be available 24x7.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent, really good college.
reviews.review_text: Excellent, Graphic Era infrastructure, of course. The hostel was so excellent, and our course and department were so good. Labs, classrooms, library, canteen, medical facilities, sports and games, etc., are all very excellent. Also, the mess of every hostel is so good, and the college provides us with Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: Average college life at Graphic Era Deemed to be University. The crowd is lazy and distracted.
reviews.review_text: Most classrooms are outdated, like they were built 10-20 years ago. Wi-Fi is poor. First-year labs are bad. The library is cramped up in the break, and it's difficult to study as there are no power ports available. The quality of hostels is average, and so is the food. Medical facilities are average. Sports events and games are good.

reviews.review_heading: Comprehensive and industry-oriented B.Tech aerospace at GEU.
reviews.review_text: Over 90% of students got placed. The average package is 5.38 LPA, the median package is 7.25 LPA, and the highest is 54.80 LPA. Top recruiting companies are ISRO, Indian Air Force, Tata Advanced Systems, Airbus, DRDO, MRO, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied but could do better.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms, and library are very good with comfortable seats and good equipment. Wi-Fi is average. For sports, the teams are good. Mess food is average, and canteens are great. Clinic is good for quick check-ups. Hostel facilities are good as they provide necessary things.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with my college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good. The quality of hostel is good for the students, and the quality of food is also good. They provide different menu everyday for the students. The facilities for sports and medical in my thinking this college is the best.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements, infrastructure, but average faculty.
reviews.review_text: I don't live in the hostel but the infrastructure is good. I have heard from friends the hostels are decent with all time Wi-Fi and water coolers running 24 hours. The classrooms are more than good. The hostel is good, the mess food is decent, the canteen has variety, plus we have medical help, and sports and games facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Microelectronics and VLSI System Design) - Batch of 0
individual_reviews.title: My review of NIT Patna (Integrated M.Tech ECE).

content.Placements: For my branch, the recent placements were good. Around 70 to 80 percent of the students got placed. The highest salary was around 45 LPA, and the average was 14 LPA. Placements are improving year by year. Phonepe, Tata, and many other companies recruit. There are placement coordinators for assistance.
content.Infrastructure: The campus has good infrastructure and spacious classrooms. We have well-equipped labs, and the library is good. Wi-Fi exists on the campus, but the bandwidth could be improved. But the new campus is at suburbs, and connectivity is a hard task. But the new campus has good infrastructure and facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: My college is very good.

content.Placements: Almost 70 percent of students are placed in this course in different categories. The highest package is around 42 LPA and the average is 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, and SAP visit our campus to hire students. By the end of this course, 80 percent of students receive internship offers, which may provide a stipend or may not.
content.Infrastructure: We have recently shifted to the new NIT Patna. It is very beautiful and bigger than the old NIT. The old NIT was around 50 acres, while the new one is around 120 acres. They provide Wi-Fi 24/7, and all labs and the library run with air conditioning. Food quality is good, but somewhat difficult for South students, but we manage.

faqs.question: Is there direct admission in NIT Patna?
faqs.answer: Candidates who want NIT Patna admissions have to clear entrance exam and also need to fulfill the eligibility criteria. There is no provision for direct admission. So candidates need valid scores of national-level entrance tests. There are in all 10 departments that offer 40+ courses. The flagship course of NIT Patna is BTech which admits students on the basis ofJEE Main scores. Hence, candidates cannot get direct admission at NIT Patna. Candidates need to visit the official website of the national-level entrance exams and apply online. Selected candidates can proceed further for counselling, and PI.

reviews.review_text: We have recently shifted to the new NIT Patna. It is very beautiful and bigger than the old NIT. The old NIT was around 50 acres, while the new one is around 120 acres. They provide Wi-Fi 24/7, and all labs and the library run with air conditioning. Food quality is good, but somewhat difficult for South students, but we manage.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Patna - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: I live in the hostel named Brahmapur Hostel of the National Institute of Technology, Patna. This is one of the largest boys’ hostels in NIT Patna, and yesterday there was a special dinner. There are three boys’ hostels and one girls’ hostel. The total capacity is around 1,400 students. Some hostels have poor basic facilities. The Wi-Fi is very slow due to the large number of users. The library is well-equipped, but the classrooms are a bit old. The mess food is unacceptable.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Old college yet excels at modern engineering.

content.Placements: Around 80 percent of students got placed from our course. Among them, 15-20 students got more than 20 LPA, and around 50 students got 7 LPA-18 LPA, and the rest got less than 7 LPA. The highest package is 58 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average is 8 LPA. The recruiting companies are Microsoft, Google, Texas, Wells Fargo, Synopsis, etc. 40 percent of students got on-campus internships, and overall, 80 percent of students got an internship.
content.Infrastructure: Overall, the department is okay, but it needs more space. Labs and libraries are good. Wi-Fi is also available. Hostel infrastructure is bad, and the mess is also not good since this college is very old, the building and toilets have been used for many years without renovation, so it's a bit disappointing, but now they are constructing a new 10-storey 1000-seater boys hostel with a modern look. I hope they increase the quality of the food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Being an IIESTian – through my journey.

The top roles offered are in the automotive, manufacturing, and consultancy sectors.
content.Infrastructure: In my department, there is no Wi-Fi in classrooms. However, it is available in the library. To be frank, the quality of food and water in the hostel is poor. Medical facilities are limited to minor issues, but a health card is provided. All sports and games facilities are available with a good number of opportunities.

nirf.description:
IIEST Shibpur has received strong ranks by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Provided parameters including, Teaching, Graduation Outcome, Inclusivity and Research, the institute is ranked in a good position as compared to other institutes by the NIRF 2025. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown a fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIEST Shibpur's rank is #101, the same as last year's rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
One can observe that within the category of 'Engineering', the institute's ranking has fallen when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIEST Shibpur fell 5 ranks to #54 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Architecture and Planning' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, IIEST Shibpur's rank is #4, the same as last year's rank in the 'Architecture and Planning' category by the NIRF ranking.

reviews.review_heading: Old college yet excels at modern engineering.
reviews.review_text: Overall, the department is okay, but it needs more space. Labs and libraries are good. Wi-Fi is also available. Hostel infrastructure is bad, and the mess is also not good since this college is very old, the building and toilets have been used for many years without renovation, so it's a bit disappointing, but now they are constructing a new 10-storey 1000-seater boys hostel with a modern look. I hope they increase the quality of the food.

reviews.review_heading: Being an IIESTian – through my journey.
reviews.review_text: In my department, there is no Wi-Fi in classrooms. However, it is available in the library. As IIEST Shibpur is the second oldest engineering college in India, the infrastructure is old but good. Classrooms are very clean and neat, with a good number of fans and lights available. To be frank, the quality of food and water in the hostel is poor. Medical facilities are limited to minor issues, but a health card is provided. All sports and games facilities are available with a good number of opport...

reviews.review_heading: Really good college, like if you make good friends who hustle and are fun at the same time.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are pretty old and dirty, but are being maintained every year. All the hostels have Wi-Fi with a speed of up to 300 Mbps, and in the curfew hours, like around 10 pm, the speed goes to 30 to 40 Mbps. The campus is clean, but roads are very poorly maintained however, work is underway and will probably be finished in 5 to 6 months. The library is one of the best places with AC and sofas for reading journals and computer desks for studying, and a computer center which will open soon for ...

reviews.review_heading: College gives you all the things regarding academic as well as college life.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good in the department. We have seminar hall, Wi-Fi, labs, and well-equipped classroom. There is also a library. Quality of food offered in hostel is much good. Canteen is available at affordable cost. Medical facilities are also provided by the institute. Sports club and gymnasium are also well-equipped.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: So far we have not come to the electives stage that will be given to me in the second year but in the first year, I have to study all three subjects that are physical, organic, and inorganic chemistry. I will opt for physical chemistry as my elective in 2nd year. I am staying in PG and I pay Rs. 6000 per month and the facilities are not very much good but they are just fine to stay. Food is not quality food but it does the job and is better than eating fast food.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel facility in the college as the college is located at a prime location of Jabalpur where a lot of coaching classes. Hotels and PGs are available at a very economical rate which we will not find anywhere else. It is small. The hostel facility is the most attractive thing in this institution and I can definitely suggest one who needs the hostel facility to choose this college.

reviews.review_heading: IIEST Shibpur is worth it or not.
reviews.review_text: In first-year classrooms good number of fans and lights are there. They are also very clean and neat but there is no Wi-Fi connection. Labs are also nice. Our hostel buildings are too old, infrastructure is not that good at hostel. Wi-Fi connection is there with good speed. Mess food is decent. Three canteens are there on our campus. Medical facilities are not available (except for everyday and small problems) but they provide health cards. All sports and games facilities are available and good.

reviews.review_heading: About IIEST SHIBPUR formally known as BE college.
reviews.review_text: Library is open every day from 10:00 AM to 12:00 AM except Saturday and Sunday, closing time for Saturday and Sunday is 6:00 PM. Wi-Fi is available in library, a quiet place for study. There are separate hostels for girls and boys, and at least 3 days of non-vegetarian food are given to students. Biryani is given 2 times a month. Infrastructure is also good.

reviews.review_heading: It was the best period of my life to spend such a memorable time there.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good. The library has a high-speed Wi-Fi connection. Classrooms are very comfortable, with soundproof walls. The food in the hostel is below average in the first year but gradually improves. Table tennis is available in the hostel. For cricket and football, there are Oval and Lord's grounds.

reviews.review_heading: It is an absolutely amazing college, and I love everything about it.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are really good. Classrooms are air-conditioned, Wi-Fi is available, and the library has a wide range of books. The quality of food in the hostel is okay-ish but eatable. There is a hospital and three canteens inside the campus, and a lot of sports events are happening.

reviews.review_heading: It is the 2nd oldest engineering college and the only IIEST in India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good but quite old. It is being constantly renovated. There are around 20 hostels with a 1,000 seater and a 10 storeyed. It already completed its construction. The girls' hostels are particularly large with good food. Boys' hostels are average with average food. The exception is on an occasional basis.

reviews.review_heading: IIEST Shibpur: One of the oldest colleges.
reviews.review_text: All courses in the college are good. There are 10 departments, including the Department of Architecture, all of which are good. Hostel facilities are also good, with 20 hostels providing accommodation for almost all year students, including 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th years.

reviews.review_heading: IIEST SHIBPUR Since 1856 - REVIEW.
reviews.review_text: Sports ground available for sports like cricket, basketball, badminton, and football. In each, there is one television, carrom board, and badminton court. Hostel Wi-Fi is also available. There are various labs available for each department, and the quality of food in the hostel is average.

reviews.review_heading: Strong placements, great facilities, and vibrant campus life are available at IIEST Shibpur.
reviews.review_text: Facilities at IIEST Shibpur for B.Tech include Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a vast library with physical and digital resources. Hostels provide basic amenities with moderate cleanliness. The mess offers decent food, and the canteen has additional snacks. It provides sports facilities like grounds for cricket, football, and courts for badminton. Medical care is available through an on-campus dispensary.

reviews.review_heading: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur,is the second oldest engineering clg
reviews.review_text: There are a total of three hostels for first-year students at IIEST Shibpur. Hostel 8: This hostel is the oldest among the three. The mess food and sports facilities are better compared to the other two. Hostel 9: This hostel is slightly similar to Hostel 8. Hostel 10: This is a newly built hostel, and its infrastructure is much better in comparison to the others.

NIT Jalandhar admission processincludes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list, and counselling. Check below the steps to get admission Dr B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar:
1: NIT Jalandhar Application Process

Candidates seeking admission at NIT Jalandhar are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. After appearing for the respective entrance exams, candidates have to apply for the counselling process for the final seat allotment. However, candidates seeking admission to PhD courses are through the official website.
2: Selection Rounds

For its flagship BTech course, NIT Jalandhar admits students with a valid JEE Main score. Candidates are allotted seats throughJoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Jalandhar MBA admissions are done through CAT score, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the Personal Interview round.
3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

NIT Jalandhar cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

paragraphs: NIT Jalandhar has concluded the placements for its BTech and MTech students passed out in 2025. The institute has placed 91.88% students of its BTech Class of 2025 . The highest and average salary secured by the BTech students during NIT Jalandhar placements 2025 was INR 52 PA and INR 9.78 LPA . A total 862 BTech students were eligible for the placements, of which 792 student secured job offers. In total, 1003 job offers were provided to the BTech graduates.

For MTech program , NIT Jalandhar has achieved 52.54% placements in the academic year 2024-25. The highest package secured by the MTech batch 2025 was INR 22 LPA. The participating recruiters presented 129 job offers to the MTech students. 236 students registered for the placement drive 2025, of which 124 secured job offers. The top recruiters of National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar in 2025 include Amazon, Google, Trident, Microsoft, Bosch, Cisco, EY, Flipkart, Infosys, Infoedge, Oracle, Optum, etc.
