reviews.review_heading: Not the best placements (but in rate it's 100 percent in my branch) but a very good college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is the best thing in the college. Every day I go to my college from hostel and see all the buildings and so much luxurious classrooms, my heart fills with happiness that I'm at a very best place for 4 years of my graduation. The surroundings are clean and there are little extreme climate conditions though.

reviews.review_heading: College has really good placement and infrastructure. Even the behaviour of staff is good.
reviews.review_text: If we talk about the infrastructure, the infrastructure is quite good. The campus is spread in 152 acres. Each department has its own building. Classrooms are good but there are some old classrooms as well. But each classroom is filled with facilities like projector, AC, even some new classrooms have digital boards and Television. If we talk about Hostel, each hostel has different management. Hostel infrastructure is decent with decent food quality. Campus also has a dispensary and ambulance for...

reviews.review_heading: It has a big green campus with good classrooms. Placements are good.
reviews.review_text: There is a separate building for the CSE branch in the college. Many options are available in the college for food and snacks if you do not enjoy the hostel meal. The buildings are new, well-maintained, and contain lifts. For every course, there are separate labs, and the instruments in the labs are new. There is a slight problem that the hostel rooms for two are very small, but every room contains a balcony, and the view from the balcony is good. The food in the hostel is average. Sometimes it ...

reviews.review_heading: The placements are getting better year by year. The college life is also awesome.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is awesome, simply mind-blowing. There are no issues regarding the infrastructure of classrooms, library, etc. However, the infrastructure of hostels for first-year students is not that good. The hostels are very basic, they provide one bed and a chair-table for one person and a cupboard/almirah for clothes. The quality of food is decent; the chapattis are very bad to eat, but the other items and menu rotation are good. The canteen of our college is average, not...

reviews.review_heading: Core placements are not satisfying, but everything else is top notch. Sports and cultural.
reviews.review_text: The department building has all the facilities needed. You can reach out to any faculty member for help, as they are really friendly. Hostels are decent, and the mess food is good enough. First-year hostels have a badminton court and a volleyball court. There are three boys’ hostels and two girls’ hostels for first-year students.

reviews.review_heading: Best college ever in all types.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure in labs, library, garden, and classroom. Food is best quality, all other is average in our hostel. Cleanliness is average level. Hostel attendees are not good, they always blame students for anything that happens in the hostel. The garden is not for students, only for attendees.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is average, placements are going up, and infrastructure and facilities are good for the cost
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good in my opinion. The classes are well-equipped with projectors and smart boards. Its one of the benefits of government institutes. There's Wi-Fi everywhere on campus. The library is also newly made and very comfortable. The hostel we got in our first year is actually very good. The food is actually good, and everything else is too, the facilities for outdoor and indoor games are enough, there's a computer room with high end PC's. There's only one downside to this, that w...

reviews.review_heading: The college is too beautiful and good in everything.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi facility is not good. Hostel, all facilities are good. Mess food is good, and all services in the mess are good. Classrooms of the college are well settled. The library gives you all types of books, all authors' books. In the library, you have all study-based and other types of books.

reviews.review_heading: NIT, Jalandhar, is an Institute of national importance.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi connection is provided to all the students, and the connectivity in the classroom and labs is decent. The quality of food is good, and the medical facility is brilliant here. Near the Bank inside the campus, we have a dispensary where the workers' behavior is really good. We have a badminton court, basketball, and many more clubs too.

reviews.review_heading: Average placements, average peers and value for money.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are okay. Library is very nice with good air conditioning. Wi-Fi is not good all over the institute. The quality of food in the mess is okay but in the canteen certain food items are very low. Medical facilities are nice with despansary having doctors 24/7 and free care. Sports grounds are not okay except for badminton and basketball.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best NITs in North India.
reviews.review_text: NIT Jalandhar boasts a well developed infrastructure with a great hostel and academic infrastructure. Hostel facilities are very good with good room food and very good washrooms. Free Wi-Fi is also available in entire campus and the research equipment is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: It solely depends upon you.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is okay. It sometimes stops working on its own, but the infrastructure and exposure are quite good. There are 4 or 5 canteens. There is a place for indoor games and a quite big ground for outdoor games too if you are interested, a basketball ground, a tennis court (outdoor one is being built right now), but still it is quite good, I think.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and college life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the department is very good. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, but some hostels are not as good as the MBH rooms, which are very good. The rest of the hostels, which are 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 rooms, are very tiny, making it a struggle to live there. Food quality, sports facilities, and medical facilities are very good.

reviews.review_heading: I think things are changed, if a person who studies well he will definitely get a job.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the course is good, but the hostels are still not that great because they are old. However, a new hostel is under construction, and its facilities are really good. The sports facilities are good too, there are TT courts, badminton courts, and a tennis court.

reviews.review_heading: Really well-furnished infrastructure of our college with a new building and very good placement.
reviews.review_text: There are different labs in our department, like the concrete technology lab, surveying lab, geotechnical lab, and AutoCAD lab. There are ample number of classrooms in our department. We have a 3-story library in our college, and the department also provides a seating area for studying in labs and departments. For the hostel, we have a well-equipped hotel with sports facilities like table tennis and badminton court, and a gym with a common room, library, TV room, and fully air-conditioned mess.

review_summary.college_name: IIT Jammu Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: CSE and MNC courses in IIT Jammu are better than the IIT lower branches.

content.Placements: 2024-25 placement data has not been updated till now. The highest package is recorded off campus. In the year 2023-24, around 85-90% of students got placed. The placement cell is working hard to get us placed. Top recruiting companies for our course are Graviton, Samsung, MediaTek, Qualcomm, MathWorks, BP, L&T, Microsoft, Amazon, Adobe, Deloitte, and Flipkart. 80% of students got internships in DRDO, Adobe, Samsung, T&P, etc. For the 2023-24 batch, the highest package is 53 LPA, and the average package ranges from 15-19 LPA. The lowest package is 9 LPA.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college is good considering academics, hostels, and placement in tech.

content.Placements: This year there is approximately 80% placement in IIT Jammu. The highest package on-campus is 45 LPA while the lowest is 6 LPA. However, one student got a package of 85 LPA off-campus. The average package is 13 LPA. I am from the MnC branch which is relatively new. None of the batches of MnC has passed out but it has a very good scope as per the current scenario. CSE has a 100% placement start. Talking about internships, you will get an ample amount of opportunities and college support too.
content.Infrastructure: The classroom is air-conditioned and there are 2 libraries. There is a study hall too in which you can go and study. You will get institute Wi-Fi 24/7 in the hostel as well as classroom and library. The hostel has some study rooms and TT table setup. The food in the mess ranges from average to good depending upon the mess you get. Talking about sports, there is one football ground (one in the making too), one basketball court, one volleyball court, cricket nets, 2 badminton halls (one indoor and one outdoor),2 gyms, and some indoor games setup (pool, carrom, etc.).

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It's a great place to live in with an amazing infrastructure and growing tech culture.

content.Placements: In our batch (third year) about 16/40 students got internships in companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Warner Bros, Samsung, etc. Even I got 2 internships as an SDE intern at WBD and the other as a 6-month summer intern (SWE role) at Amazon. The highest package till now in our senior batch is around 62 LPA which is an offer given by Atlassian.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is great. It gives a luxurious feel. A new academic block has been built this semester only, which has bigger AC classrooms and well-equipped labs. The campus has access to 24/7 Wi-Fi with good speed. Mess services are okay, could be worse. Sports culture is improving day by day.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Getting an IIT itself is a big thing.

content.Placements: Almost all students get placed in our course. The average package is 14 LPA and the highest is 50 LPA. Top roles are in Data Science, ML, and software development. Top recruiting companies like Qualcomm, Intel, Nvidia, Amazon, and Silicon Labs. Almost the batch gets internships. There is nothing hard to get.
content.Infrastructure: Talking about the infrastructure, it is one of the best due to the new emerging IIT. Hostels are the best I have ever seen in my life with so many facilities, night canteens, and a good mess. Medical facilities are also good. A proper gaming area building is there, along with a huge ground for football.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good college in tier 3 IITs.

content.Placements: In electrical engineering, the last time that is 2024 batch had an astonishing record of 87% placed. The highest offered was around 50 LPA and the average was 18 LPA. I don't know about recruiting companies but so many companies come to recruit. Around 70% were given internships from my course.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are quite good. They provide full-time Wi-Fi. Labs have so much equipment. Classrooms are neat. Even the library has a vast collection of books. The quality of food is below average as you cannot expect anything much better because it is located in Jammu and I am a south Indian who likes to eat more spicy, they cook food which is sweet. Medical facilities are also good. They also conduct good events based on sports and games.

Students are required to qualify JEE Main exam before appearing for JEE Advanced. Additionally,IIT Jammualso offers MTech, E-MTech and PhD courses. While admission to MTech is subject to GATE, admission to all the remaining courses is based on written tests and interviews conducted by the institute. sports.description: IIT Jammu offers a wide range of sports facilities to promote holistic development among students. The institute offers indoor and outdoor sports facilities. Indoor facilities include a Student Activity Centre for those interested in:

reviews.review_heading: CSE and MNC courses in IIT Jammu are better than the IIT lower branches.
reviews.review_text: C3i labs are highly equipped with the latest technology. It has new libraries, and a reading hall has been recently built. Classrooms are really huge and the biggest one has 160 seating capacity. We have Nescafe which is open on all days till 1 PM. We also have a canteen near the academic building. The food quality in the mess is not so good, but don't worry the breakfast here is always good, so students should not miss it. Medical facilities are available 24X7. Nearly every sports facility is p...

reviews.review_heading: The college is good considering academics, hostels, and placement in tech.
reviews.review_text: The classroom is air-conditioned and there are 2 libraries. There is a study hall too in which you can go and study. You will get institute Wi-Fi 24/7 in the hostel as well as classroom and library. The hostel has some study rooms and TT table setup. The food in the mess ranges from average to good depending upon the mess you get. Talking about sports, there is one football ground (one in the making too), one basketball court, one volleyball court, cricket nets, 2 badminton halls (one indoor and...

reviews.review_heading: It's a great place to live in with an amazing infrastructure and growing tech culture.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is great. It gives a luxurious feel. A new academic block has been built this semester only, which has bigger AC classrooms and well-equipped labs. The campus has access to 24/7 Wi-Fi with good speed. Mess services are okay, could be worse. Sports culture is improving day by day.

reviews.review_heading: Getting an IIT itself is a big thing.
reviews.review_text: Talking about the infrastructure, it is one of the best due to the new emerging IIT. Hostels are the best I have ever seen in my life with so many facilities, night canteens, and a good mess. Medical facilities are also good. A proper gaming area building is there, along with a huge ground for football.

reviews.review_heading: Good college in tier 3 IITs.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are quite good. They provide full-time Wi-Fi. Labs have so much equipment. Classrooms are neat. Even the library has a vast collection of books. The quality of food is below average as you cannot expect anything much better because it is located in Jammu and I am a south Indian who likes to eat more spicy, they cook food which is sweet. Medical facilities are also good. They also conduct good events based on sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: One of the above average colleges in IIT Jammu.
reviews.review_text: Everything is fine but room cleaning is not so frequent. The mess doesn't provide non-veg because of some budget issues. But the food is okay and hygienic. The taste is not good but the quality is good. The 1st and 2nd year students have 2 shared rooms and 3rd and 4th year male students have 1 shared room with inbuilt air-conditioning.

reviews.review_heading: The institute has great infrastructure and facilities and is one of the well-emerging third-gen IIT.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is rated 4.5 out of 5. The infrastructure is top-notch, with newly established hostels and well-facilitated. The quality of food available is rated 3.8 out of 5 (less spicy), and hygiene is great. Sports and Games are highly encouraged and well-facilitated. Students selected for inter-IIT events receive greater privileges, and the coaches do a perfect job in their respective fields.

reviews.review_heading: About Indian Institute of Technology, Jammu.
reviews.review_text: For 1st and 2nd year students (boys) sharing a room is given (2 people per room). It is quite sufficient and we are given a bed, table, chair, and almirah. Wi-Fi facility is good and library is not too big. Classroom infrastructure is good with multiple boards and projector screens. Labs are also fully equipped. The food in the mess is edible and canteen service is not bad. Medical facilities are good and constructed new block dedicated only to sports with nice equipment.

reviews.review_heading: My college life was so good, I enjoyed it with great passion.
reviews.review_text: The department has modern labs, smart classrooms, a well-stocked library, and strong Wi-Fi connectivity. Hostels are clean with spacious rooms and good Wi-Fi. The mess food is decent with multiple options, and the canteen serves snacks. Medical facilities are available, and there are grounds for cricket, football, and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Weather and studies are excellent.
reviews.review_text: Our college has excellent hostels for boys, with AC in single rooms with a single person. Labs are also good. Food in the mess is good, and the canteens are also good enough. Classrooms are one of the best I have ever seen. It is fully high-tech and pleasant for studies.

reviews.review_heading: An Enriching Journey with Excellent Facilities, Supportive Faculty, and Great Opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Our Chemical Engineering department at IIT Jammu has modern classrooms with projectors well-equipped labs a library with a good collection of books and campus-wide Wi Fi. The hostel facilities are clean and well-maintained, with spacious rooms and 24/7 Wi Fi. The mess offers decent food with a variety of options and the canteen serves snacks and beverages. Medical facilities include an on-campus health center with basic care. Sports facilities are excellent with grounds for cricket, football and...

reviews.review_heading: Have a look at IIT Jammu, a new IIT having pretty good performance compared to other 3rd gen IITs.
reviews.review_text: We have very good infrastructure, new buildings, AC classes, all types of equipped laboratories, and good Wi-Fi connection. The library is not up to expectations; it is quite small with low capacity. Mess food is average, sometimes really bad, sometimes good; special dinner is quite good. Medical facilities are up to the marks; basic medical facilities are available within the campus, and for any major problem, a 24/7 ambulance is available for the nearest good hospital. A new gymkhana is openin...

reviews.review_heading: IIT Jammu: Superb college for IIT with best infrastructure and facility.
reviews.review_text:
Faculty members are always educated and acknowledged in the first structure; super labs and classrooms are hi-tech, and the library is good. 
Facilities in my hostel are of superb quality; the food available in the mess is good, and canteen medical facilities are superb. Sports and games are also superb.

reviews.review_heading: It has natural beauty, but not sure about the quality of education.
reviews.review_text: Materials science lab is well-equipped with all the necessary instruments, such as SEM, TEM, XRD, and more. There is also one dedicated lab for materials students that includes a muffle furnace and many other things. Recently built hostels are good, all are single occupancy rooms with air-conditioning. There is one separate building dedicated to mess only, which is of 4 floors.

reviews.review_heading: A decision to join in IIT Jammu.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good, with average food quality. Wi-Fi is available, but the speed is not very fast—it's average. There is a water cooler facility and a table tennis table in the hostel. Rooms are well-lit, and LAN ports are available in the rooms. Rooms are of two occupancies for first and second-year students.

fees_and_eligibility.overview: Candidates must take part in the IIT Tirupati admission process before the last date of application. Candidates must know their IIT Tirupati eligibility criteria before applying online. At the UG level, the college offers 4-year BTech courses to students. The institute offers these courses with total tuition fees varying from INR 10K to INR 8 Lakh with a basic eligibility criterion of qualifying Class 12 (for UG) with 75% aggregate and graduation (for PG) with 50% aggregate.

faqs.answer: A:    Candidates seeking admission to M.Tech at IIT Tirupati are required to meet with the minimum eligibility criteria (required for the course) and also have a valid score in the GATE exam. To be eligible, candidates must have one of the following:Completed their BE/ BTech/ BSc (Eng) with at least 60% aggregate (55% in case of SC/ST/PWD) or 6.0 CPI (5.5 in case of SC/ST/PWD) out of 10 ORa first-class specified by the university ORBTech degree holders from any of the IITs with a minimum CPI of 8.0 will be directly admitted to M.Tech programme (under Teaching Assistants position through a written test/ or an Interview).

review_content.Placements: Employment opportunities for students are exceedingly high, with nearly 95% of students getting placed in overseas multinational corporations with seamless placement processes. The average package is 16 LPA, with the highest being 40 LPA. Tata Motors, Jio Ltd., Google, Meta, and several others are the top recruiters and visit the campus for hiring. The college also offers internships every year.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available on campus, and LAN is available in hostels. The labs are fully equipped and excellent. The library contains all types of books—over 2 lakh books. The food can be rated 2 out of 5; the medical and sports facilities are good. The few hostels provided for second-year students are not good. The rest of the hostels are good. The food is also good.

review_content.Placements: A lot of students get placement here. Apart from its flagship programme,IIT Tirupatialso offers MTech, MSc, MS and PhD courses to students at postgraduate and doctoral levels. While admission to MTech and MSc is subject to GATE and IIT-JAM, entry to all the remaining courses is based on written tests and interviews conducted by the institute. The institute also offers a two-yearMPP or Master of Public Policy programmecatering to the growing demand for policy professionals and diversifying the intellectual landscape. GATE and non-GATE candidates both can apply for MPP.

STEP 1: IIT Tirupati Application Process 2025

Candidates seeking admission at IIT Tirupati need to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For example, for BTech, candidates are required to apply for JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced application. Similarly, for the MSc, IIT JAM application form is required to be completed. However, for MTech admission, candidates have to register for GATE first. The qualifying candidates have further applied for COAP and then apply on the official website of IIT Tirupati to proceed to confirm their admission.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

IIT Tirupati admits students to BTech courses based on JEE Main and JEE Advanced scores. Candidates are allotted seats in JoSAA Counselling for BTech courses. Admission to MTech is through GATE followed by COAP Counselling. The institute considers IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling for MSc courses.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent new infrastructure and world-class research faculty, but placements need improvement.
reviews.review_text: When I joined in 2023, almost half of the campus was still under construction. Now, most of the work is complete. The campus infrastructure has significantly improved. Since facilities are newly built, we have access to modern amenities and well-designed, high-quality hostels. The classrooms are modern, and labs are equipped with state-of-the-art instruments. Crucially, the entire campus is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi access for all students, supporting both academic and research needs. The c...

reviews.review_heading: College created tons of memories.
reviews.review_text: It's truly an environment that provided us the same with what we manifested before while during the initial stage of college days. A special department was appointed to find out and address the problems of the students. College created tons of memories with affordable charges.

reviews.review_heading: Indian Institute of Technology Tirupati College Review.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on campus, and LAN is available in hostels. The labs are fully equipped and excellent. The library contains all types of books—over 2 lakh books. The food can be rated 2 out of 5; the medical and sports facilities are good. The few hostels provided for second-year students are not good. The rest of the hostels are good. The food is also good.

reviews.review_heading: My Review of this college.
reviews.review_text: The course gives overall knowledge of the area related to the course, and also gives an idea of the market we would be facing when we pass out. This is a good branch for Research, as you can decide what you like and then contact any professor. Hostel food and facilities are awesome. Like food quality is too good, there were always all options in the South and North Indian food. Breakfast is too good, all that you want is available. Dinner is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Tirupati - Indian Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and labs are good. Classrooms are also fine with a projector, etc. The library is big and has enough books. Hostel rooms are clean but not so big. Mess food is okay, sometimes good, and sometimes bad. The canteen is small but fine. Medical help is also available. A sports ground is also there.

reviews.review_heading: It has a very beautiful environment.
reviews.review_text: It has good and decent classrooms and neat and good hostels. It has a library with all types of books available, and the library has online support. We can read books online. It also has 24/7 lab support, so we can train ourselves.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty members, placements are more or less good, and infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good and well-equipped with library, classrooms, lecture hall, Wi-Fi, canteen shops, stationery shops, etc. Hostel facilities are good like they have Wi-Fi, common room, gym, washing machines, water cooler, day canteen, and stationery shops. The quality of food they provide in the mess is awesome.

reviews.review_heading: Challenging college journey.
reviews.review_text: It's a Hi-Tech campus, which would be a costly campus, for getting admission to various courses is not an easy thing. College infrastructure was well-constructed with extensive facilities. Students were more secure and protected on the college campus.

reviews.review_heading: Crisp review about my college.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are so aesthetic with vibrant looks, equipped with modern technologies. The modern technologies like digital classrooms, digital libraries, and air-conditioned laboratories. All the simulation projects are properly done under the proper guidance with the enhanced support.

reviews.review_heading: Chemical Engineering at IIT Tirupati.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are top-notch. You get 24/7 Wi-Fi access anytime, anywhere. Labs are so good, it has well-developed a lot each student can access the lab and do practicals in the lab itself. We also have a computer lab for freshers. Hostels are also good, and while the food is average, there are many dhabas and hotels nearby from where we can order if we don’t like the hostel food. All medical facilities are free. We have two sports complexes with well-equipped courts.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Tirupati is a good college with a good environment.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in our hostel include Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. Fully air-conditioned classrooms are available in our college. A central library is also available on our campus, and books can be issued by students. The quality of food in the mess is average. There are three canteens on our campus, and the fast food is good. We have a small ground to play different sports like volleyball, football, and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Masters life at the college of IIT, Tirupati.
reviews.review_text: Top-notch meals are cooked and served everyday in the institute mess.

reviews.review_heading: Sophisticated campus area.
reviews.review_text: Friendly campus and gave me some hope, and confidence to achieve something in life. It's an enlarged green campus with separate blocks for all departments. We use campus bus, cycle, or bus to move from hostel to our classrooms. All departments are seperate from one another by following some set of rules.

reviews.review_heading: Course at college of IIT, Tirupati.
reviews.review_text: Expertly designed laboratories with technological advanced assistance are appointed to take care of the lab areas. Most importantly, Wi-Fi facilities were available on the overall campus which would be accessible to students, staff, and workers. Libraries would be accessible to students using biometric process.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college. It provided amazing placements in 2024.
reviews.review_text: Best-in-class infrastructure is available at IIT Tirupati. All types of amenities and large fully furnished rooms are available for students residing in the hostel. There is Wi-Fi all over the campus. It has a large sports stadium, medical departments, and e-classrooms with air-conditioning and water purifiers in the department.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: My experience and review at Manipal University Jaipur as a fresher of 2025.

content.Placements: Around 50% of students get jobs in my batch, according to experience. Recruiting companies are Infosys, Dell, Flipkart, Amazon, and Wipro. Project manager, web developer, database manager, and many more roles are offered. The highest is 10 LPA, the lowest is 2-3 LPA, and the average is 5.5 LPA. Around 60% of students get internships in companies like Tata, Infosys, Dell, and many more.
content.Infrastructure: It is the best college according to facilities and infrastructure in all of Rajasthan. Hostels feel like a 5-star residence colony. Everything is available in hostels, hospitals, cafes, shops, parks, gym, sports facilities, and indoor games, almost everything. No need to go out of the hostels for any legal matter. They have professional cooks for the mess, and every day is something different and tasty in the mess.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good college, self-study is important.

content.Placements: The college provides many opportunities through clubs, internships, competitions, and placement training, but it also depends on students whether they can grab the opportunity. Students who stay focused, work hard, and do consistent study can get the most out of these opportunities and get top placement packages. Self-study is a must.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are above average, with decent rooms, food, and basic amenities, better than those at other colleges I have seen. However, the hostel fees are also on the higher side compared to many other colleges, so it is expensive for some students. You can also apply for a student loan. College is friendly with loan documentation.

Facilities at the hostel are also very good. They take care of students. Their priority is students' safety and health.

individual_reviews.title: Very good infrastructure and very good amenities.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by Manipal University Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Manipal University Jaipur has an entrance test on courses like the BTech.The first exam is referred to as MET (Manipal Entrance Test).Applicants to the BTech programme are required to have a Class 12 pass of 60 percent aggregate or equivalent with Physics and Mathematics as core subjects and Chemistry/Computers Science/ Biotechnology/Biology/ Statistics/ Engineering Drawing as optional subjects.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in Manipal Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Manipal University Jaipur does not provide direct admission to all the courses. However it does provide direct admission to some of the courses such as BCA, BBA, BA, BCom. Admission to these courses takes place on the basis of class 12 exam and personal interview. For some of the courses candidates might have to take English Compregension tests. Primarily BTech and M.Tech admision takes place on the basis of JEE and GATE scores.

reviews.review_heading: My experience and review at Manipal University Jaipur as a fresher of 2025.
reviews.review_text: It is the best college according to facilities and infrastructure in all of Rajasthan. Hostels feel like a 5-star residence colony. Everything is available in hostels, hospitals, cafes, shops, parks, gym, sports facilities, and indoor games, almost everything. No need to go out of the hostels for any legal matter. They have professional cooks for the mess, and every day is something different and tasty in the mess.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, self-study is important.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are above average, with decent rooms, food, and basic amenities, better than those at other colleges I have seen. However, the hostel fees are also on the higher side compared to many other colleges, so it is expensive for some students. You can also apply for a student loan. College is friendly with loan documentation.

reviews.review_heading: It offers supportive faculty members and a good learning environment.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Manipal University, Jaipur, is top-notch and rewarded with many awards as well. The campus is Griha-rated, which is also a great achievement. Facilities at the hostel are also very good. They take care of students. Their priority is students' safety and health.

reviews.review_heading: Quite a good university giving average placements, great infrastructure, and vibrant culture.
reviews.review_text: Great and vibrant infrastructure with lots of amenities and activities. You have different messes with food that are better compared to other universities that I have known and heard of, and many facilities like a gym, sports like TT, billiards, basketball, football, and many more.

reviews.review_heading: Very good infrastructure and very good amenities.
reviews.review_text: Every corner of our campus has Wi-Fi, and each course has its labs and a central library which has a seating capacity of nearly 500 students. The mess food is average, and the hostel amenities are good. The college has a small clinic for emergencies, and it has a ground for cricket, football, badminton, etc.

reviews.review_heading: If you have money then only come to this college, else no need.
reviews.review_text: MUJ has a modern and well-planned campus. Classrooms are smart and spacious, labs are well-equipped, and the library is excellent. The hostels are clean with good facilities, and the campus has great sports grounds and a vibrant environment. Opt for hostels if you want access to more sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The college has very good infrastructure and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The facilities of our college are top-notch and have a beautiful infrastructure. They provide Wi-Fi hotspots, AC classrooms, a central library, 4-5 auditoriums, a cricket ground, a football ground, a running track, a badminton court, a basketball court, and many other sports facilities. We have a very good food court.

reviews.review_heading: This is a decent tier-2 college with average placements and great campus life.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is too good but expensive compared to other colleges, and it has various food outlets in the college and hostel too. The sports facilities are really good, and there is also a great campus life in this college, as well as a hostel. I am really loving the campus life over here.

reviews.review_heading: The college makes us industry-ready.
reviews.review_text: The course covers all the topics related to being industry-ready. The university organizes many seminars to provide knowledge, there are many competitions organized for students, and many industry experts come for the lectures. The attendance policy is strict (75%), and the university provides good placement opportunities. The only con that the university has is its location.

reviews.review_heading: Manipal University Jaipur is the upcoming premier Institution of India.
reviews.review_text: Excellent library and classrooms. Well equipped library with rare titles. There is a central library where you can get early sprint versions of very old books, which are practically extinct in the market. Well furnished athletic centers as well as well equipped gymnasium, football, basketball court, tennis court, swimming pool, table tennis, cricket ground, etc.

reviews.review_heading: A good college with some flaws.
reviews.review_text: College has excellent infrastructure especially if you are going to live in the hostel facility of college GHS. The college is not that big. It has a main building called as dome building with library in it for B.Tech and other branches. We have 4 other blocks and 2 messes in total with many cafeterias around the college university. We also have a cricket ground with basketball court, badminton, and tennis court along with a football area. The infrastructure is excellent, to be precise.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and good faculty!
reviews.review_text: The college has air-conditioned classrooms. The college has Wi-Fi, good and big libraries, good faculty, really high-tech computers in labs, and a lot of food canteens available. The rooms are really good and feel very high-end. The food is good. There are two types of meals, and medical service is provided.

reviews.review_heading: Welcome to Manipal University.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are top-notch, you never feel missing your home, you get more than a vip college. It has a perfect campus, good Wi-Fi, clean and air-conditioned classrooms, more than 3 libraries, and well connectivity between hostel and college. Hostels are also pretty decent. We get Wi-Fi, decent mess food sometimes, due to excess crowd we have to wait last long to an hour. Medical facilities are also good. There is always an ambulance available 24X7 for the Manipal Hospital, Jaipur, for any...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Manipal University, Jaipur.
reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure is excellent. It is very large, and many facilities are available. The hostel is also good, with two messes. The food is very good, and there are some outlets. There is a recreational room where we can play table tennis and pool. There is a cricket turf and a football turf.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college for students who are eager to find their career.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at MUJ (Manipal University Jaipur) is magnificent. The buildings give royal Rajasthan Mahal's look. Wi-Fi network is all around the campus. Labs are equipped with high-end equipments. The classrooms are air-conditioned with a projector. Library is open for 12 hours a day. You can get a variety of books out there. For sports like volleyball, basketball, tennis, a number of courts are built. A cricket ground is also being built now. So that's pretty great.

reviews.review_heading: Good course and facilities in college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is well built at apt location. All mess hostels are inside the campus. The library is top notch strict & and resourceful. Classroom has E board laptop that can be connected to AC speakers are all good. Sports activities take place regularly. Many technical clubs that push students to do better and have better knowledge. Cultural clubs and music clubs collaborate with outside talents during fests.

reviews.review_heading: Really good college life and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The labs are awesome, with modern infrastructure; everything is functional, and the classrooms are cozy. The library is very quiet and contains many books. For Wi-Fi access, you need the administrator's permission. To mention the canteens, it is such a pleasurable mess in Manipal. The food tastes, ohh, not like home but also not less than it.

reviews.review_heading: B.Tech in Aeronautical Engineering at MIT, MAHE, Manipal.
reviews.review_text: The college management is highly oriented with students' ideas. It makes easier for students to connect with them. The management is well aware of its crucial responsibilities. The college has good networking, which helps students connect with higher professionals easily.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, good curriculum.
reviews.review_text: One of the best sets of hostels available in the country. There are various lodging options such as single seater room, twin sharing room, single seater with common batch, attached bathroom, dormitory, etc. The rooms are well ventilated, airy and regularly maintained. The classroom has a centralised AC with a projector and board. Almost all books are there in the library, and a wide collection of journals. There are a lot of clubs, almost for everything. There is great exposure to the outside wo...

reviews.review_heading: A good opportunity for a great start.
reviews.review_text: I stay in hostel block 5, room is small, but comfortable and sufficient. Moreover, depending on how you study, you get a choice of rooms, like if you are studying really good you have plenty of options in rooms like AC, non-AC, single seater, double seater, triple seater. But if you are not studying good and your CGPA is low, you have fewer options in room or sometimes the worst option or even no options, but then all rooms are good, it depends upon your needs. There is free Wi-Fi too.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college with okay placements and basic facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our depth had good labs, Wi-Fi, and classrooms with projectors. Library also had enough books. Hostel was okay-okay, the rooms were a little small. Food in mess was not so good, but canteen was better. Medical help was available, but slow. A sports ground was there, but not much equipment.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are much better compared to other colleges, with the infrastructure and the kind of facilities provided. There are enough rooms to fit in all the students, plus all options all available, like single (AC/non-AC) and double (AC/non-AC). The mess food is good in terms of hygiene, but for obvious reasons, it becomes boring if you eat there every day.

reviews.review_heading: Overall good if you have money and want to have the time of your life.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Multiple labs with fast Wi-Fi for various subjects. Spacious classrooms and also all lectures are recorded. The food they give is a bit bland, but it is balanced and has many meal facilities with different types of food available. Hostel rooms are good with regular maintenance. Various sports facilities, including football, basketball, cricket grounds, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, decent college with good infrastructure and bad placements.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are air-conditioned with Wi-Fi. 5 academic blocks are present, all with air-conditioned classrooms. Most labs are air-conditioned apart from mechanical and chemical. Hostel facilities are above average, depending on your rank in MET hostel is allotted in grounds, if you have a good rank, you get to choose better hostel blocks i.e. single rooms with AC, certain blocks have an elevator 11-story means blocks. Wide variety of mess options to choose from, menu in each mess varies daily or ...

reviews.review_heading: Really a good engineering college .
reviews.review_text: They provide us world class laboratories, innovation centre to facilitate multiple disciplinary research. Library was available in the college and have excellent references resources. Full Wi-Fi campus available in the college. The quality of facilities available in the hostel was good.

reviews.review_heading: MIT Manipal- a complete review of academics, hostel, and campus life.
reviews.review_text: I'm staying in a non-attached, non-AC room. Cleanliness is very good, and it's peaceful. Toilets are cleaned once every day. Rooms are cleaned once every two days or more if we request. Wi-Fi is available throughout the hostel, with a constant speed of 15 Mbps. Classrooms are equipped with projectors, blackboards, whiteboards, AC, podiums, and so on. The library is easily accessible to any student with an ID card. Mess food is very clean and hygienic, but you do get tired of it after some time. ...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were sufficient for research and knowledge. Today's essential facilities like Wi-Fi and a library were available in the college. The quality of facilities in the hostel was also good. A sports ground was available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the good infrastructure and technology.
reviews.review_text: The college hostel and infrastructure, like the food courts, football ground, and cricket grounds, are very nice and comfortable. There is a huge library open from morning till night at 11:30, along with group study halls. The campus also has a place called Student Plaza for socializing.

reviews.review_heading: A great college for socialists.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure for Mechatronics are decent and growing, as it is a relatively new branch. Labs are well-equipped, classrooms are neat and well-ventilated, and there is a huge library with access to the required knowledge. Wi-Fi access is given to each student, along with a learner ID through which they can use all amenities, including online ones like Grammarly and others. Plenty of sports amenities are also present.

faqs.answer: A:    No, direct admission in MMMUT is not possible. This autonomous university give admission on the basis of scores obtained in entrance examinations. admission_overview.college_name: MMMUT Gorakhpur Course Admission 2025: Fees, Eligibility, CUET, Dates, Application & Selection Process

paragraphs: MMMUT Gorakhpur admission 2025 is entirely entrance-based.MMMUToffers various UG, PG and Doctoral programmes in the fields of Engineering, Technology, Management, etc. Candidates seeking MMMUT admissions must qualify for the national-level entrance exam for respective courses. For admission to popular courses such as BTech and MTech, candidates have to qualify for JEE Main and GATE, respectively. Whereas, as per the MMMUT admission process, valid CUET UG & CUET PG scores are required to get admission to UG & PG courses. Further, a common MMMUT counselling process is conducted in online mode for the final seat allotment. Read more about MMMUT admission in the following article.

MMMUT offers full-time UG & PG courses. For admission to any of the courses, it's mandatory to fulfil MMMUT eligibility criteria along with the selection criteria for the respective courses. Candidates can also apply for the second year of BTech and BPharm via valid CUET UG scores. Admission to all courses at MMMUT is done through scores of national-level entrance exams. Further, PhD course is offered in both full-time and part-time modes. The university conducts an in-house entrance exam to admit eligible candidates for PhD. Find below the course-wiseMadan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology courseadmissions 2025:
BTech & BTech (Lateral Entry)
Class 12 pass in PCM stream with 60% aggregate
JEE Main& CUET (for BTech Lateral Entry)
Class 12 pass in PCM or PCB stream with 55% aggregate
Class 12 pass in any discipline with 55% aggregate
Bachelor’s degree in relevant Science stream with 50% aggregate
Bachelor’s degree with 50% aggregate
Bachelor’s degree with 50% aggregate
BTech in relevant discipline with first division marks
Bachelor's and Master’s degree in Engineering/ Technology/ Science/ Management or equivalent in the relevant discipline
Note:A 5% relaxation in marks is given to the reserved category students.

MMMUT seats may vary for all UG & PG courses. The highest number of seats are available for BTech and the lowest number of seats are available for MBA and MCA. Further, the MMMUT fees include various components such as Tuition Fees, Registration Fees, Hostel Charges, Examination Fees, etc. Candidates can check out the courses-wise MMMUT fees and seats for all courses:
MMMUT admission process consists of multiple rounds, which is inclusive of applying for the course, appearing for the entrance exam, counselling registration and more. Candidates
Step 1: MMMUT Application Process 2025

For admission to MMMUT Gorakhpur, candidates must visit the official website of the respective entrance exams and apply for the same along with paying the application fee. Candidates can apply for their desired course and appear for the exam.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

MMMUT admissions are entirely entrance-based. Admission to all UG & PG courses, except BTech and MTech is done through a valid CUET UG & CUET PG entrance exam scores, respectively. Further, candidates seeking admission to BTech and MTech are done based on scores of JEE Main and GATE exams. The university conducts MET exam for the selection of eligible candidates for PhD courses.
Step 3: Counselling Registration

After the declaration of the final results of the respective entrance exams, candidates have to apply for on online counselling process on the MMMUT's official website. Aspirants have to submit their entrance exam scores, lock in their course choice and pay the registration amount of INR 2,500.
Step 4: Seat Allotment and Document Verification

The university will allocate seats to candidates through an online counselling process. If seats remain vacant, the university release conducts spot counselling to fill the remaining seats. At last, the selected candidates have to submit their documents online for verification.

faqs.question: Can I join MMMUT Gorakhpur directly?
faqs.answer: No, direct admission in MMMUT is not possible. This autonomous university give admission on the basis of scores obtained in entrance examinations. All the seats of B.Tech is filled on the basis of JEE Main score, for BBA and B.Pharm you have to qualify CUET UG, to get admission in all the PG courses except M.Tech you should qualify CUET PG, and for M.Tech, admissions are given on the basis of GATE or Malaviya Entrance Test (MET) score. After entrance examination subsequent rounds of online counselling is done so as to get branch accordingly your rank secured . According to the rank obtained by the student, the seat is allotted without any biasing. Thus, you have to work hard to get into MMMUT Gorakhpur.

faqs.question: Are admissions at MMMUT Gorakhpur entrance-based or merit-based?
faqs.answer: Admissions at MMMUT Gorakhpur are completely entrance-based. You have to give entrance exam to get admission in any course offered by the college. All the seats of B.Tech is filled on the basis of JEE Main score, for BBA and B.Pharm you have to qualify CUET UG, to get admission in all the PG courses except M.Tech you should qualify CUET PG, and for M.Tech, admissions are given on the basis of GATE or Malaviya Entrance Test (MET) score. After entrance examination subsequent rounds of online counselling is done so as to get branch accordingly your rank secured . According to the rank obtained by the student, the seat is allotted without any biasing. Thus, you have to work hard to get into MMMUT Gorakhpur.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good and underrated college of UP, and it is the best college of UP with NIRF ranking of 60.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities and infrastructure are here a good Wi-Fi network, excellent labs, a good classroom, and one of the essential things, a good and big library. Food is best in my hostel mess. An ambulance and a doctor's facility are provided. All sports and game areas are there.

reviews.review_heading: Balanced academics and extracurricular opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The course infrastructure includes Wi-Fi, a proper computer lab, an AI/ml lab, a Chemistry lab, a Physics research lab, spacious classrooms with a smart board, and a well-stocked library for study and research. Hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms, though the mess food quality varies. Medical support is available on campus, and sports grounds for cricket and football, volleyball, along with games keep student life active.

reviews.review_heading: Tier 3 college-wise, it is good and improving.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the CSE department is good. The hostels are average, but they are big in size and contain a ground in between. Wi-Fi is provided both in the department and the hostel. Classrooms are better and newly made with air conditioning. The library has a vast collection of books, but it's not 24/7. The mess food provided is average. The mess fees are Rs. 18,000 for six months, and the hostel fees are Rs. 30,000 per year. There is a medical facility, but they don't have many medicine...

reviews.review_heading: Huge campus, rude faculty, average placements.
reviews.review_text: Well, in the starting phase, every first-year student lives under restrictions for three months, which means you cannot go outside on your own. Each student has to form a line, go to class, and return to the hostel after class, that’s all. It is very irritating. The food is pretty decent, so you can manage. Medical facilities are available, as a dispensary is there, and sports facilities are also available. Hostel rooms are about 4 persons in 1 room, plus bathrooms are clean, 4 times meal in a day. reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were good. Wi-Fi facilities were available in the whole campus building. reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with my college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are decent. Rooms are comfortable, and the environment is good for studying. The mess food is average, some days good, and some days just manageable, but overall okay for students. The campus also has sports grounds, a gym, a health centre, and a decent canteen. The hostel area feels safe and has all the basic facilities like water, electricity backup, and common rooms. The campus and hostel experience is pretty good and student-friendly. The infrastructure for Civil Engineerin...

reviews.review_heading: MMMUT Information Technology review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is getting updated every year. There is Wi-Fi available in the whole campus, including the hostels. The labs are also updated. There are the best PC processors established in the ITCA lab. The hostel is also well & good. The mess is run by the students themselves. The hostel mess is also good. There are restrictions for first-year students. There is also a medical facility available in the college itself.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MMMUT Gorakhpur.
reviews.review_text: It is average, not the most luxurious and modern. Wi-Fi is available everywhere. The library is also good. Regarding the hostel facility, it is not so perfect. The mess food menu is decided by the student group itself. For games and sports, a proper student club is available that organizes events in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty and college life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available 24 hours. Classrooms are all smart and air-conditioned. The library is one of the top libraries. Hostel rooms are quite good. The mess is average, but the variety is more, and facilities are great. A canteen is also available 24 hours if you are craving food.

reviews.review_heading: Average placement in CSE.
reviews.review_text: College is old-fashioned with need of developed infrastructure. Provides Wi-Fi facility, 2 libraries & classrooms are air-conditioned. Few labs are working. Hostel needs renovation. Mess food is average. Medical facility is provided & sports facility too.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Madan Mohan Malviya University of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very poor, only the main auditorium is well maintained. Otherwise main academic building and hostel all are not that much good.

reviews.review_heading: Quite a satisfactory college.
reviews.review_text: The college was established in 1962, and it needed renovation in some parts. The lecture halls for 1st year students are quite good and air-conditioned. College provides the facility of library and internet. Hostel provides good food and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: You will find very supportive seniors here who are ready to help you every step.
reviews.review_text: Talking about infrastructure, infrastructure is very average. If we talk about hostel, first year girls are very good compared to the other hostels. All other hostels including boys and girls have decent infrastructure. Wi-Fi facilities are available in every hostel.

reviews.review_heading: MMMUT electrical engineering review.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of this college is good. The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled. The labs are also updated. The classrooms have smart board now. This college has dedicated library with a lot of books and capacity. Many students are studying daily. Infrastructure is also developing day-by-day. The hostel is also now developed. The first year hostels have done renovation work recently. The food quality is also awesome. The hostel mess is handled by the students.

college_info.intro:
IIST Trivandrum comprises 7 departments, including the Department of Aerospace Engineering, the Department of Avionics, and the Department of Physics, among others. Through its departments, IIST offers various UG, PG, and PhD courses.
The BTech and MTech programmes offered at IIST are very popular among the students. IIST Trivandrum offers two, four-year BTech programmes: Aerospace Engineering, and Electronics & Communication Engineering. Apart from this, IIST offers postgraduate programmes in fifteen areas of space science, space engineering and others. The popularity of these programmes is attributed to their curriculum which has been developed and upgraded to enhance the knowledge of students in various branches of space engineering and technology. IIST also provides its students with the opportunity to work extensively in specialised areas of research in collaboration with different ISRO centres.

The ISRO interview is generally taken during the 6th semester, in which students must have a CGPA of 7 on a scale of 10. Other than ISRO, other core and non-core companies also visit.
content.Infrastructure: Since the college started in 2007, hostels have been pretty new and always clean. Since it's not a very populated college, you will always find it calm and peaceful here. In the first year, one has to share a room with 2 other batchmates, which turns into 2 people per room from the 2nd year onwards.

The institution also accepts national-level entrance exams likeJEE Main, JEE Advanced, GATE, etc.IIST offers undergraduate, postgraduate, PhD, and dual degree programmes under seven departments Aerospace Engineering, Avionics, Chemistry, Earth & Space Sciences, Humanities, Mathematics, and Physics. IIST admission process 2025 is a step by step process, which candidates must complete to get admitted to their desired course. The admission process commences with the release of the application form and concludes with seat allotment. The IIST admission process can differ from course to course. Candidates are advised to carefully check the course-specific selection procedure. Check below the step-wise IIST admission process:
Step 1: IIST Online Application Process 2025

The application process for IIST is completely online for all the courses. Before applying, aspirants must check the required qualifications for admission to the desired course. Eligible students can visit the IIST official website (http://admission.iist.ac.in)to fill out the application form. Candidates must pay the application fee for each course (the fees vary by category).
Step 2: IIST Selection

IIST prepares an admission rank list for candidates who have successfully registered and paid the application fees. The list is prepared based on the candidate's performance in the qualifying exam. In the case of the BTech programme, the list is prepared based on JEE (Advanced) Examination subject to satisfying the minimum marks prescribed as per the institution's admission body. For PG course, candidates with a valid GATE score and marks obtained in written tests/interviews are selected for admission. Candidates with their name in the admission rank list are required to fill in their choice of branch in order of preference for the UG and Dual Degree Programmes during the time of registration.
Step 3: IIST Seat allotment and Acceptance round

The institute released the seat allotment/ acceptance rounds on the website. Seat allocations are done based on merit as per the preferences filled in by the candidates. Candidates must accept the seat by paying the first-semester fee. Once the fee is paid, candidates must upload all the required documents.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied if you like the subject with really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: College is one of the best in student-faculty ratio at 7:1 and the space lab constitutes students to do projects with the guidance of professors without any restriction of CGPA scored. The hostels are spacious enough for one and the food is obviously like any college food that will be average .

reviews.review_heading: Best placements for 2025 .
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi service is available in all hostels with centralized AC classrooms. There are various sports facilities like badminton, cricket, football, squash, table tennis, chess, carrom, basketball, volleyball, etc. available. There is also a gym with various equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied and happy.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, classrooms, and library are all good and present and are really at the top. The library is state of the art, only needing some power backup. Hostel quality is good but very far from the city. The mess food is good and can’t be complained about. They also keep changing the menu regularly.

reviews.review_heading: IIST - Unique or just another IIT?
reviews.review_text: Since the college started in 2007, hostels have been pretty new and always clean. Since it's not a very populated college, you will always find it calm and peaceful here. In the first year, one has to share a room with 2 other batchmates, which turns into 2 people per room from the 2nd year onwards.

reviews.review_heading: A good institute for study and research.
reviews.review_text:
1. The infrastructure is really good; the college was set up in 2007, so you can imagine how new the department buildings are:
2. Personally, I am amazed after seeing the lab facilities in IIST. There are more than 30 labs in IIST that are well-functioning. You will find one or two Ph.D. students working in the labs always. (for example, we have a space lab in our college. I personally visited that lab and did some work also. 
3. Talking about other facilities, classrooms are very nice (having A...

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college in terms of education.
reviews.review_text: Apart from sports facilities, all facilities are available like labs, classrooms, a library, etc. The hostel facilities are good. The quality of the food is good. The taste is not good. I don't know what the staff says. It's South Indian food. I am a South Indian but I don't like the food. Medical facilities are good. There is only one small canteen in the entire campus. It is open only from 8 AM - 11 PM. It is difficult to find a canteen facility during exam time, so we need a night canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good for students who have an interest in space science.
reviews.review_text: If students want to work in labs, this place is a heaven. Hostels aren't top-notch but they are better than NITs. Wi-Fi has restrictions for games and some websites like other institutes. The mess is not good. It does not provide good food like other colleges.

reviews.review_heading: Learning and enduring platform.
reviews.review_text: The department is huge. We have various types of labs for experiments and research. We have a library and the hostel also provides us with basic amenities. The medical care and help are also available. The food is hygienic and taste may depend upon individual choices.

reviews.review_heading: A hidden gem of a college (better than new IITs).
reviews.review_text: Excellent course infrastructure; the library is very huge with a large collection of books; 24hr 5G Wi-Fi for students; quality of food is average, but there are various food joints nearby, so that is not a big issue. Sports facilities are also good and improving every day, as now the B.Tech students will have credit for sports too.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIST - Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are newly built, and they are well managed. The warden is a painter. IIST is very strict on rules. Washing machines are not available; you will have to pool your money and buy one yourself, and the cleanliness could be better. The course is good.

reviews.review_heading: Everyday starts with excitement and ends with new learnings.
reviews.review_text: Basically, it’s a superb environment with all the necessities. Through various extracurricular activities, they pave the way for our development. Because of them, we are able to showcase our skills like leadership, passion, and empathy. This environment makes us feel our social responsibilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good beginning for a new life.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a very good environment. In our library, we have 5-6 copies of books for an individual book.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty, good placements, and really good infrastructure and facilitie
reviews.review_text: Faculty members come from all over India and have post-doctoral degrees in their specific fields. Many have been educated at Ivy League colleges. Classrooms are air-conditioned, and Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. The library is excellent, fully air-conditioned with six floors, and includes educational books, scientific papers, and novels. Hostels are also good and clean, though they lack AC and have common washrooms. Food at the mess is varied—some is good, some not so much.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with academics, sports and extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi's are sometimes unstable but yes, they are efficient. You do not get Wi-Fi or any Internet in your classrooms, of course. There's a 5-story library and more than 35,000+ books there, mostly related to space and the course. There's not much in the literature section. The food is hygienic but not tasty enough but yes, you won't get sick. Sports are evolving there.

reviews.review_heading: IIST review: good infra, facilities and placements but lack of extra curriculars.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms and labs at IIST are fully furnished, with air conditioning available in most labs and some classes. The Wi-Fi facilities are available all over the campus. Our campus contains free medical facilities, indoor and outdoor sports, a gym, and other amenities. The sports facilities are not great, but we have a wide range of sports activities, including outdoor sports like cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, and basketball, as well as indoor games like chess, carrom, table tennis...

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is fine, placements are good. Campus life is decent.

content.Placements: Placement season is all around, and most of the seniors I know have been placed at the start of their final year. Top recruiting companies are often Goldman Sachs, and there are also second years who got internships this year. Some were doing GSoC. Since the beginning, there have been three major domains that one can go for: app development, web development, and AI/ML. App development has a somewhat lesser environment here, as most want to do either web development or AI/ML. Though there are students who are quite passionate about app development.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied with the infrastructure, the faculty is good, but 75% attendance is mandatory.

content.Placements: In the Computer Science branch of MNNIT, around 96 percent of eligible students got placed. The highest package offered is 72 LPA while the average package is 27 LPA. The lowest package is around 4.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, and Amazon. 20-30 percent of students got internships in their pre-final year. Top roles are offered, including software developers, full-stack developers, data analysts, etc. Overall, good placement opportunities in MNNIT as in CSE.
content.Infrastructure: Decent infrastructure of classrooms and labs, including a good LAN connection in labs. Well-maintained library with over a thousand books for the course and other interests. The hostel for the first year is decent, LAN connections are available in all rooms. Only the vegetarian mess is present in the hostel, providing decent food. One canteen is in the hostel which is open late at night, and one stationery shop is also in the hostel.

paragraphs: MNNIT Allahabad has released the placememt details for its BTech, MTeh, MBA and MSc batch passed out in 2025. reviews.review_heading: College is fine, placements are good. Campus life is decent.
reviews.review_text: The library is fine. It has a lot of books and online resources. The hostel for first years is also good. Don't believe people who want to be relatable. Hostel food and facilities are quite nice, the food is fine, and there are three food outlets on campus. The mess is pure veg, so it's a good option for those who don't want non-veg. Medical facilities are also good. There is an on-campus ambulance, and they also take us to hospitals outside, even at night, and medicines are free from the dispen...

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the infrastructure, the faculty is good, but 75% attendance is mandatory.
reviews.review_text: Decent infrastructure of classrooms and labs, including a good LAN connection in labs. Well-maintained library with over a thousand books for the course and other interests. The hostel for the first year is decent, LAN connections are available in all rooms. Only the vegetarian mess is present in the hostel, providing decent food. One canteen is in the hostel which is open late at night, and one stationery shop is also in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is very good. There are a lot of labs available for civil engineering students. Hostels are provided with free Wi-Fi. A dispensary is available for medical emergencies. The quality of the mess food may be of decent quality.

reviews.review_heading: Best placements. Average infrastructure. Average sports facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite average if I compare this college to other colleges like NIT Jaipur. 1st year and 4th year hostels are good, but 2nd and 3rd year hostels have small rooms. Mess food is average. The internet connection is not good enough to play games unless you have 5G.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placement, good infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is really good. There are a lot of labs available for civil engineering students. Hostels are provided with free Wi-Fi. A dispensary is available for medical emergencies. The quality of mess food may be of decent quality.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is very good. There are a lot of labs available for civil engineering students. Hostels are provided with free Wi-Fi. A dispensary is available for medical emergencies. The quality of the mess food may be of decent quality.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements. Good coding culture. Enough facilities to grant you a good college life.
reviews.review_text: Almost all the classes are AC equipped. The library is of considerable size. College Wi-Fi gives about average speed. Lunch and dinner are just average, but breakfast is good. The canteen contains all the essential items. The college has many clubs for sports. Overall, 1st-year hostels are good, but 2nd- and 3rd-year hostels are not up to the mark.

reviews.review_heading: College is decent. Placement-wise, very good, but campus life is not so good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college, Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology, is, I say at weaker side, campus is not a big building, the classes are very old and boring, and the hostel facility is not good. First and last year hostels are good, but the second or third are very bad.

reviews.review_heading: It's good. At the start, it could be humbling.
reviews.review_text: CSE labs are good, though in our labs, many equipments does not work. 4-5 people's group perform a single experiment, it's miserable, even classrooms of the core department other than electrical have some miserable classrooms, sometimes rain water pour through their ceilings.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, college is good in placement, faculty, course structure, and strict in rules.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good but not that much decent like other NITs, all the facilities are available like Wi-Fi, LAN, classrooms, and library which are fine but 2nd and 3rd year. Hostels are not that good but the facilities in hostels are fine. Mess food is also good, fully vegetarian, only eggs are available in the canteen. Medical facilities are also fine, an ambulance is available 24 hours, and the college dispensary is open from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. There are so many sports and club societies in...

reviews.review_heading: The college is good in terms of software placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very old, and the campus area is small. Most of the campus area is allotted to faculty and girls where boys are not allowed so campus infrastructure is poor, and the maintenance hostel is average but the mess is below average. Labs and classrooms are old-fashioned.

reviews.review_heading: Brilliant placement college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is poor and dull with a very small campus. Very small for boys half of what it is, old buildings. The library is good, Wi-Fi is available in academic buildings, labs are well connected with the network, and proper enabled PC. Mess food is bad, canteen is good, and it offers a variety of food. Sports facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Inside details of MNNIT Allahabad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent, not very Hi-Fi and not very bad as well. The hostel for first-year and final-year boys are the best. The grounds are good, 2 badminton courts in the first year boys hostel (SVBH), and a table tennis room on every floor. The mess food is not very good. You have to manage. LAN connections are provided in each room so no problem. Classrooms are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of the placement only of the MNNIT brand only.
reviews.review_text: Poor facilities and not-so-good infrastructure. Wi-Fi is available in the library, the computer centre is fully centralized, and classrooms are currently under construction. The facilities are not so good, the mess food is average, and the canteen is not so well in the hostels. College medical facilities are also poor, with limited sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Top college with a great return on investment.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have decent facilities with some of them being air-conditioned. The library has a wide variety of books and good Wi-Fi, the hostel rooms and mess are usually clean and the food is usually alright. Sports and games facilities are alright. The canteen has a good variety of foods.
