review_summary.college_name: IIIT Delhi Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Design - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Actually pretty good in the recent times.

content.Placements: Approximately 70 percent of the people who sit in the placement grounds from my branch get placed. The highest package is around 36 LPA, with the average being around 20 LPA. Top recruiters are ICICI, Adobe, Siemens. Around 60 percent of students get an internship in MNCs.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi coverage across campus, all classrooms are air-conditioned or cheated. Library has areas for group studies, discussions, or self-study. It is also stocked with books and provides Kindles to borrow. Food quality is above average, menu in the mess keeps changing every few months. The canteen is 24/7 with decent food. Small cafes and kiosks are placed throughout the campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Applied Mathematics - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great campus, strong academics.

content.Placements: 96% of students who got a CGPA of more than 6 were placed with the highest of 50 LPA and the lowest of 6 LPA from top recruiting companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Natwest, Meesho, etc. Around 20% of students got paid internships with good stipends. The teaching staff is good, with proper teaching assistants. I hope you find that review useful.
content.Infrastructure: IIIT Delhi has Wi-Fi, modern classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a rich digital library. Hostels are clean and comfortable with proper connectivity. The mess and canteen provide good food. The campus has reliable medical care and proper sports facilities with proper equipment.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and VLSI Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Excellent faculty, good infrastructure and facilities, placement is also good, and the campus.

content.Placements: Placement is good. B.Tech Eve, being a new course, no batch has passed yet, so placement hasn't taken place for this course. Qualcomm, Western Digital, Nvidia, and Texas Instruments are some of the companies that come for placement for the ECE branch. It is also very easy to get software roles.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Although the campus is small, the facilities provided are very good. Wi-Fi coverage is in every building. There are labs with up-to-date equipment, a clean campus, classrooms of all sizes, etc. We also have a library building, which is very good in terms of the books available. Mess facilities are available for everyone, and the food is of good quality. There is also a sports complex.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College curriculum is tough with high fees, but high placement and great faculty members.

content.Placements: Placement record of last year's batch was somewhat around 80 to 85%. This ratio varies among different branches. The minimum, according to my knowledge is 3.5 LPA, and the highest is somewhat around 1.2 crore. Approximately all the MNCs (Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Qualcomm, Nvidia) visit our campus to recruit students. Around 80% of students get placed among the shortlisted students (shortlist based on CGPA above 7).
content.Infrastructure: All day high-speed network is available on the campus. We have top-class infrastructure with modern facilities, all-time medical support, hostels are too good, having an AC in all the rooms, quality of food is not that much better but eatable, sports and gym open 24X7, and students can roam around the campus anytime, no restriction like other colleges have.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Best placements and good infrastructure, but academic life is stressful.

content.Placements: Placement is not good initially. But later on, almost 300+ students get placed out of 500, with an average package of 24 LPA, showing strong and well opportunities for future and development. If you're looking for the most advanced tech curriculum, this is the place.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is top-notch.
content.Faculty: Faculty is internationally graduated and is some of the best I could study with. However, some professors do not have the best teaching methods. Teaching and knowledge are two different things, but the professors never get stuck on the questions I ask. Faculty is supportive, and exams are a bit trickier than I expected, but this prepares us for the best. The course gets hectic, and academics are challenging. Every other day there are tutorials and quizzes that carry a lot of weight. Attendance is not mandatory, but if you don't attend classes, even YouTube can't save you.

After the application process, the institute releases a course-wise cutoff list. The cutoff list indicates the minimum required score in the respective entrance exam for a candidate to become eligible for admission. Candidates with a score equal to or more than the cutoff marks can apply.
3. Counselling

paragraphs: IIIT Delhi placement report 2025 has been released. The highest international package offered in 2025 stood at INR 99.28 LPA and the highest domestic package offered was INR 51.31 LPA . The average and the median packages offered are INR 19.51 LPA and INR 17 LPA , respectively. In total, 176 recruiters participated during the IITD placement drive and made 763 job offers in 2025. This season achieved a remarkable placement rate of 88.45% . Notable recruiters include- Myntra, Goldman Sachs, DE Shaw and Co and many more that took part during the IIIT Delhi placements 2025.

Earlier, the highest domestic and international package offered during IIIT Delhi placements 2024 stood at INR 49 LPA and INR 109 LPA , respectively. In addition, the average package offered during IIITD placements 2024 was INR 20.65 LPA . Further, a total of 719 offers were made out of which 12 were international offers and the placement rate recorded during IIIT Delhi placement 2024 was 90.99%. Leading recruiters such as Google, Amazon and Microsoft visited the campus in recent past during IIIT Delhi placements 2025.

reviews.review_heading: Actually pretty good in the recent times.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi coverage across campus, all classrooms are air-conditioned or cheated. Library has areas for group studies, discussions, or self-study. It is also stocked with books and provides Kindles to borrow. Food quality is above average, menu in the mess keeps changing every few months. The canteen is 24/7 with decent food. Small cafes and kiosks are placed throughout the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus, strong academics.
reviews.review_text: IIIT Delhi has Wi-Fi, modern classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a rich digital library. Hostels are clean and comfortable with proper connectivity. The mess and canteen provide good food. The campus has reliable medical care and proper sports facilities with proper equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent faculty, good infrastructure and facilities, placement is also good, and the campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Although the campus is small, the facilities provided are very good. Wi-Fi coverage is in every building. There are labs with up-to-date equipment, a clean campus, classrooms of all sizes, etc. We also have a library building, which is very good in terms of the books available. Mess facilities are available for everyone, and the food is of good quality. There is also a sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: College curriculum is tough with high fees, but high placement and great faculty members.
reviews.review_text: All day high-speed network is available on the campus. We have top-class infrastructure with modern facilities, all-time medical support, hostels are too good, having an AC in all the rooms, quality of food is not that much better but eatable, sports and gym open 24X7, and students can roam around the campus anytime, no restriction like other colleges have.

reviews.review_heading: Best placements and good infrastructure, but academic life is stressful.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-notch.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college because of its placement records and excellent college life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great, with good Wi-Fi speed in almost every part of the college. The library is open 24/7, even at night, so that students can study, and the canteen is also open 24/7. There is great nightlife in the college with no restrictions for anyone. Hostels are great too, with proper cleanliness. The mess food is also good. Hostels are much better than those in IITs. Sports facilities are also great and are open 24/7, with a gym and an indoor swimming pool.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Every facility is available, whether it’s Wi-Fi, all kinds of labs, research labs, library, 300-500 seater classrooms. The quality of the food is good. Medical facilities are available 24/7. The sports center is open 24/7, with a swimming pool, table tennis, volleyball court, badminton court, basketball court, football and cricket shared ground, cricket nets, lawn tennis court, squash, billiards, pool table, chess, air hockey, and many more. The hostel infrastructure is really good, with AC room...

reviews.review_heading: IIITD: Great for R&D, tough workload, beautiful campus, good crowd.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi speed is excellent throughout the campus. Labs and libraries are all equipped with Lenovo computer systems. Classrooms are also well-maintained. The hostels are very nice, and the food is good; we are provided breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks in the evening.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIIT Delhi - A good and bad college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very modern and great. It is a recently built college and the infrastructure is very great and better when compared to other Delhi Colleges. Hostels are also very nice and modernly built. Only problem is that the AC only runs from 7 to 7 in the hostels which makes it difficult to survive in very hot weather.

reviews.review_heading: Hectic routine placements are going down, but it's best for research people.
reviews.review_text: Labs and all the needed things for the course are top-notch, and the Hostel and food quality are really good. You can completely depend on them. Sports Block has everything you would want, and they also have a good medical center, so no worries.

reviews.review_heading: It has an amazing campus life. There is no amazing course curriculum.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are top. There are no limitations on time. We can go out whenever we want and we just need to do entry and exists. Sports facilities are available 24 hours. The canteen is open 24 hours along with one Nescafe both of which are open 24 hours which is near hostels. Hostels are comfortable with good Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with college. Placements and campus life are good, overall, it is worth the money.
reviews.review_text: Labs and classrooms are better than those in most colleges since they are new. The entire campus is equipped with Wi-Fi facility. Mess food is decent and better than that of other NITs or DTU. The library has three floors with different study rooms. Sports and games facilities are not very good. Hostels are the best.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college with a lavish campus and excellent placements, but with extra academic loads.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great as it was established in 2008. The new and developed buildings are there. Wi-Fi is available in every corner of the campus and is different for mobiles and laptops. Labs and classrooms are well maintained, while the library has access to every type of book in every genres, whether academic or non-academic. The hostel facilities are also very good.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is excellent, placements are relatively good, and the faculty is incredible.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent, with various types of niche laboratories equipped with sophisticated instruments that are easily accessible to students. As for hostels, the food is certainly above average, hygiene is acceptable, the taste is okay, and the variety is great and highly cost-effective. The canteen also serves reasonably priced food. Medical facilities are adequate and available whenever required. The sports and games facilities are amazing; there is a dedicated sports block with al...

reviews.review_heading: This is one of the best college in India.
reviews.review_text: The campus provides 24/7 lab facilities. The hostel has no restrictions, and the infrastructure is excellent. All necessary amenities are available, including a gym, swimming pool, playground, basketball court, football court, cricket ground, labs, library, music rooms, dance room, and yoga room, all within the campus.

paragraphs: IIIT Delhi scholarships are provided under various criteria for the UG and PG level students. The scholarship amount or percentage differs according to the income of the parents.
Chairman’s Merit Scholarship for top BTech aspirants, admitted through JAC Counselling:

Any Delhi student with a JEE Main rank of less than 2,000, seeking admission at IIIT Delhi through JAC Counselling is entitled to a scholarship of Rs 1.25 LPA for four years, provided that the student maintains a CGPA of 8.5 or above. These students are not eligible for the income-linked fee waiver scheme of the scholarships.
Income-Linked Fee Waiver Scholarship:
Students pursuing any degree from IIIT Delhi are entitled to this scholarship based on following eligibility parameters:
Parents of the wards come under Below Poverty Line (BPL) category
The gross income of parents in service is up to Rs 6 LPA and the last school fee paid is less than Rs 25,000 per year
The gross income of parents in service is between Rs 6 LPA-Rs 8 LPA and the last school fee paid is less than Rs 45,000 per year

admission_overview.college_name: IIT Palakkad Admission 2025: Cutoff, Fees, Eligibility & Selection

paragraphs: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Palakkad admission 2025 is entrance-based for all the courses. The IIT Palakkad offers a list of courses at the undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral levels. The flagship programme ofIIT Palakkadis BTech which is offered in various specialisations. Admission to Bachelor of Technology (BTech) is granted on the basis of JEE Advanced followed by JoSAA counselling. Furthermore, MTech, MSc and other programmes are offered by the Indian Institute of Technology Palakkad through the GATE and IIT JAM scores. The seat allotment for BTech, MTech, and MSc courses is carried out through respective counselling bodies. Additionally, IIT Palakkad also offers PG Certificate courses in Cloud Computing and Cyber Security.
Before applying to a course, the aspirant must carefully check the eligibility requirements.

IIT Palakkad course admission begins with the application process of the accepted entrance exams. BTech is the flagship course of this institute. IIT Palakkad admission criteria differ from one course to another. Eligible aspirants can check out the below table for IIT Palakkad admission highlights 2025:

IIT Palakkad Admission 2025: Eligibility and Selection Criteria

For BTech admission, IIT Palakkad accepts JEE Main and JEE Advanced entrance exam scores, followed by a JoSAA counselling round. Similarly, admission to IIT Delhi MTech and MSc courses is GATE and IIT JAM based, followed by COAP and CCMN counselling, respectively. Registration is open for Master of Science (MSc) admission. IIT Palakkad admission procedure varies as per the courses candidates wish to pursue. However, the qualifying eligibility criteria as per the IIT Palakkad's admission guidelines are equivalent for all the courses. The IIT Palakkad admission process consists of multiple steps which are as follows:
Step 1: IIT Palakkad Application Process

IIT Palakkad conducts the application process for admission to its offered courses. However, for a few courses, candidates are required to complete the entrance exam's registration/application process.
Step 2: IIT Palakkad Selection Process

Candidates are shortlisted based on their qualifications. Next candidates are required to go through the selection process which requires candidates to to go through the course-based entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After the selection rounds are completed, they are required to go through the course-wise counselling process for final seat allocation. For PhD and MS, IIT Palakkad conducts its own written test and personal interview for selection.
Step 3: IIT Palakkad seat allocation

Seat allocation for BTech is conducted by the JoSAA (Joint Seat Allocation Authority) counseling plays a crucial role in the final selection process, as it facilitates the allocation of seats in the BTech programme at IIT Palakkad. For MTech candidates must participate in the GATE counselling for seat allocation. And for MSc JAM counselling is accepted.
Step 4: IIT Palakkad Final Admission

Once the seats are allocated, applicants who are selected can submit the admission charges and confirm their admission to the relevant course at IIT Bombay. Candidates might have to visit the institute's admission office to verify the documents.

placement_data.title: IIT Palakkad Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The placements are ongoing for the Class of 2025. IIT Palakkad has achieved 86.67% placements for its BTech batch 2025 so far. The average package secured by the students of the BTech batch 2025 stood at INR 13.98 LPA. The CSE students secured the average package INR 17.45 LPA . The students secured 20 PPOs and 38 offers with the CTC of INR 15 LPA and above. The top recruiters of IIT Palakkad in 2025 include Mahindra Finance, TCS, Infosys, Alpha Wave Semi, AMD, Analyzer CAE Solutions, etc.

Earlier, the institute has recorded 74.15% placements for the overall Class of 2024. A total of 205 students of the batch 2024 registered, of which and 152 students were placed during IIT Palakkad placements 2024. The overall highest and average package grabbed by IIT Palakkad students of the batch 2024 was INR 47.12 LPA and INR 13.82 LPA , respectively.

The highest package offered to CSE, Electrical, Mechanical and Civil students in 2024 was INR 41.61 LPA, INR 36.72 LPA and INR 20 LPA. Placement rate for these branches was 93.02%, 69.44%, 80% and 84.21%.

reviews.review_heading: Masters course in the department of Physics.
reviews.review_text: The specialized equipment and apparatus required for laboratories are maintained in proper conditions to provide accurate results during experimentation. For master's courses in all the departments, only 40 seats are available. Seats are provided on a first-come, first-served basis.

reviews.review_heading: Not able to tolerate the professors activities.
reviews.review_text: College officials provide seats to the students based on both direct admission and merit admission. All their activities were officially published on their official website, keeping them updated on the social platform. The Institute had consistently been a part of preparing young talent for the nation.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are too good. Campus is spread across 504 acres, which is near the Western Ghats. Wi-Fi and classrooms are best. In every class, projector is available, and well-stocked library is present on campus. Food quality is good, and separate hostels are available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best institute for the B.Tech in Electrical Engineering course.
reviews.review_text: It's nice that each branch has its own building and labs. The college and hostels offer Wi-Fi. The digital screens are installed in the projector classrooms. The college contains a cricket pitch, followed by a badminton pitch and a basketball court. On campus, you can play indoor games like TT, chess, carrom, and more.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best Institute for a Ph.D. in Chemistry course.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a library, and sports facilities are all available on campus, which is excellent. The food in the college canteen is good, and the hostels are very nice. I didn't face any infrastructure issues during my time. There is also a free clinic for students in need, and we have a very good library.

reviews.review_heading: Master's studies in my native place.
reviews.review_text: It's a campus where even the unknown strangers immediately help us when we reach out to them. It's a cool, hill hostel with fewer conditions, but it's mandatory to fill out the hostel records while living and entering the hostel zones. Transport facilities are available for good safety purposes.

reviews.review_heading: Maximum companies would be the core companies.
reviews.review_text: Possibilities for exploring industrial visits, and tours are very less but students are allowed for such activities at least once a year. Immediate suspension is raised from the side of college management if we are involved in any unnecessary activities. Food shortages often occur in the canteen zones.

reviews.review_heading: Phenomenal college with good values.
reviews.review_text: It is a little far from the college. But I chose to reside in the college hostel. Hostel food is okay, but I crave my home food. So I left the college every weekend, and it required a lot of approval. It is a phenomenal college with good moral values.

reviews.review_heading: The college with good recognition.
reviews.review_text: The percentage of recruitment from the computer science and engineering department is up to 75% randomly and it is the highest when compared with other courses. The type of training decided by ourselves to attend would decide the pay gained by us in the future. I chose the extreme level of training so I got a package of 13.5 LPA.

reviews.review_heading: Overall perspectives of mine.
reviews.review_text: The comprehensive course curriculum and diverse career opportunities in electronics offer students a wide range of prospects, from embedded systems, telecommunication and VLSI design. The mean package provided to the hired students would potentially between 4.3 LPA to 6.17 LPA.

reviews.review_heading: As being a fresher of IIT, Palakkad.
reviews.review_text: Our college placement team only allows students with zero backlogs for placement recruitment. While others are required to attend drives for the companies offering the lowest salary packages. Mostly top performers in academics got placed in good companies and rest of them got placed in other companies.

reviews.review_heading: Quite disappointed with the facilities.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure and facilities available for our course are average. Classrooms and labs are outdated and getting old. The hostel rooms are small and comfortable. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is hygienic. No time to play sports.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with IIT Palakkad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here was excellent and all facilities were available for students including Wi-Fi, labs, a library, sports facilities and medical services. The campus life was amazing and all necessary amenities were provided to students. The food quality in the canteen was very good with a variety of options available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of B.Tech in computer science and engineering.
reviews.review_text: Fully climate-controlled classes with comfortable seating for a limited number of students are there. Also, sitting is arranged with drawers and lockers for keeping our books and notes safe and to avoid overloading of the students. We should also be accessible to online learning platforms in case it is needed.

reviews.review_heading: I lived a manifested life at IIT Palakkad.
reviews.review_text: For every department, there were usually 8 to 10 classrooms with required features like smart boards, green boards, projectors, and laptops or computers. To protect students from health issues. A hygienic environment was maintained with clean restrooms and sanitized study areas.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Delhi Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The next top institute of India.

content.Placements: In my course, 87.6 percent of students are placed. The highest package is 67 LPA, the lowest is 8 LPA, and the average is around 18 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Nvidia, and Google. Almost 50 percent of students have internships this year. The top roles offered are SDE, Data Scientist, and Business Analyst.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are available for all students who want them. Sports facilities include a football ground, cricket ground, table tennis court, badminton court, and basketball court, along with many indoor sports. Labs are accessible with permission from the authorities. Wi-Fi is available 24/7. All classes have smart boards. The library is small but has enough books, though seating space is limited. In the hostel, a night canteen is available, and medical facilities are accessible day and night.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Perfection does not need any review of placements.

content.Placements: As you know, NIT Delhi is one of the fastest-growing NITs in India. So, as the growing speed of their placement rate is also increasing year by year across all departments. Its placement rate reached 100 percent in the last few years. In the CSE department, there is 100 percent placement rate in 2025, with 58LPA the highest and 18.27 LPA the average package.
content.Infrastructure: There is an issue for boys that their hostels are 6 km away from the college, which is why many students are not enjoying their campus life efficiently. Food quality is extraordinary. All classes have a separate Wi-Fi system and all labs have an individual system for each student.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: A brief of the NIT Delhi.

content.Placements: Almost all the ECE students are placed well in both core and technical areas. The average package is 10-12 LPA. The recruiting companies are Microsoft, Samsung, Wipro and more. Some students are placed in the same company where they intern. Many tech companies are also coming for only the CSE branch.
content.Infrastructure: The college is under construction, so sometimes it does not feel that comfortable. But the new hostel is awesome, where the LAN facilities are also available rather than Wi-Fi. The mess food is not that good. There is also a night canteen. The college provides many sports and gym facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I had two valuable years at NIT Delhi.

content.Placements: NIT Delhi has a great placement record each year. The average salary offered is one of the highest among all NITs. The highest package offered in 2024 was 62 LPA, and the lowest package was 16 LPA. The average package was 17 LPA. Companies like Adobe, Amazon, Microsoft, and Deloitte visited the college for placements.
content.Infrastructure: At NIT Delhi, construction is undergoing. It has shifted to a permanent campus, and it is a well-furnished campus. All LTs ( lecture theatres) are air-conditioned. Labs are well-equipped and have all the required equipment. Currently, there is only one hostel for boys and one for girls. The other hostel is expected to be complete by August 2025. Sports facilities are good. It has most of the sports courts and grounds.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I have to say about placements that NIT Delhi has a good record and average salary is 12.5 LPA.

content.Placements: We are the first batch in NIT Delhi in the department of mechanical engineering. We will pass out in 2026 as a student of first batch in mechanical branch. We don't have seniors to guide us for placements and others so we have to do our best by ourselves. We are the seniors but I have to say that our faculty members are too good here.
content.Infrastructure: Courses are completed at the end of the semester as we all know our college has recently shifted to the new campus at Bakoli village. So infrastructure is all new and according to the new beautiful design. All facilities are provided better than expected.

reviews.review_heading: The next top institute of India.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are available for all students who want them. Sports facilities include a football ground, cricket ground, table tennis court, badminton court, and basketball court, along with many indoor sports. Labs are accessible with permission from the authorities. Wi-Fi is available 24/7. All classes have smart boards. The library is small but has enough books, though seating space is limited. In the hostel, a night canteen is available, and medical facilities are accessible day and nigh...

reviews.review_heading: Perfection does not need any review of placements.
reviews.review_text: There is an issue for boys that their hostels are 6 km away from the college, which is why many students are not enjoying their campus life efficiently. Food quality is extraordinary. All classes have a separate Wi-Fi system and all labs have an individual system for each student.

reviews.review_heading: A brief of the NIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The college is under construction, so sometimes it does not feel that comfortable. But the new hostel is awesome, where the LAN facilities are also available rather than Wi-Fi. The mess food is not that good. There is also a night canteen. The college provides many sports and gym facilities.

reviews.review_heading: I had two valuable years at NIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: At NIT Delhi, construction is undergoing. It has shifted to a permanent campus, and it is a well-furnished campus. All LTs ( lecture theatres) are air-conditioned. Labs are well-equipped and have all the required equipment. Currently, there is only one hostel for boys and one for girls. The other hostel is expected to be complete by August 2025. Sports facilities are good. It has most of the sports courts and grounds.

reviews.review_heading: I have to say about placements that NIT Delhi has a good record and average salary is 12.5 LPA.
reviews.review_text: Courses are completed at the end of the semester as we all know our college has recently shifted to the new campus at Bakoli village. So infrastructure is all new and according to the new beautiful design. All facilities are provided better than expected.

reviews.review_heading: College life at NIT Delhi is overall a good experience.
reviews.review_text: The course infrastructure and syllabus are best. Facilities available in labs and library are also good. The food quality in the mess is good. Sports and games are also great. The mess and canteen provide food at an affordable price.

reviews.review_heading: Food in mess is bad. 5 students share a room.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi connectivity in hostel is not that fine but it sometimes fluctuates, in library or any other it's better than hostel. Classrooms are fully centralized and smart boards are available. The quality of the mess food is not good and the canteen also doesn't contain many items. Sports facilities are very good at this college. There is almost every game and there are coaches for each game.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the mess food, but absolutely good placements and a wonderful college life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college, hostel, and the course is very nice. You will be provided with well-spaced labs and very nice classrooms with AC. Wi-Fi facility is also available here, but the speed is not up to the mark. The library consists of nearly more than 20,000 books. The facilities provided in the hostel are okay, and the food quality provided by the mess has to be developed.

reviews.review_heading: Residential life of NIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The campus is still under construction, so the infrastructure of the college is not that good. But according to its model photos placed in the admin block, the college will get a brilliant look after the completion of the construction. The campus contains all the basic needs required by students, like a common room, library, sports room, health center, canteen, etc.

reviews.review_heading: College with good infrastructure but not fully constructed and dissatisfied with the hostel.
reviews.review_text: NIT Delhi got its permanent campus recently, so its infrastructure is very good but not fully constructed, with smartboards in classes, properly functioning labs, and all the necessary infrastructure and machinery provided. Moving to the hostel, it is average, not too good, and the food is just eatable.

reviews.review_heading: We have a very good placement states and college life is fun too.
reviews.review_text: Our hostels are very clean and comfortable. Each room has two attached washrooms, and the mess food is quite good. The admin block has a lot of labs and classrooms, all of which have projectors and air conditioning. We also have canteens on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. We have Wi-Fi, good clean classrooms, and a library. But the hostel is not so good; the rules are very strict. The mess food is just okay; you have to compromise here. The mess price is a bit on the higher side, but they still don't provide good quality food, so this is the major thing where you have to compromise.

reviews.review_heading: Going to become one of the top college in upcoming years.As of today it is on NIRF rank 45.
reviews.review_text:
As of 2024, the college is least developed from outside but has a very good internal infrastructure. All the labs are well equipped and the whole campus has centralized AC. The wifi is working but with decent speed. The classrooms are very good.
As of 2024, the hostels for the 1st year are away from campus and for the rest years they get hostels inside the campus. Food available in the mess is decent quality, just edible. Canteen offers some good options of snacks at a decent price.

reviews.review_heading: It is going to become one of the top colleges in upcoming years.
reviews.review_text:
As of 2024, the college is least developed from outside but has a very good internal infrastructure. All the labs are well equipped and the whole campus has centralized AC. The Wi-Fi is working but with decent speed. The classrooms are very good.
As of 2024, the hostels for the 1st year are away from campus and for the rest years, they get hostels inside the campus. The food available in the mess is decent quality, just edible. Canteen offers some good options of snacks at a decent price.

reviews.review_heading: In short, I would say if you have the opportunity to get into this college, then take it.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, although it is still under construction. There is an admin building where all offices are located, fully centralized AC, and an open ground for football and cricket, along with a basketball court, badminton court, volleyball court, lawn tennis court, and more. There are three hostels for boys and one for girls. Hostel facilities are good enough, except for the food quality, which is below average. However, the medical facilities are very good.

review_summary.college_name: SVNIT Surat Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good facilities, but average placement and facilities.

content.Placements: I would say average from the past two years. The average package in core chemical engineering is around 6-6.5 LPA, and the highest package so far in the year 2025-26 is 11 LPA. Other than core, there are chances in non-core areas like software development, data science, management, consultancy, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facility is average only. Like in the first year, you get in time and after that, there is campus time of 10:30 PM, which I personally find very restricted, and there is also food delivery not allowed till the hostel. You have to go to the main gate to collect your food delivery.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good placements in 2026 and decent infrastructure.

content.Placements: In 2026, very new and good companies come for placement and provide good packages. Mainly established private companies visit like Apple, Meesho, Cisco, Growetc, and also government companies like BHEL visit campus for recruitment. Approximately 60% of the batch gets placed.
content.Infrastructure: Decent to medium infrastructure with all basic requirements filled for the students. All department labs have their Wi-Fi setup, and classrooms have smart monitors for visualization. Now, hostels try to maintain good facilities. The mess is decent, where you can have your lunch, dinner, and breakfast.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Getting admission is completely worthwhile.

content.Placements: I am B.Tech 2nd year student in the Department of Civil Engineering at SVNIT, Surat. Placement ratio is about 57 percent. Girls placement ratio is more than the boys. Top companies include Cem India. Top roles offered by the course are construction and building management, planning etc.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel infrastructure is good enough for living with proper Wi-Fi, a hygienic environment and spacious rooms. The department has a good study environment, with a central library with a fully equipped infrastructure and books. AC are available. Spacious enough for a large crowd.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I am quite satisfied, except for the sports facilities.

content.Placements: In my course (Civil), placements are quite decent. It is around 50 to 60 percent in recent years. The highest placement is 16 LPA, and the lowest is 3.5 LPA, while the average salary is 6.8 LPA. Overall, placements are good. Larsen & Toubro (L&T), Adani Group, and Reliance Industries are among the top recruiters, but they generally don’t offer more than 8-9 LPA. Top roles include site engineer, executive engineer, and junior project manager.
content.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure of our college is above average. The CSE, Electrical, and Chemical departments have very good infrastructure, while the Mechanical department buildings and classrooms are the worst. The Civil Engineering department has good infrastructure. Wi-Fi is not available in most departments. Classes have a separate building. There are two more buildings, Civil A wing and Civil B wing. Separate drawing halls and labs are available. Hostels have good room space and facilities. Mess food varies, but overall, it is decent.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Satisfying placement with good infrastructure.

content.Placements: I am a student of Electronics and Communication Engineering department. In our batch, till now around 50-60 percent students got placed. The highest package is around 40 LPA, the lowest package is 5 LPA, and the average is around 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Apple, Meesho, Oracle, ZS Associates, and around 20-30 percent, students got internship. Roles offered are software side only like frontend developer, backend engineer, AI/ML engineer.
content.Infrastructure: All general facilities are available in our campus such as Wi-Fi, library, labs, and all are well maintained and perform satisfactorily to help a student grow in their field. Talking about hostel infrastructure, it lags in some facilities. There is no common room for study and gaming instruments depend on hostel, in some hostels there is a playing area and in some hostels there is none. The mess is well maintained, but you can't expect home-like food.

sports.description: To support the holistic development of students, SVNIT also provides infrastructure for both indoor and outdoor games. The institute has a Student Activities Centre (SAC) that manages sports, extracurricular, and co-curricular activities for students and staff. SVNIT Surat sports facilities include badminton, basketball and tennis courts, two volleyball grounds, a football ground, and a table tennis court, among others. reviews.review_heading: Good facilities, but average placement and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is average only. Like in the first year, you get in time and after that, there is campus time of 10:30 PM, which I personally find very restricted, and there is also food delivery not allowed till the hostel. You have to go to the main gate to collect your food delivery.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in 2026 and decent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Decent to medium infrastructure with all basic requirements filled for the students. All department labs have their Wi-Fi setup, and classrooms have smart monitors for visualization. Now, hostels try to maintain good facilities. The mess is decent, where you can have your lunch, dinner, and breakfast.

reviews.review_heading: Getting admission is completely worthwhile.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure is good enough for living with proper Wi-Fi, a hygienic environment and spacious rooms. The department has a good study environment, with a central library with a fully equipped infrastructure and books. AC are available. Spacious enough for a large crowd.

reviews.review_heading: I am quite satisfied, except for the sports facilities.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of our college is above average. The CSE, Electrical, and Chemical departments have very good infrastructure, while the Mechanical department buildings and classrooms are the worst. The Civil Engineering department has good infrastructure. Wi-Fi is not available in most departments. Classes have a separate building. There are two more buildings, Civil A wing and Civil B wing. Separate drawing halls and labs are available. Hostels have good room space and facilities. Me...

reviews.review_heading: Satisfying placement with good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: All general facilities are available in our campus such as Wi-Fi, library, labs, and all are well maintained and perform satisfactorily to help a student grow in their field. Talking about hostel infrastructure, it lags in some facilities. There is no common room for study and gaming instruments depend on hostel, in some hostels there is a playing area and in some hostels there is none. The mess is well maintained, but you can't expect home-like food.

reviews.review_heading: A lot of events, fests, and seminars are conducted on different topics in BHU, students can enroll.
reviews.review_text: All the departments are excellent, and many departments are undergoing major renovation. LAN is provided in all hostels and a library, overall, the infrastructure is good, and hostels are clean, but in some wings, there are issues in the bathroom areas. There are also times when the LAN does not work for 2 to 3 days, and there is also a connectivity problem in the rooms on the first floor of Gajjar Bhavan.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with placements, infrastructure, and the education course.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and course departments have no Wi-Fi. The quality of food in Mess is below average, and in some hostels it's the worst. Canteen food is roughly average. Medical facilities are not very good. Many sports and games faculty members are also lacking, like a football ground, a proper gym for everyone, badminton, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology (SVNIT) Surat has a decent campus. Most of the area is covered in greenery. A significant portion of the campus is also occupied by unused or abandoned buildings, beyond the currently usable infrastructure. The hostel conditions are better than those in some NITs but worse than others. Overall, not always up to good living standards. However, that’s part of the charm of college life. The internet connectivity is quite poor, but the labs and cla...

reviews.review_heading: It has a really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. Wi-Fi facility is available in the college. The library has a huge collection of good-quality textbooks. Sports facilities are good. The quality of the hostel is also good.

reviews.review_heading: My college is good in every manner.
reviews.review_text: Facilities were good and infrastructure was also good for my course. Classroom was not that much comfortable but other than that everything was good. Hostel quality was superb and their food was also good. Medical facilities were also available.

reviews.review_heading: SVNIT to explore better.
reviews.review_text:
Our college has good networking for the alumni association. SVNIT has 
Wi-Fi facility for the students and staffs. The institute has a central computer central center that takes care of the internet access requirement throughout the campus, including administration and academic departments, hostels, staff quarters, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Recession affects the placement of every tier of college.
reviews.review_text: For the course and department, facilities are average. There are labs and a library. There is poor connectivity in the department. In labs, systems are outdated, but we can manage it. The hostel quality depends upon which hostel is given to us.

reviews.review_heading: The college is okay. Good companies do come here and some faculty members are good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in the department are good like water facility, electricity, etc. The only thing that I didn't like was the LAN/ Wi-Fi facility because sometimes it didn't work in labs. Rest all things are good. Labs are clean. Hostel facilities are good and the mess food is also good if students are vegetarians.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good. The education level and curriculum are not good.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are the best each year, and we will get a new hostel. However, they are old really and need some construction. Mess food is bad here because it really tastes bad. There is only one canteen till now but one cafeteria is under construction which will be completed by July.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college because it is NIT.
reviews.review_text: It's an old college, so we should not keep high hopes on infrastructure and hostel. The library is new and some of the departments are being rebuilt. There is a sports complex with a gym for all. We have a tennis court, stadium and also a cricket ground with football in a single stadium.

individual_reviews.course: M.E. in Embedded and Real Time Systems - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Overall best College for M.E. In the embedded and real time systems course.

content.Placements: Almost all students were placed in our courses. The highest salary is 12 LPA to 15 LPA, which was the minimum. 90% of students received their internships. The top recruiters were Intel, Qualcomm, Robert Bosch, Texas Instruments, etc. The top roles offered were Embedded Software Engineer, Firmware Engineer, and more.
content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi system was awesome. Classrooms were good. The campus was awesome and clean. The campus had specially designed sports courts for basketball, volleyball, etc. The college system here was amazing, as here things are amazing, which helps us a lot. The college ensures cleanliness, and students also ensure that they do not have any problems inside the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good placements, campus, people, and a better you.

content.Placements: Students above 95% can easily get into our department. The highest package is 12 LPA, the average package is 6 LPA, and the lowest is 2.4 LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Amazon, and Zifo. Most of the students got their internships, around 50%, with companies like Biozeen, Biocon Ltd, AIIMS, and IGIB. The jobs are related to microbiologists, research scientists, quality control, and bioanalytical techniques.
content.Infrastructure: There is indeed a good Wi-Fi connection, library, and all, but the labs do not have advanced machines and tools. The classrooms are good enough. The hostel is good here. Based on our preference, they provide rooms with two sharing, six sharing, etc. Medical facilities are very good here. There are lots of sports and games activities available. The mess food is really good compared to any other hostels. They provide non-veg food three days a week.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.Sc. in Data Science - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: The honest review of PSG College of Technology.

content.Placements: Almost 90 percent of our seniors are placed in good companies. The highest package is 27 LPA, the lowest package is 5 LPA, and the average package is 10 LPA to 12 LPA. The companies that visited our college, that is, TCS, Microsoft, Deloitte, Amazon, Wipro, Zomato, etc. Every student got an internship. There are 2-6 months of internship provided by the placement cell, which is very helpful.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is average in my college, but there is good equipment in the labs and the library. The hostel is also average compared to other colleges. They provide double-sharing rooms, triple-sharing rooms, and four-sharing rooms, but the food is average. I am from Andhra. I didn't like the food, but I came here to get placed in good company, so the students who are coming to place in good company and focusing on studies, I would strongly recommend students come here, and the sports are not as good as those at other colleges.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Production Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely 90% placement, a very good infrastructure, and facilities.

content.Placements: Minimum 50% and maximum 75% were placed. Highest salary is 13 LPA, and the lowest Salary is 4 LPA. Caterpillar and TCS are the top companies for our course. More than 60% students will get internships from our college. Production manager is the top role.
content.Infrastructure: We have a CAD CAM lab, and we have a separate block for our course. Food quality is expected as hostel food, not very good or less good. We have grounds, a football and a basketball court. In our hostel, we have clinic for 24 hours. Lots of sports are here, and a gym also.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Applied Mathematics - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: My honest review of my college.

content.Placements: Placements in PSG are very good. The campus is visited by a variety of companies, from MNCs to local companies. The college first brings the MNC companies like Goldman Sachs, Intel, Amazon, Microsoft, eBay, etc. Then, the service-based companies like Cognizant, TCS, Wipro, etc., and the local companies are given a chance to recruit our students for those who wish to work in their hometown. During our final year, around 700 got placed in Cognizant, 60 in IBM, 28 in Wipro, 15 in Intel, 10 in eBay, and 8 in Amazon; all these are approximate values.

We need to pay for the canteen if we buy extra food, but the food is quite tasty. Lemon juice is most common in the canteen. Many games and guidance are available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the college, and it is well-known throughout Tamil Nadu.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good and it is traditional, which was built 70 years ago. It is a continuously developing college because 65% of the income will be given to the importance of infrastructure, and it is continuously done by the principal, Prakasan Sir.

reviews.review_heading: On an overall, it is a worthwhile college for placements and the development of your skills.
reviews.review_text: There are a wide range of labs available in the college. The college gives more priority to placements and academics, and not to the infrastructure. However, the required facilities for academics and students are available. The library plays a major role. Three canteens are available, and hostel facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied and value my knowledge.
reviews.review_text: The food in the canteen is good. Libraries are available for 6 days and they will be very useful. Labs are well-built and have a good network connection. Hostel food will be good and timings are strictly followed for girls and boys. They are maintaining the hostel well like cleaning and washing, and machines washing cloths are available for free cost for girls. Sports activities are available and extra time will be provided for them.

reviews.review_heading: My college experience at PSG.
reviews.review_text: There are libraries for each department and Wi-Fi facility throughout the campus with varying internet speed. There are air-conditioners, seminar halls, and classrooms available. The quality of food is acceptable in mess and comparatively good in canteen. There is a clinic inside the hostel for medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good and we have chosen the best college. Placements are also good.
reviews.review_text: At PSG College of Technology, we have a fabulous infrastructure. Lab facilities are well and good. The quality of facilities in our hostel is good, and the food is clean and tasty.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the college life in PSG College of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The college is provided with free Wi-Fi in every nook and corner. The department has its own library and labs are provided with clean equipments in good working conditions. The hostel facilities are good. The management solve most of the problems we put forth and the food is also good both in mess and canteen.

reviews.review_heading: My experience as an aspiring production engineer.
reviews.review_text: We have specialized CAD/CAM labs. Library is there for our department. We have an open laboratory for experimenting with new ideas. There is Wi-Fi throughout the campus with varying internet speeds. The quality of food is moderate to good differing each day. The canteen food is absolutely good. There are clinics inside our hostel and sports complex inside our hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the faculty, syllabus, freedom, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: PSG College of Technology has a decent infrastructure. It has a common library for 4 floors which contains almost all books needed for students to prepare for semester exams. Books for competitive exams like GATE, CAT, etc., are also available. The entire college is provided with a Wi-Fi facility and labs have a wide range of instruments in good working conditions. PSG has a wide range of sports. The food available in the mess and canteen is hygienic and good in taste.

reviews.review_heading: My college life, unfiltered.
reviews.review_text: The college facilities are good. We have excellent and well-equipped lab facilities and a large library. Wi-Fi is there, but the signal is not good everywhere. Hostel facilities are moderate to good. Some blocks are very good, like Q Block, and it depends on personal preference. The food quality is moderate, and there aren’t many changes in the menu.

reviews_list.review_title: Review of Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology.

review_content.Placements: There are no placements for students with a history of arrears in our department.
review_content.Infrastructure: Good, but AC in labs and classrooms would have been nice. Classrooms and bathrooms are not great, but manageable. It is still one of the best universities in Chennai, and this is not an excuse. A bus is available for almost every route in Chennai. Lunch is the best time with a good meal, both veg and non-veg. review_content.Faculty: Faculty is good enough, and teachers are good, but security is rude and not helpful. paragraphs: Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology also consider the seat's availability while accepting admission for different courses. There are more than 3,000 seats available for the BTech programme. Find below the course-wise seat intake for SIST Chennai:
Seats Intake
Note: Candidates must note that this information is taken from the official website of the institute and may change.
Students who are interested in taking admission at Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology can check the points mentioned below:
Step 1: Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology Application

The admission process starts with filling Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology application form followed by the merit score of eligible candidates. Interested candidates can visit the official website of Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology to apply for the course of their choice along with making the fee payment for the respective course.
Step 2: Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology Selection

For UG, the students need to qualify for class 12. For PG courses, graduation in the relevant discipline is required. The students with the minimum qualifications will be eligible to get register for the Sathyabama All-India Entrance Exam (SAEEE).

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and management .
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities were well maintained with good mess and canteen food. Medical facilities and sports rooms were available. It makes campus life comfortable. Overall, the campus provided a safe and student friendly environment. And also, the mess food is really good.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good facilities and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: There are many labs and Wi-Fi facilities on campus. Every classroom is equipped with a digital smart projector. The library is vast and has a lot of useful books. There is an emergency hospital and a dental hospital for emergency facilities. NCC and NSS are encouraged and given priority.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology.
reviews.review_text: Good, but AC in labs and classrooms would have been nice. Classrooms and bathrooms are not great, but manageable. It is still one of the best universities in Chennai, and this is not an excuse. A bus is available for almost every route in Chennai. Lunch is the best time with a good meal, both veg and non-veg. Lively canteen. The campus is walkable, giving it a pretty much Karan Johar college life.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in our department like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and computer labs are very perfect. The quality in our hostel facility is so good. The quality in our mess and canteen is good. Medical facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: The review indicated the importance of my college and the facilities it provides.
reviews.review_text: Campus has good infrastructure with modern classrooms, labs, and library. Hostels are well-maintained with basic facilities, decent food, and proper safety security by the college staff over there. The food is common to everyone, and it is free of cost.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely very good infrastructure and good placement in 2025.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good. There are good professors and well-educated lab technician. The surroundings are always clean and neat. The bus facilities are not good as they arrange less buses for more students. Nearly 10,000 students are studying so the college is always busy.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements are provided every year. I am fully satisfied with our college life.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good infrastructure and lab facilities that are equipped with various equipment and Wi-Fi connections all over. There is a sufficient number of laboratories for each subject with efficient materials, and a large space has been allotted for each laboratory.

reviews.review_heading: Best for studies and placements.
reviews.review_text: Courses are Electronic Communication and Engineering and Computer Science is most important courses in our college. Wi-Fi is available all over the college in all places and library is full with books for study. Labs are so clean and the ambiance of labs.

reviews.review_heading: Good and best for studies.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available all over the college. Canteen and library are also nice. Our college ambiance is excellent. Medical facilities are also available in our college. In mess, food quality is good. Daily non-veg is provided in our mess hall. Cool water facilities are also there in our campus.

reviews.review_heading: A few friendly faculty members expect everyone to be like that.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are good, and the labs are well-equipped with equipment. The Wi - Fi facility is available near the library. The mess food is not so bad when compared to other colleges, and not so good that the canteen is always crowded. You can't expect it to be so good, some half of the dish and juice are overpriced and taste bad.

reviews.review_heading: Really great in placements.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in our college are updated to modern technology, and the infrastructure is also very good. Sometimes the Wi-Fi connections are poor. When it comes to labs, classrooms, and the library, they are great. The food in our college is perfect and delicious.

reviews.review_heading: The college has poor infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: To be candid, the infrastructure operates on a strict policy of 'bare minimum. If viewed in isolation, the facilities are functional and liveable. The basics are there. However, the moment you benchmark our campus against peer institutions, the deficit becomes glaring. We are lagging significantly in modernization and maintenance, making the campus feel adequate only to those who haven't seen better alternatives.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in IT industry.
reviews.review_text: The course is of very high quality, and the sports facilities are also good. The food provided is of good quality and is free for day scholars, and a free bus facility is available. Security on campus is well maintained, and there is no dress code.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and infrastructure with good ambience.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available all over the college canteen, and the library is also nice. Our college ambiance is excellent. Medical facilities are also available in our college. The mess food quality is good. Daily non-vegetarian food is provided in our mess hall, and cool water facilities are also available on our campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college for engineering.
reviews.review_text: Labs and classrooms are very good. The library contains many books according to your department, allowing you to learn general knowledge as well. Wi-Fi is in very good condition. The courses offered also include specializations.

paragraphs: The application process, appearing in the entrance exam, counselling, and seat allotment, is included in theIIIT Bangalore admission process.  Aspirants should carefully check the eligibility and selection criteria of the desired programme. Below the admission procedure is explained briefly:
1: IIIT Bangalore Application Process 2025

Students have to apply on the official website of the accepted entrance exam and the institute's website. Aspirants need to pay an application fee of INR 1,000 to register for a course. The application portal is open online and eligible students can apply within the specified deadline.
2: IIIT Bangalore Selection Process

IIIT Bangalore cutoff listis released after the entrance exams for shortlisting the students. Those with valid scores need to apply for the counselling process through the official website of the concerned bodies. Students based on their scores, are allotted the branch/specialisation.
For IIIT Bangalore PhD admission, Students have to take a written test and go through an interview for selection.
3: IIIT Bangalore Final Seat Allotment

Students during their counselling process have to report to the admission cell at IIIT Bangalore for physical reporting along with all the required documents for verification purposes and tuition fee payment for final seat allotment.

faqs.question: Is it worth doing M.Tech from IIIT Bangalore?
faqs.answer: MTech is one of the popular courses of IIIT Bangalore. The institute has been ranked at 74 under the 'Engineering' category in 2024 NIRF rankings for its Engineering courses. faqs.question: How much is the IIIT Bangalore MTech fee?

faqs.question: What GATE score is required for IIIT Bangalore M.Tech admission?

Candidates with score equal or above the GATE cutoff are offered admission in the MTech programme.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in IIIT Bangalore without JEE?
faqs.answer: The answer to this question depends on the course applied by the candidate. JEE Main is necessary if the aspirant is applying for BTech programme. Candidates also need to fulfil the eligibility requirement specific to BTech course for admission.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for IIIT Bangalore PG Diploma courses?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to an IIITB PG Diploma course shall hold a valid Bachelor's or an equivalent degree in science/engineering/business administration/commerce/mathematics/computer applications or a Master’s degree in mathematics/statistics/commerce with at least 50% aggregate. Moreover, an aspirant should have passed the qualifying exam from a recognised university. The degree course mark sheets along with other documents have to be presented for verification purposes.

reviews.review_heading: It has strong academics, great placements, and good industry exposure at IIIT Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities for our department are very good. The campus has 24/7 high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped computer labs with updated systems, and smart classrooms with projectors. A well-stocked library is available with textbooks, research papers, and online resources. Hostel facilities are decent and comfortable, with clean rooms, Wi-Fi, laundry, and basic amenities. The mess food is average but hygienic. The canteen has limited but affordable options. Medical facilities are avai...

reviews.review_heading: A wonderful college to turn my dreams into reality.
reviews.review_text: The total campus is 9 acres of land with modern equipment and rooms made of good infrastructure. Coming to classrooms, they are comfortable for every batch of students. Library is well stocked with all kinds of books. Mess food is completely hygienic and consists of a variety of food items. Medical facilities are available 24X7. For sports, there is sufficient ground to play.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college if you focus on placement and academics.
reviews.review_text: Every facility is provided, and all sports facilities are available. Considering the 9-acre campus, there is no swimming pool or separate football and cricket ground. The ground is small. Academic-related facilities, like labs and others, are also provided. Hostel facilities are also decent.

reviews.review_heading: IIIT Bangalore is a premier institute for its engineering and IT programs.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are the best here. We have labs for almost everything related to electronics. Library has books of every sort, from fiction to reference books. Hostel is very good. We are provided with 3 sharing rooms with ample space to keep a table, bed, and cupboard.

reviews.review_heading: Just few things about my college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good here. The classrooms are also very good and comfortable. The hostel rooms are of single occupation for girls and single to triple occupation for boys. The quality of the mess food is reasonable. And there is good encouragement for different kinds of sports here .

reviews.review_heading: A good college if the student focuses on knowledge and education.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities are better than other colleges. Each floor and each room are well-equipped with Wi-Fi. Labs are well-managed and up-to-date with technology. Classrooms are better than usual classrooms, equipped with ACs and proper digital smartboards. The library is quite impressive as it holds a large number of books to choose from. The facilities in the hostel are very good. Proper maintenance and cleaning are done on a regular basis. The food in the mess are better than othe...

reviews.review_heading: Great college with nice faculty and placements. Except for the campus, which is really small.
reviews.review_text: There is great Wi-Fi service provided by the college. Even the mess food is good. The lab is fully functional and kept up-to-date. The hostels are really kept clean and tidy. They have staff to look after cleanliness. The food is also good for nutrition and is a balanced diet. The classrooms are well maintained. The labs also allow you to learn about real-world problems.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college provides facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a library, a gym, a basketball court, a tennis court, a badminton court, a football ground, a volleyball court, etc. The hostel facilities are good and clean.

reviews.review_heading: Very good exposure to explore more opportunities. Excellent placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available at almost every place in the Institute with excellent speed. Classrooms and Labs are very good with the latest technologies like projectors etc. The library is well built and has a wide collection of relevant and the latest books. The hostels, mess food, and canteen are all very good. Doctors frequently come to campus for medical facilities, every student has health insurance for emergency cases. Almost every sport facility is provided in the campus, Just the football ground c...

reviews.review_heading: I feel blessed to be part of one of the best colleges in India.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is well furnished, we have single rooms from 3rd year till 5th year in case of integrated M.Tech and case of M.Tech, we get a single room from the very first day. Fooding is also awesome in terms of hygiene, we have meals four times a day each day that contains milk and curd all the time. We have 24x7 Wi-Fi available with a speed of more than 200 Mbps. Our library contains a plethora of books from all fields, the library is fully air-conditioned and it is open for students till 1 AM.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the placement facilities and opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is excellent, with all the equipment available. The mess serves 4 meals a day. The food is better than what one expects from a mess. The menu is changed every 2 weeks. From this year onwards, non-veg has also been introduced to mess. Medical facilities could be better as the doctor is not available 24*7. In sports, we have volleyball, basketball, cricket, football, badminton, table tennis, foosball, etc., are available. Sports equipment is well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: IIITB was the institute of my dreams.
reviews.review_text: There are many labs and classrooms on our campus. It has an electronics lab-CEEMS, HideS, robotics club, BITES etc. The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. reviews.review_heading: IIT Bangalore has a great infrastructure and amazing learning experience.
reviews.review_text: Our college is situated in Electronic City Phase 2 and has a beautiful campus with greenery around. The classrooms are really up to the standard of any top-notch college in India and abroad. We have access to the vast library, and we get access to it even after completing the course for about 6-8 months. The hostel is decent, but as I am a resident of that location, I have not opted for it. Many of my friends stay in the hostel and are recommended for students who come from different places.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college to learn and innovate with excellent faculty members and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides large air-conditioned classrooms to accommodate 150 students and recorded lectures. Computer labs are equipped with ubuntu installed in machines. In the hostel, single rooms are available for masters students. They provide hot water facility in the morning and evening and 24 hours water faci...
