reviews.review_heading: It has good campus life, helpful teachers, and decent placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel quality is really good. However, the mess food is not tasty or hygienic. The central canteen is present, and we will find almost all types of eateries there. High-speed Wi-Fi is present at every location on the campus. There are all smart classrooms with air-conditioners. Medical facilities are also present on the campus, and they are free of cost. For almost every sport, there is a facility out there, be it cricket, table tennis, badminton, football, etc.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and a good placement history, mainly for the tech branches.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, specially 1st year classrooms are amazing and the overall location of the college is so good. Hostels are average and only available for students outside Delhi. The food quality is also average. Hostel rooms are good compared to many government engineering colleges. Most of the rooms are single bed, so it's a plus point.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are good, and teachers are well qualified.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is okayish, with a variety of food items as well as basic facilities. Mess and canteen foods are also okayish, on some days it is good, on a few days it is just bearable. Wi-Fi connectivity is good in the entire college, and hygiene is also maintained.

reviews.review_heading: I think overall the college is good; there are fewer canteens.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good but not excellent. There is everything like a gym and sports complex, but the gym infrastructure is good while it is mostly closed. There are no sports equipment to use, and we have to buy them on our own. Wi-Fi is not up to the mark, and water quality is very bad in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Fairly good, tier 1 college and placements are also good, infrastructure is not that good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for Computer Science branch is good. smart boards, projectors, and APJ complex are amazing for 1st year only. Also Wi-Fi everywhere. Library is also good, but timing can be improved. Dedicated running track in sports complex. Hostels are average. Food is good, but AC is not there in boys hostel.

reviews.review_heading: This college is a type of school.
reviews.review_text: You will face issues with drinking water. You have to invest in drinking water, and the hostel doesn't justify the price. Mess is compulsory, and you cannot skip. It will charge you Rs. 23,000 per semester, which is not justified for the quality of food they are giving. The menu is terrible for some days.

reviews.review_heading: Experienced faculty members, average sports complex (the only good thing is the track).
reviews.review_text: Facilities are great, we have AC. Also, we have a lot of instruments to try new things under guidance. There is a great canteen and mess for each hostel. The best thing about the sports complex is the racing track, which is 400 meters long. We also have SAC, a student activity centre.

reviews.review_heading: Is NSUT worth it in 2025?
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is above average, I would say. Everything works fine, but not a lot of places of great architecture like DTU. Classrooms are of top quality with digital boards and comfortable seats. Hostels are also comfortable. Mess food is average, but canteen food is good. We have a small hospital was urgent attention and works fine. The sports ground is also good and spreads over 30 acres. Games like basketball, volleyball, badminton, football, cricket, and table tennis can be easily played.

reviews.review_heading: It has good placements and an average college life.
reviews.review_text: The overall college infrastructure is well and good. Whole campus is facilitated with Wi-Fi at every corners. Almost all the classes are air-conditioned and have smart boards. Power sockets are provided for each student below their seat in the classroom. The campus has a medical clinic. For sports, it has a synthetic athletic track, basketball court, badminton court, tennis court, volleyball court, futsal ground, and cricket ground.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Netaji Subhas University of Technology (East Campus)
reviews.review_heading: A very underrated college.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms here are centrally air-conditioned, and all labs are equipped with Intel i7 PCs by HP. But network connectivity is not great here, only Airtel sims works fine here. The canteen here is also good, we have 2 grounds, 1 badminton court, and 1 open gym, and close gym is currently under construction. Almost all facilities are present here.

reviews.review_heading: NSUT - overall review for someone who wants to join.
reviews.review_text: Campus is really beautiful, and lovely to walk around, especially considering it's in Delhi, so having a walkable place itself is a blessing. Canteen is above average, you will get what you want most of the time, Mother Diary, Nestle, and a normal canteen. We have a total of 3 hostels, which are typical average hostels of Indian engineering colleges, nothing new, as most of them look old and flabby. Labs are 7/10. The library is above average, but has less seating space. Maybe they are looking f...

reviews.review_heading: NSUT is a top college for both education and placement purposes.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well structured, and the electrical machines present in labs are sufficient to provide better knowledge. The quality of hostel food is okay, and the medical facilities and sports facilities are better, but it could be better.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Netaji Subhas University of Technology (West Campus)
reviews.review_heading: Good placement record and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The official hostel isn't provided by the college; that's why you have to find accommodation on your own. The infrastructure of the college is very good compared to other colleges. The lab facilities are too good, with daily lab sessions conducted and many more activities performed during the session.

reviews.review_heading: It offers nice courses and amazing infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are clean. Food in the Mess is pretty average. The security guard is there every time, so they are strict with rules and regulations. However, they have structured everything.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend this college only for the tech branches. For non-tech, one should opt for DTU.
reviews.review_text: The library and computer center are very good. The SAC is usually busy, and there is no indoor badminton or basketball court. The APJ Complex classrooms are good, but the others are just average. The quality of canteen food is above average, but the mess food is only average.

faqs.question: Is direct admission possible in Banasthali University?
faqs.answer: Bananasthali Vidyapith course admissions to all courses is both merit and entrance-based. The university offers admission to various UG and PG courses. The university conductes Banasthali University Aptitude Test for admission to selective courses such as BTech, MBA, BSc Nursing, LLM, etc. There is no way to get direct admission to these courses. Admissions are solely based on entrance exam. However for courses such as BA, BSc, BCom, MA, MSc, etc.,. There is no requirement to qualify for any entrance exam. Candidates are only required to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria and fill an online application form. Based on the past academic records of the applicants, the university will select the right candidates.

faqs.question: What are the courses that Banasthali Vidyapith offers?
faqs.answer: The university offers 15+ undergraduate courses in the disciplines of Mathematics, Science, Management, Commerce, Arts, Engineering, Aviation, Education, Design, Law, and Journalism. It also offers 60+ masters and 25+ PhD courses in the disciplines of Humanities, Social Sciences, Law, Education, Commerce and Management. The popular courses of Banasthali Vidyapith are BTech and MBA. These courses are offered across various specialisations. Admission to most of the courses at Banashtali Vidyapith is entrance-based. Whereas, for other courses, candidates are selected based on their previous merit scores.

faqs.question: What is the last date for Banasthali Vidyapith admission form?
faqs.answer: Banasthali Vidyapith admissions are currently open. The university usually releases the admission form in April. Since admission to some of the courses is entrance-based, the university also releases the dates for the aptitude test. The university conducts Banasthali University Aptitude Test in June for different courses.

faqs.question: Can I apply offline for B.A LL.B admissions at Banasthali Vidyapith?
faqs.answer: Yes, Banasthali Vidyapith BA LLB application can be submitted in offline mode. To apply offline, students are required to send a DD/IPO for INR 1,000 in favour of 'Banasthali Vidyapith' payable at Banasthali/Jaipur, in order to obtain a prospectus and application form. It is to be sent to-Secretary-Banasthali Vidyapith, P.O. Banasthali Vidyapith -304022, Rajasthan, INDIA.

paragraphs: IIT Bhilai admission process includes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list and counselling process. The step-wise admission process for all IIT Bhilai UG & PG courses is given below:
Step 1: IIT Bhilai Application Process

The IIT Bhilai application process for BTech, MTech and MSc courses is based on exam-specific registration. For example, for BTech, candidates are required to apply for JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced application. Similarly, for the MSc, IIT JAM application form is required to be completed. However, for MTech admission, candidates have to register for GATE first. After that, the qualifying candidates have to further apply for COAP and then apply on the official website of IIT Bhilai to proceed to confirm their admission. All the PhD aspirants have to register on the official website of IIT Bhilai.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

IIT Bhilai admissions are entirely entrance-based. All the BTech aspirants are selected based on valid scores from JEE Main and JEE Advanced entrance exams. Whereas for MSc and MTech, students have to qualify for IIT JAM and GATE exams, respectively. Candidates can check with the admission office for the selection rounds of the rest of the courses.
Step 3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

IIT Bhilaicutoff for BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Candidates have to register for exam-specific counselling bodies for the final seat allotment. The shortlisted candidates and then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.
IIT Bhilai Fees 2025: Affordability & ROI

The fee for all IIT Bhilai courses varies depending on the duration and type of the course along with the course specialisations candidates choose. The tuition fee for all the UG & PG courses of IIT Bhilai ranges between INR 25,000 to INR 9 lakh. A one-time fee is INR 14,000 for all the courses.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Bhilai offers a serene and modern environment that blends innovation with tranquillity.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very, very nice. It fails many such colleges and gets its position at the very top. It is a completely new campus. It is being built and is very much incomplete, but it is quite nice. It feels like a five-star hotel with very creative and amazing infrastructure. I can enjoy it very much.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good but not outstanding.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are very good with air-conditioning (AC) in each room since the college is not too old. Bathrooms have hot, cold, and normal water. Very hygienic and clean hostels are provided. Mess food is also good most of the time. Sometimes we may not like the food, but most of the time the food is good. Wi-Fi is also provided everywhere, 24 hours a day.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and an environment. Placements are average.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. Labs are good, but need to increase the lab size. Classrooms and libraries are also good. The hostel room has AC, but the room size is small. Sports facilities are still in the developing phase. Being a third-generation IIT, its infrastructure and college environment are very good.

reviews.review_heading: The most aesthetic IIT. Campus feels different.
reviews.review_text: The college has an aesthetic campus, fully air-conditioned hostels. However, Wi-Fi in the freshers' hostel is not so great. Restrooms feel sleek and modern. Mess food is okayish (better than many colleges). Clubs are active, and they have functioning equipment which can be accessed by club members.

reviews.review_heading: It has very good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. It has unlimited internet access, a well-furnished library, spacious classrooms, etc. It also has well-equipped and high-tech laboratories. The hostel quality is good. Medical facilities are available. Multiple sports complexes are present here.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: In this course, we study higher Chemistry and its applications in the fields of industries, research, material synthesis, medical sciences, etc. Every aspect of this course should not be linked to the grades. Course load is more in the first year. Hostel rooms are very neat and clean. Each student has a separate room. There are 6 rooms in a unit. Each unit has a common drawing room and a kitchen. There is a mini refrigerator in the kitchen of each unit. There is a common balcony in each unit. Ev...

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: This two-year postgraduate program offers a deeper knowledge of advanced mathematics through subjects like geometry, calculus, algebra, number theory, differential equations, etc. The students become more skilled and specialized in a particular subject and are encouraged to carry out research in various fields of mathematics. reviews.review_heading: Placements are very good.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is gorgeous and well-maintained. We have classrooms with good space, projectors, and smart boards. Labs have high-speed Wi-Fi connections. The library is well-stocked with books and journals. The hostel is very clean and we have attached washroom facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The institute is fine at its infrastructure with good academics.
reviews.review_text: The buildings were constructed with perfection, and they looked great. Wi-Fi was available everywhere on campus, and the classrooms were fully air-conditioned. The library was quiet and a good place to study. The academic block was really beautiful. Laundry facilities were available at the hostel, along with Wi-Fi. The food quality was above average. For medical facilities, there was a health center on campus. For sports, there was a cricket ground, a basketball court, a football ground, badmint...

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college I can say but it is just in its initial phase of achieving excellence.
reviews.review_text: Our institute is in a growing phase, so some facilities are not available here, like Olympic playgrounds and student activity centers, etc. But those facilities that are built till now are up to the mark, like all hostel rooms having air conditioners installed, washing machine facilities inside the hostel, and good Wi-Fi connection with unlimited internet. So I can say those facilities that are built are very the latest and cutting edge.

reviews.review_heading: A growing college with lots of developments in the future.
reviews.review_text: We have a state-of-the-art campus with beautiful buildings, lakes, and greenery all around. The campus has centralized Wi-Fi with good speed. Hostels are good, with AC in each room. Currently, there are 3 hostels. Labs, classrooms, and the library are all well-equipped with the latest technologies. Mess food is good here. There is a common health center. Sports and games are in the development phase, as the campus is new. It will improve over time.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty, amazing infrastructure, best 3rd gen IIT, good for startups.
reviews.review_text: Our annual festival is called MERAZ, which is central India's biggest techno-cultural festival. It's held in November. In addition, we have over 100 events throughout the year, not counting festivals and celebrations. We're always tinkering with the labs and finding new things. The sports complex isn't ready yet, but we have a decent temporary sports facility and a partnership with nearby sports clubs for professional training. We have 19 clubs on campus, which is a lot, and it's really fun to t...

Sports facilities are still under development.
Medical facilities are good and open 24x7.

reviews.review_heading: Strong faculty and practical learning at IIT Bhilai with great campus life.

reviews.review_text: Library and Wi-Fi is 24*7. Labs particularly thesis lab is good but M.Sc.  practical lab for first year is okay from Next year it will be better. Hostel rooms are provided with AC and full cleanliness like a dream place. Hostels are better than anyone's expectations.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: An almost good institute with average placements and a beautiful campus.

review_content.Placements: NIT Srinagar's placement ratio is decent, means average placements. In Civil Engineering, there are the best placements. Computer Science and Electronics and Communication have the best placements, while other courses have average placements. I'm a Mechanical Engineering student, so in my course, approximately 80-85 percent of students are placed. The highest package is 35 LPA, the lowest package is 4 LPA, and the average package is 12 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, and some courses are NBA-accredited. There are all facilities for our course. It includes good Wi-Fi, classrooms with both smartboards and whiteboards, and good-quality labs. The food is good, and they prepare all Indian foods, both South and North. Sports facilities are also good, with a cricket ground, badminton courts, basketball courts, volleyball courts, etc. There are many canteens, but one problem is that there is no night canteen.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Srinagar - National Institute of Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Come to NIT Srinagar if this is your last and best option.

content.Placements: Unfortunately, in my course, placements are very low. The maximum package for this year is 8 LPA, 8–10 students got placed for the same amount, so it can be considered as an average package as well. Most of the students got internships in good companies like DRDO, HPCL, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is fine. Classrooms are good. Wi-Fi is also available. Labs need some maintenance. The library is well maintained but very small and congested. Mess food is just edible, canteen food is far better. For common health issues, medical facilities can help you, but for bigger issues, the college will prefer you go to a government hospital. Most of the sports courts are here. If you are a sportsperson, you will be happy.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Improving gradually in 2025.

content.Placements: This year, the placements have been decent. As per the data provided by the placement cell of NIT Srinagar, 67% of students of Computer Science and Engineering are placed this year, up to now, with a median package of approximately 9 LPA, and the average package is around 8.5 LPA. The highest package is 24 LPA, and the lowest is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiters are Physics Wallah, Oracle, Microsoft, and Make My Trip. This year, from my course, we have plenty of internship programs offered by Microsoft, but only 40% students opted for internships.
content.Infrastructure: As per the needs of the modern world, I don't think that we have the required facilities and infrastructure available in NIT Srinagar, classrooms are not well maintained, and many tools for doing experiments are outdated, yet we have Wi-Fi facilities and all kinds of labs. Hostels are built according to old standards, but the new mega hostel will be ready this year. Food is good with all sorts of requirements for a balanced diet. There are 2-3 canteens for each station, fast food, daily use items and stalls, they have all the required items you desire. A big playground is available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: I am in my first year of college. It is very good and one of the most beautiful campuses in India.

content.Placements: NIT Srinagar has good placement records from the past 5 years. It has almost 100 percent placement records in almost every branch, with an average of 9 LPA. MNCs from across India come here to place students in their companies.
content.Infrastructure: It has very good infrastructure. Every hostel has a nice garden in front of it. There is a badminton court in my hostel where we enjoy playing every day. We have a big ground and good sports equipment, so we enjoy ourselves a lot while playing. We also have a nice view of the mountains.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: An almost good institute with average placements and a beautiful campus.

content.Placements: NIT Srinagar's placement ratio is decent, means average placements. In Civil Engineering, there are the best placements. Computer Science and Electronics and Communication have the best placements, while other courses have average placements. I'm a Mechanical Engineering student, so in my course, approximately 80-85 percent of students are placed. The highest package is 35 LPA, the lowest package is 4 LPA, and the average package is 12 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, and some courses are NBA-accredited. There are all facilities for our course. It includes good Wi-Fi, classrooms with both smartboards and whiteboards, and good-quality labs. The food is good, and they prepare all Indian foods, both South and North. Sports facilities are also good, with a cricket ground, badminton courts, basketball courts, volleyball courts, etc. There are many canteens, but one problem is that there is no night canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is good for students in higher branches like CSE and ECE, with a nice campus and location.

content.Placements: Placements are good in Computer Science Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, and other major branches. The highest package is around 35 LPA, and the average is around 13 LPA for CSE and other major branches. In lower branches, the average is around 8-9 LPA. Many companies, such as BPCL, ONGC, and HPCL, recruit from core branches. Approximately 80-85% of students are placed in major branches.
content.Infrastructure: Mechanical and ECE departments are accredited. Wi-Fi is slow in hostels but good in academic areas. Mess food is manageable but not very good. A new hostel is being built for more convenience. Geysers, 24/7 water, and electricity are available. Cupboards are provided in the rooms, and single rooms are available for 4th-year students. Labs are good, with equipment and support staff.

admission_overview.college_name: NIT Srinagar - National Institute of Technology Admission 2025 (Open): Cutoff, Fees, Eligibility & Application

paragraphs: NIT Srinagar admission 2025is entrance-based for all the courses. Its flagship course is BTech for which admission is done based on JEE Main scores.NIT Srinagaralso offers MSc, MTech, MBA and PhD programmes. Candidates shortlisted through JEE Main and GATE exams need to appear for JoSAA and CCMT Counselling forNIT Srinagar course admissionsto BTech and MTech programmes. The admission criteria vary from one course to another. In the following sections, details aboutNIT Srinagar admissionsto the offered courses are provided briefly.

The eligibility criteria is the minimum qualification required for a candidate to qualify for theNIT Srinagar courseadmissions. Further, the seat allotment is done as per the selection criteria. The eligibility and selection details vary for each of the programme as mentioned in the table given below:

NIT Srinagar fee structurevaries for each course is a cumulative of multiple components. Some of the fee components are security deposit, alumni fee, hostel fee, and more. Students have to pay some amount of the total fee at the time of admission for seat confirmation. Check below theNIT Srinagar feeand average for all courses:

The seat intake for the courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. For example, for the BTech programme, the seat intake is released by JoSAA. At the time of counselling, candidates are allotted seat as per the allotted seat intake. Mentioned below are theNIT Srinagar course-wise seat intake:

NIT Srinagar admission processvaries for each of the programmes. The admission procedure involves registration, selection rounds, cutoff, merit list release, and counselling for seat allotment. Details about each of the admission stages are provided below:
1: NIT Srinagar Application Process 2025

For admission to NIT Srinagar, students are required to complete the application process of the course-specific entrance test. Aspirants have to visit the respective exam conducting body's official website to apply. However, forNIT Srinagar PhD admission, candidates shall visit the institute's official website (nitsri.ac.in) to apply.
2: Selection Rounds

Candidates become eligible for participation in the selection rounds if they meet theNIT Srinagar cutofffor the respective course.NIT Srinagar admissionis based on merit in JEE Main score followed by JoSAA Counselling. In addition, admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling.
3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling

A course-wise merit list is released to indicate the minimum marks required for admission. Aspirants must score equal or above NIT Srinagar cutoff for admission. The shortlisted candidates then have to take part in the respective counselling process such as JoSAA for BTech, CCMT for MTech, and CCMN for MSc. Candidates who get selected become eligible for admission.
4: Admission Confirmation
After the conclusion of the selection rounds, the shortlisted candidates can pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

reviews.review_heading: Come to NIT Srinagar if this is your last and best option.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is fine. Classrooms are good. Wi-Fi is also available. Labs need some maintenance. The library is well maintained but very small and congested. Mess food is just edible, canteen food is far better. For common health issues, medical facilities can help you, but for bigger issues, the college will prefer you go to a government hospital. Most of the sports courts are here. If you are a sportsperson, you will be happy.

reviews.review_heading: Improving gradually in 2025.
reviews.review_text: As per the needs of the modern world, I don't think that we have the required facilities and infrastructure available in NIT Srinagar, classrooms are not well maintained, and many tools for doing experiments are outdated, yet we have Wi-Fi facilities and all kinds of labs. Hostels are built according to old standards, but the new mega hostel will be ready this year. Food is good with all sorts of requirements for a balanced diet. There are 2-3 canteens for each station, fast food, daily use item...

reviews.review_heading: I am in my first year of college. It is very good and one of the most beautiful campuses in India.
reviews.review_text: It has very good infrastructure. Every hostel has a nice garden in front of it. There is a badminton court in my hostel where we enjoy playing every day. We have a big ground and good sports equipment, so we enjoy ourselves a lot while playing. We also have a nice view of the mountains.

reviews.review_heading: An almost good institute with average placements and a beautiful campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, and some courses are NBA-accredited. There are all facilities for our course. It includes good Wi-Fi, classrooms with both smartboards and whiteboards, and good-quality labs. The food is good, and they prepare all Indian foods, both South and North. Sports facilities are also good, with a cricket ground, badminton courts, basketball courts, volleyball courts, etc. There are many canteens, but one problem is that there is no night canteen.

reviews.review_heading: College is good for students in higher branches like CSE and ECE, with a nice campus and location.
reviews.review_text: Mechanical and ECE departments are accredited. Wi-Fi is slow in hostels but good in academic areas. Mess food is manageable but not very good. A new hostel is being built for more convenience. Geysers, 24/7 water, and electricity are available. Cupboards are provided in the rooms, and single rooms are available for 4th-year students. Labs are good, with equipment and support staff.

reviews.review_heading: Good college. Placement is good, and the facility is also good.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure and all facilities. Wi-Fi is everywhere. Classrooms are good. Library is good and canteen is available. The food is not very good. There are a lot of facilities in sports like badminton, volleyball, cricket, etc. Medical facilities are also good, we get good treatment.

reviews.review_heading: Average colleges don't take your expectations very high while getting into NIT Srinagar.
reviews.review_text: As a National institute, you expect a good infrastructure but it's not a good campus infrastructure. You may feel a lack of privacy and find it difficult to adjust at first in hostels. The canteen's facilities are not good, and you also get restrictions for visiting outside of campus and the hostel in terms of timing. You have to share a room with 5 students, and the room is not in very good condition. You will get Wi-Fi facilities. Department buildings are decent. Hostel food is not good. As yo...

reviews.review_heading: NIT Srinagar - National Institute of Technology .
reviews.review_text: The campus is beautiful. Dal Lake is right beside the college. The campus is a little small though. In sports, there are basketball, volleyball, cricket, football, tennis, table tennis, chess, and carrom. There is a canteen, a cafeteria, and some stationery shops.

reviews.review_heading: My opinion for NIT Srinagar.
reviews.review_text: Due to the low temperature here, heaters are available in the library and classroom, and Wi-Fi facility is also available. There are all labs available for all branches, like for civil – geotechnical, highway, transportation, structural, concrete lab available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Srinagar - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are very nice due to the cold environment here. Heaters are available in the classrooms. Smart boards are installed in each class, and medical facilities are very good, with a medical unit on campus. There is a big library that is open till 12 at night. Open-air campus Wi-Fi is also provided by the college.

reviews.review_heading: My review of NIT(National Institute of Technology) Srinagar.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities and infrastructure are relatively nice. There are pretty good Wi-Fi lab facilities, well-maintained classrooms, a library, and nice medical facilities for sports and games. There is scope for improvement that needs to be addressed. Overall, it is a good college.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Srinagar: Pros and cons.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi often doesn't work. Although classrooms are spacious. Labs have the required equipment most of the time. The library needs more space. The quality of food is above average. The rooms have 5 occupants each. However, this could change soon since a new hostel is being built.

reviews.review_heading: Some teachers are good, and some are not.
reviews.review_text: Excellent infrastructure, beautiful campus life, and sufficient labs and workshops for the mechanical department. In the hostel, there are 5-seater rooms, which are not good, and the mess food is average. Sometimes the hostel Wi-Fi is not working properly. In NIT Srinagar, the best branch is the mechanical department.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Srinagar - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is excellent, especially in the winter. The campus has all the necessary facilities required for students. Labs are sufficient and equipped with modern tools. The whole campus is Wi-Fi covered. Classrooms are digitalised, and the library is open from 6 AM to 12 AM. The hostel is okay. 5 students are accommodated in a room for the first year. The mess is okay, with differentiated timings for veg and non-veg, providing 4 meals a day.

reviews.review_heading: Everything needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: Labs are decent, but first-year classrooms are not good. The library has a very limited seating capacity. Wi-Fi is available but limited, with unnecessary website restrictions. The mess and canteen are poor. Sports and games are below average. There is not enough infrastructure for sports, with very few events and tournaments.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Master in Optometry (M.OPT) - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: The research scope is great here.

content.Placements: An optometrist role is offered at the initial average salary package that ranges from 4-5 LPA. Students generally get placed in hospitals. People do internships in a nearby hospital, which is linked to the university. Our university has 100% placements, and many of them opt to study abroad for better opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is top-notch, and we will get free Wi-Fi at every building with high-speed. Classrooms are also quite good with projectors. The library offers approximately 20,000 books 24x7. In hostels, rooms are average with good cleaning services. It also offers quite healthy and tasty food.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Health Psychology - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: My honest review of my college.

content.Placements: We have a good placement cell on our campus. Every year, we use to invite them for the campus selection. We used to go for higher studies rather than going for a job, most of us are pursuing a Ph.D. now. Still, we have some opportunities to get a job. The list of companies includes Velammal Educational Institutions, DuPont, and some renowned IT companies. We can do an internship under a professor.
content.Infrastructure: The course is also vast, and the labs are so good. If anyone wants research, this is the best place to be. So, many labs and many research programs happen here. Seminars from international professors are also very frequent. Exams and labs make a hectic schedule. Exams are very frequent. There are 3 minor and 1 major happen for one subject, with lab exams. The hostel is so good here, and the infrastructure is also very good. Everything is good and clean. Each room has only 2 members, so not a problem at all. Playgrounds are available at hostels. The gym is also there for students, which is very nice. For every semester, the hostel fees are so feasible for everyone.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it is the best university for the M.Sc. in Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences course.

content.Placements: Almost 90% of students are successfully placed in our Hyderabad University. Our course has the highest package of 37 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3-7 LPA. Recruitment agencies include IMD, IIRS, MoES, and many others. Opportunities for internships are great, with more than 85% of students placed in good companies. The top roles offered are oceanographer, climate modeler, and more.
content.Infrastructure: It has very fast internet and the best library compared to all the colleges in India. Indira Gandhi Library is one of the best libraries with a lot of books and papers. The hotel quality and facilities are excellent. There are some of the best medical emergency centers on campus, and we also have excellent sports and games facilities.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Financial Economics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I am fully satisfied with the course and dissatisfied with hostels.

content.Placements: Placement percentage is 12% - 15%. The highest package is 14 LPA. The lowest package is 5 LPA. The average package is 7 LPA. Recruiting companies are Federal Bank and Synchrony. Internship percentage is 20%. Roles and companies are research assistant in IITs, research institutes, RBI, and NABARD. Roles offered are research and data analysis.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good in the classroom. Toilets are neat and clean. Facilities available for PWD students. Wi-Fi is available. We don't have a library but a reading room. Hostel facility is not good. Food is not good and insects can be found in the food. We have many canteens on our campus and they are subsidized as well. Medical facilities are available all the time. Sports facilities are also provided.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.A. in Economics - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Best affordable university with great amenities.

content.Placements: As far as I know, you will have a good placement percentage but don't expect a package like 20LPA. If you are well talented, you can surely get placements as many companies will come for placements. The eligibility criteria depend upon the company, and some companies have minimum CGPA but some consider an interview irrespective of your CGPA. As I am still in 2nd semester this much only I can provide information about this section.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is another thing I personally like about this university as everywhere can get ramps for disabled students. Well maintained hostels and different blocks for different branches are there. There is an open theatre for events and a beautiful auditorium for seminars. There will be 24/7 library. Wi-Fi facility is there everywhere. Hostels are also nice and spacious. The food is a bit average.

University of Hyderabad has received strong ranks by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Provided parameters including, Teaching, Graduation Outcome, Inclusivity and Research, the institute is ranked in a good position as compared to other institutes by the NIRF 2025. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with the previous year's ranking. One can observe that within the category of 'University', the institute's ranking has fallen when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, University of Hyderabad fell 1 rank to #18 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, University of Hyderabad fell 4 ranks to #74 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been seen that in the 'Management' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability in trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2025, University of Hyderabad's rank is #101, the same as last year's rank in the 'Management' category by the NIRF ranking.

library.description:
University Library has rich collection of 4.53 lakh books, e-journals, e-books, reference books, serials, theses & dissertations, back volumes of journals, maps etc. The Library has a separate book bank for SC/ST students and 2500 braille books for visually challenged students. Apart from this, the Library has
received 642 books as gift from various sources worth approximately Rs.3.4 lakhs. The Library had renewed subscriptions to 230 plus print journals and 48 plus databases covering more than 40,000 e-journals.
The Library is also a member of Universal digital project of Carnegie-Melon University, Pittsburg, USA(Million books to the Web). Under this project, a scanning center was established in the Library to digitize rare books. The Library has signed MoU with UGC-INFLIBNET Centre, Ahmedabad, to digitize and upload full text Ph.D. theses submitted to University of Hyderabad.

reviews.review_heading: The research scope is great here.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is top-notch, and we will get free Wi-Fi at every building with high-speed. Classrooms are also quite good with projectors. The library offers approximately 20,000 books 24x7. In hostels, rooms are average with good cleaning services. It also offers quite healthy and tasty food.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The course is also vast, and the labs are so good. If anyone wants research, this is the best place to be. So, many labs and many research programs happen here. Seminars from international professors are also very frequent. Exams and labs make a hectic schedule. Exams are very frequent. There are 3 minor and 1 major happen for one subject, with lab exams. The hostel is so good here, and the infrastructure is also very good. Everything is good and clean. Each room has only 2 members, so not a pro...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best university for the M.Sc. in Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences course.
reviews.review_text: It has very fast internet and the best library compared to all the colleges in India. Indira Gandhi Library is one of the best libraries with a lot of books and papers. The hotel quality and facilities are excellent. There are some of the best medical emergency centers on campus, and we also have excellent sports and games facilities.

reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with the course and dissatisfied with hostels.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good in the classroom. Toilets are neat and clean. Facilities available for PWD students. Wi-Fi is available. We don't have a library but a reading room. Hostel facility is not good. Food is not good and insects can be found in the food. We have many canteens on our campus and they are subsidized as well. Medical facilities are available all the time. Sports facilities are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: Best affordable university with great amenities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is another thing I personally like about this university as everywhere can get ramps for disabled students. Well maintained hostels and different blocks for different branches are there. There is an open theatre for events and a beautiful auditorium for seminars. There will be 24/7 library. Wi-Fi facility is there everywhere. Hostels are also nice and spacious. The food is a bit average.

reviews.review_heading: If you're planning to come here for studying M.A. Economics, please don't.
reviews.review_text: The Infrastructure is very poorly planned and designed. Apart from old and depressing architecture, the locations of different buildings are also not well thought out. Some of the hostels are in the north campus and some are in the south, which are 3-4 km apart. Some departments are in the middle, some are in the east campus (3 km from the north campus), and some are in the south. There aren't enough buses to carry all the students to their respective classes. But, the library is in the middle, ...

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied as they are very affordable, large campus area, and have a lot of greenery.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure is up to the mark especially in south campus whereas it is not as much good in north as they all are so old. South campus hostels are well-equipped with geyser, RO, water cooler, and Wi-Fi both LAN and outer near to rooms. We need not worry about the classrooms as they are best in infrastructure wise with the modern equipment. Labs are also well maintained. Hostels need a little bit of maintenance but academic buildings are well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and facilities. Everyone is friendly.
reviews.review_text: We have a big library where many books are available. We have playgrounds, a gym, and yoga. Many tournaments are held here. The food is good, and hostels are always clean. We have a separate medical center where people there take care of us. Wi-Fi is provided in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: UOH is one of the best universities if you are looking for research. Faculty members are really good
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is really good; some of the buildings of the college are really good. Wi-Fi, the library, and all are really good. In the hostel, we have to stay with 2 members in each room, and ethernet facilities are available in all hostels. The food quality is average.

reviews.review_heading: This institute has got the title of "Institute of Eminence."
reviews.review_text: This university has a library named Indira Gandhi Memorial. It has many books and journals for every respective field. The books here cover linguistics, such as Hindi and Urdu, and technology engineering. Many clubs are running here, such as the Arts, Dance, Science, and Junior Clubs, and many more.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied! It's really a great college.
reviews.review_text: Food quality is very good and offers many dishes in one place. There is a big library with seating arrangements, and we can also borrow books from the library for study. Computer labs and science labs are available. Our college has plenty of space with multiple washrooms and ample space with an auditorium and multiple computer labs. We have a huge cricket playground with turfs. Great Wi-Fi connection.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Computer Science in University of Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text:
The hostel is good but not too clean, with corridors full of dogs but not much charm.
Labs are good except when it comes to computer labs. 
There are study rooms, reading rooms, and libraries open 24/7 except on some major holidays. 
Okay canteen, faculty members, and good medical facilities. Not much support in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Integrated economics at the University of Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text: College campus is very big and full of greenery. Department buildings have good and advanced facilities. There is 24/7 library and reading room are avilable. Wi-Fi is enabled in hostels and all public places. Good indoor, outdoor sports facilities, and good gym facilities. Hostel rooms are decent with 2 students per room.

reviews.review_heading: Curriculum and campus environment are good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is amazing. Over 2300 acres campus with good connectivity, free bus service, advanced department building, and classrooms. Big and decent library which is 24/7 open. Full-time Wi-Fi is available in all public areas, including the shopping complex, hostels, lecture halls, and departments. Hostel rooms are good we have to share a room with one of our roommates. All other basic facilities are available such as gym, stadium, and sports complex for almost all indoor and outdoor sports....

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty, but administration is poor.
reviews.review_text: Bad condition of infrastructure and technology, provided by the administration, buildings are in worse condition in my school, but the library is the finest place where students rush to. The mess condition is even worse, but the quality of food sanitation is good.

reviews.review_heading: The campus life is peaceful.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not as great as that of the newly built college, as MSRIT has been around for many years, but the labs are well maintained. The classrooms are neat and clean. But as the rumour says, the campus is under construction every time, and some classrooms need maintenance.

reviews.review_heading: MSRIT-College is innovative and makes you industry-ready.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure and hostel facilities. Decent mess food and timely preparation if asked, and the canteen is also good, all kinds of snacks are available. Good place to hang out during break. Wi-Fi is good in the hostel and college, too and good connectivity in labs and working labs.

reviews.review_heading: It has good placements and a nice infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available here. The speed is not good across the campus, but good in labs. There are a lot of labs and libraries with a lot of systems and proper internet in that area. There are at least 60-70 systems in labs. Digital libraries are also there. Sports ground and facilities are also there.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good experience.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is a bit old compared to BMSCE and other colleges. Although the labs are fine, but the classrooms, etc., are a bit old and there are no digital classrooms. The Wi-Fi is provided to every student, but the speed is very low. The sports facilities are also a bit average. The mess and canteen are good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the teaching of the college, as it's average to good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, but it feels like more school than college. Labs are well-maintained. College is hygienic and clean. Modern labs are also there. Hostels are mid, it's affordable too, it mainly depends on the money you can get, an Rs. 80,000 hostel or a 1.3 lacs hostel. The facilities are different, with an overall average.

reviews.review_heading: Placements and faculty are good, but few extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: MSRIT offers a well maintained campus with modern classrooms, advanced labs, and strong Wi-Fi coverage. The library is spacious and resource rich. Sports facilities and common areas are clean and organized, creating a productive academic environment.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in 2025, decent faculty for the first year, and a decent college.
reviews.review_text: The average infrastructure is not very modern, but it is okay. Wi-Fi is mediocre. Hostel quality varies based on the course fees. The luxury one, which is 1.3 LPA, is much better compared to the Rs. 80,000 per year one. Food is good. There are multiple sports clubs you can join. Labs are okay, and classrooms are like coaching ones, which is the only downside.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with placement, facilities, and teaching.
reviews.review_text: As for course and classrooms, the facilities provided are excellent. They have a working Wi-Fi all over the campus, free for students, and a very wide range of study materials available in the library, along with the facility to read silently during exams. As for the hostel, the quality of mess is not that good. Also, the fixes needed with the hostel infrastructure can be ignored or done a whole while later, which makes living really difficult. Canteen outside the hostel, i.e, inside the college...

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and campus life are really good.
reviews.review_text: 24/7 Wi-Fi is available. Labs and classrooms are well-equipped. The library is informative and includes a digital library. Hostel, mess, and canteen facilities are clean and good. Lab instructors and faculty members are supportive. Medical facilities are available, along with a gym, sports, and game areas.

reviews.review_heading: Review about RIT and college life.
reviews.review_text: Our college is a well-reputed one in all of Karnataka. It has good infrastructure with well-maintained canteens and dedicated labs for each department. The computers are also high-end, so the systems do not hang or slow down with the software we run. The library is well-equipped with all books, and each student has dedicated Wi-Fi access.

reviews.review_heading: Average placement as well as college life.
reviews.review_text: The library facilities are very good. There are a total of 3-4 libraries, with a seating capacity of 250-300 and above, not less than that. Wi-Fi is provided by the college. Labs are good, but don't think the same about the lab teachers. The hostel available on the campus is not sufficient; only 30 percent of the students will get the hostel inside the campus, but hostels are available in the locality. However, the food served is too bad. You won't be able to consume the mess food regularly.

reviews.review_heading: This college is amazing because I am getting placed in 2025.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is good. I have stayed hostel for 2 years, which is good. Wi-Fi, library, and sports are available. Study hours are also available. The food is of very high quality, and I have never seen it taste and quality. Every day have study hours in the evening. Hostel food is super.

reviews.review_heading: Genuine reaction about studying MCA in MSRIT.
reviews.review_text: We have a great infrastructure in MSRIT for students. The college provides supervised Wi-Fi access to students with a maximum of 2 devices per student. We also have a great library and also have access to a digital archive of those books. The library has all the prescribed books covered in our syllabus. I don't know much about hostel facilities as I stay outside the college hostel. I do have a rough idea about the price of the college hostel. It costs approximately 1 lakh per academic year. Host...

reviews.review_heading: The campus has many blocks making to recognised to identify which department is there to access.
reviews.review_text: All lab equipment is available with the latest tech. It provides 10 GB of data every day. The hostel is the worst, but we can stay outside. The college charges students if they break equipment.

reviews.review_heading: About MSRIT you need to know before joining.
reviews.review_text: The college is quiet and silent all the time. Wi-Fi is installed in every corner of the college. The library is good and completely quiet. It is highly equipped with all the books and stuff. The hostel food is good and completely veg. There is good scope for sports and extracurricular activities.

paragraphs: According to the 2025 placement report, Christ University Kengeri placed a total of 223 students with the highest and average packages standing at INR 16 LPA and INR 8.78 LPA , respectively.

faqs.question: What is the highest package for B.Tech students at Christ - Kengeri Campus?
faqs.answer: The highest salary package offered to students at Christ-Kengeri Campus is 21.5 Lacs per annum. The median package offered to students is estimated at 4.8 Lakhs per annum. Many companies come to this University for placements. Some of the examples are Tech Mahindra, Cisco, Newtronics, Epsilon, TCS. All specialisations have good placement opportunities and there are openings for students from all specifications that they can attend. The University has a well organised and proactive placement support. One disadvantage is that the University offers very less placements for B.Tech in civil engineering.

faqs.question: Are there any government job opportunity for BSc form Christ University Kengeri Campus?
faqs.answer: Yes, there are plenty of government job opportunities for BSc graduates form Christ University Kengeri Campus. After graduating in Psychology one can either work for a company or practice as a professional. One can easily get a job in industries like NGOs, schools, colleges, and companies. The prominent roles offered by these industries are career counsellors, juvenile counsellors, and trainers in rehabilitation centres.

faqs.question: Can HCL and Infosys be considered as some of the top recruiters of Christ - Kengeri Campus?
faqs.answer: Yes, HCL and Infosys are regarded as two of the best employers at Christ University's Kengeri Campus for recruitment. It's these well-known IT firms who engage in the university's placement drives year after year and hire an enormous amount of graduates.Offering roles in a variety of fields, including software development, IT infrastructure, data analytics, and consulting, HCL has long been a significant employer at Christ University.Students are prepared for the recruitment process through workshops and pre-placement sessions held on campus. Christ University alumni are frequently hired by Infosys, another well-known employer, for positions in project management, business analysis, software development, and testing.Students have plenty of opportunity to get placements since they actively participate in the university's employment fairs and placement campaigns.

reviews.review_heading: This university is best in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this course is very good for the students. This university offers many opportunities like all-time Wi-Fi facilities for the students and faculty, and the classrooms of this college are fully air-conditioned. This college has a big library for the students. The hostel of this college is very big for the students, and the food in both the canteen and mess hall is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Best college life that I have seen.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure available is very useful. We have neuroanatomy labs where we cut the brain of a rat and try to understand the functions of the brain. The hostels and food available are also really good. The medical room is present in the 3rd block, which is in the middle of the entire campus. Sports and games we have two huge football grounds, two basketball courts, and various other places.

reviews.review_heading: A little note about my college.
reviews.review_text: The department has good facilities: labs, Wi-Fi, and projector classrooms. Teachers prefer writing with chalk on the blackboard. The library has a good number of useful books. There’s only a boys' hostel inside the campus for undergraduates. There is no girls' hostel; it is private and located outside the campus. There are 3-4 canteens, and the food is average in the canteens. There is a medical room for emergencies. The doc is a nursing student, and she treats well. There are a lot of tournamen...

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied and proud to be Christian. Service and teachers are top-notch. Beautiful campus ever.
reviews.review_text: Labs are well-equipped and maintained. There is personalized Wi-Fi connection for students that students can access whenever they need within the campus. Hostel rooms are clean and washrooms are good, water facilities for both drinking and washrooms are available always. There are various canteens and shops that sell different types of food that are so good in taste. Stationery is available with ATM facility too. Medical room with a doctor is available. Christ gives importance to both academics ...

reviews.review_heading: No regret, absolutely satisfied.
reviews.review_text: The faculty members are highly educated and approachable. They also encourage interdisciplinary research and studies. There are almost 7 canteens on our campus that serve good food. Students interested in sports are also encouraged to pursue the same.

reviews.review_heading: Love the infrastructure and crowd.
reviews.review_text: Kengeri Campus is known for its excellent infrastructure. It stretches about 80 acres and is well-maintained. It's lush green everywhere you look. Wi-Fi is provided throughout the campus. Library consists of two floors and offers a vast collection of materials. Hostel life is very disciplined. The food is diverse as there is a huge north and south canteen present. About 3-4 more stalls offering various food and drinks. A cafe coffee day is also present. The grounds are excellent. Football, crick...

reviews.review_heading: Christ University- Yay or Nay.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at Christ University is top-notch, with multiple libraries on the same campus. Wi-Fi access, access to more than 45 thousand books, and classrooms are all equipped with both projectors and blackboards for convenient teaching. The hostels on campus for engineering students are available for boys, and the girls' accommodation is off-campus, but students are offered transport at multiple times during the day. The hostels are well-equipped with water systems, common rooms, elevato...

reviews.review_heading: Genuine review of the Christ University.
reviews.review_text: Our ECE department, as many labs regarding VSI signal, magnetic fields, and many more. All the classrooms are installed with Wi-Fi. Campus infrastructure is very good. There are mess, and the canteen is for all the students, including those in the hostel. Students also need to eat in canteens by paying.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure was good overall.
reviews.review_text: Average infrastructure. Wi-Fi had limited access to everything. There was a time restriction for going out, and no food or eatables were allowed in the hostel premises. Bathrooms were dirty, no soaps were provided, and the water was also not good. Cleaning was good overall.

reviews.review_heading: Great Placements, Great Peers, Strict Rules.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good. Rooms are cleaned every day, with CCTVs, operational lifts, and a good amount of sunshine. An issue could be the strict timings; you have to be on time every day, and you can't miss out on even a single day. Within hostels, you also have to follow a set of rules.

reviews.review_heading: College with great infrastructure and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure is top-notch. They are currently upgrading some of the labs. All the infrastructure is very good. The hostel doesn't provide food but is well-maintained, with clean rooms and washrooms that are cleaned every day.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the unnecessary rules and regulations.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is too good; I think it is the best in whole Bangalore. Hostel facilities are also good, but only food and water have some issues from time to time. Labs, classrooms, and the library are perfect. The canteen food was found spoiled and was not clean sometimes. Medical and sports are the best. Playgrounds, basketball courts, and all of them are clean and good for use.

reviews.review_heading: My thoughts about Kengeri campus.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, drinking water purifiers, toilets, bathrooms, etc. A nice garden area is there with full-time security watch. The facilities in the hostel provided are very good, but the cleanliness is not that appropriate. Security attitude is good, and also vending machines are there.

reviews.review_heading: My overview of Christ University.
reviews.review_text: My university is very vast; it has unique infrastructures and buildings. The entire campus is around 82 hectares and is filled with a green lush environment with trees. The hostel facility is average; it has 3-sharing rooms, and each student has a personal desk and cupboard. The hostel does not provide food for the students. The campus supports many sports and arts activities like football and basketball.

reviews.review_heading: Good facilities and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The Labs are easily accessible, classrooms are always clean and there are two libraries which contain books from every department. Coming to hostel, there are two separate hostels for girls and boys. There are 5 canteens with average food provided and I think the hostel fee is actually high.

This fee does not include the hostel fee or the mess fee and only consists of the total cost of tuition. The fee mentioned here is taken from unofficial sources and hence, is indicative. To be eligible for the BTech programme at IIT Dharwad candidates need Class 12 with 75%. Aspiring candidates need to clear JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced to get admission to the BTech programme at IIT Dharwad.

overview_faqs.question: How costly is IIT Dharwad?
overview_faqs.answer: IIT Dharwad courses include BTech, BS-MS, MTech, MS, and PhD across several streams. IIT Dharwad course admission is based on entrance. Therefore, candidates must secure a valid score in JEE Main/ JEE Advanced/ GATE along with securing 75% in Class 12. In addition to this, IIT Dharwad fees include total tuition fees ranging from INR 10K to INR 10 Lakh.

overview_faqs.question: Why choose IIT Dharwad?
overview_faqs.answer: IIT Dharwad is a thirs-generation IIT which came into existence in 2016 and was established by the Ministry of Education, Government of India and mentored by IIT Bombay. The institute is known to offer BTech as a flagship course along with various opportunities facilitated by the virtue of collaborations and partnerships with nationally and internationally renowned institutions. Dharwad IIT provides a good placement rate along with facilitating several industry oriented projects and scholarships for the students to avail. To conclude, it is worth choosing IIT Dharwad.

review_summary.college_name: IIT Dharwad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Inside the best 3rd gen IIT.

content.Placements: Almost every student got placed, while the others opted for start-up or higher studies. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Infosys, Paytm, AIR Asian, Oracle, Zepto, Mathworks, Texas Instruments, etc. They offer placements. The average package is around 16-20 LPA. The highest package has been 52 LPA, and the lowest is 8 LPA. Internships are available in companies like Amazon, Texas Instruments, JIO, Arista Network, etc. Top roles offered are SDE and product manager.
content.Infrastructure: The college has an amazing hostel with a fully air-conditioned mess, Wi-Fi, and power backup. The college has facilities like basketball, badminton, table tennis, fuss ball and 3 common rooms with a capacity of 100 students in each hostel. Every wing has 3 washing machines. The indoor facility has badminton, squash, volleyball, and a gym. Temporary grounds for cricket and football and a helipad. The medical facilities are very efficient with 24/7 working and an ambulance just a call away.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical and Biochemical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great things take time, and IIT Dharwad will shine.

content.Placements: Chemical, biochemical, civil, maths, and computing are the branches introduced in 2022. There is no data present for placements. But branches like CS, mechanical, and electrical have average placements. The average salary package offered is 15 LPA. The percentage of students who got placed from those branches is around 70-80%.
content.Infrastructure: As the college is in the developing phase, it is not the appropriate time to conclude about infrastructure, but till now the buildings are class, big, and enough to meet the requirements of an IIT. All the basic facilities are available to the students and staff members. We have a mess, a gymkhana, 2 hostels, one wellness center, etc. There is a lack of sports grounds, so we used it from the Walmi campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I think, as a 3rd Gen IIT student, the placements are improving from year to year.

content.Placements: In my course, CSE, 60 students are there in total for 1st-year students, with two sections, S1 and S2, 160 students in each section. As a first-year student, I did not know much about placements, but as a 3rd-generation IIT student, it is the best of all. The average package is 21 LPA for CSE.
content.Infrastructure: Nice buildings, nice hostel, nice mess, nice roads, nice gym, nice indoor stadium, nice people, nice staff, good atmosphere, environment, nice college, nice people, nice atmosphere for the library, and a very good library, nice chairs in the library, very high-class library.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical and Biochemical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure but come mentally prepared.

content.Placements: There are 12 students from the chemical engineering branch. The highest package is 54 lakhs in the CS branch. Very few students get internships in any branch. As ours is the third batch, since this is a new IIT, we still don't know about chemical engineering placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good, but hostel food is not. The classrooms and library are really nice. But, there are frequent power cuts. The Wi-Fi offers fast internet. There is a wellness center if you are sick, a sports complex to play games and a gym. Canteen food is affordable and tasty.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil and Infrastructure Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Our college has good faculty members who happily clear students' doubts.

content.Placements: This year placements are going on because our branch started three years ago. We hope that this year will get better placements. There is a career development cell (CDC) that helps to join internships. There are advanced research facilities that help more to qualify.
content.Infrastructure: They provide labs, equipment, materials, and everything. I'm still in my first year in this college, so I don't know about the engineering lab. Our seniors say that they are better than mechanical. Everything is good. Our college provides all facilities like a medical lab, hostel, canteen, and mess. The ground for cricket and football is under construction and will be available in the next year. There is a wellness center here for medical issues. We have a common indoor facility for indoor sports. There is a gym.

paragraphs: Admission is completely entrance-based for all the courses offered by the institute. IIT Dharwad offers BTech and BS-MS (integrated courses) at the undergraduate level. At the postgraduate level, the institute offers MTech and MSc. Further,IIT Dharwadoffers a doctoral-level programme as well. IIT Dharwad admission procedure varies as per the courses candidates wish to pursue. However, the qualifying eligibility criteria as per the IIT Dharwad's admission guidelines are equivalent for all the courses. The IIT Dharwad admission process consists of multiple steps which are as follows:
Step 1: IIT Dharwad Application Process
IIT Dharwad conducts the application process for admission to its offered courses. However, for a few course candidates are required to complete the entrance exam's registration/application process.
Step 2: IIT Dharwad Selection Process

Candidates are shortlisted based on their qualifications. Next candidates are required to go through the selection process which requires candidates to to go through the course-based entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After the selection rounds are completed, they are required to go through the course-wise counselling process for final seat allocation.IIT Dharwad PhD and MS admission process includes a college-conducted written test and personal interview.Step 3: Seat AllocationSeat allocation for BTech is conducted by JoSAA (Joint Seat Allocation Authority).In order to be selected, students must participate in the counselling process after which seat allocation takes place.However, for MTech course candidates must participate in the Common Offer Acceptance Portal (COAP) for seat allocation.Step 4: Final AdmissionOnce seat allocations are finalised, selected applicants must pay the admission charges along with the course fee to confirm their admission to the selected course.Candidates may have to visit the administration office of the college to get their documents verified offline.

reviews.review_heading: Inside the best 3rd gen IIT.
reviews.review_text: The college has an amazing hostel with a fully air-conditioned mess, Wi-Fi, and power backup. The college has facilities like basketball, badminton, table tennis, fuss ball and 3 common rooms with a capacity of 100 students in each hostel. Every wing has 3 washing machines. The indoor facility has badminton, squash, volleyball, and a gym. Temporary grounds for cricket and football and a helipad. The medical facilities are very efficient with 24/7 working and an ambulance just a call away.

reviews.review_heading: Great things take time, and IIT Dharwad will shine.
reviews.review_text: As the college is in the developing phase, it is not the appropriate time to conclude about infrastructure, but till now the buildings are class, big, and enough to meet the requirements of an IIT. All the basic facilities are available to the students and staff members. We have a mess, a gymkhana, 2 hostels, one wellness center, etc. There is a lack of sports grounds, so we used it from the Walmi campus.

reviews.review_heading: I think, as a 3rd Gen IIT student, the placements are improving from year to year.
reviews.review_text: Nice buildings, nice hostel, nice mess, nice roads, nice gym, nice indoor stadium, nice people, nice staff, good atmosphere, environment, nice college, nice people, nice atmosphere for the library, and a very good library, nice chairs in the library, very high-class library.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure but come mentally prepared.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, but hostel food is not. The classrooms and library are really nice. But, there are frequent power cuts. The Wi-Fi offers fast internet. There is a wellness center if you are sick, a sports complex to play games and a gym. Canteen food is affordable and tasty.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good faculty members who happily clear students' doubts.
reviews.review_text: They provide labs, equipment, materials, and everything. I'm still in my first year in this college, so I don't know about the engineering lab. Our seniors say that they are better than mechanical. Everything is good. Our college provides all facilities like a medical lab, hostel, canteen, and mess. The ground for cricket and football is under construction and will be available in the next year. There is a wellness center here for medical issues. We have a common indoor facility for indoor sport...

reviews.review_heading: IITs with best buildings, the latest IITs.
reviews.review_text: The buildings and infrastructure are quite amazing. As ours is a new generation IIT, everything was built recently, and everything is amazing. It feels good to experience things here, though there may be a little discomfort with Wi-Fi, but it’s okay. Everything provided is of fine quality.

reviews.review_heading: Campus has good infrastructure and food but placements are absolutely bad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good, as it’s a newly built college. It’s clean, and the buildings and hostels are kept cool. While there is no air-conditioner facility in the hostels, the classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners. However, the buildings are a bit far from each other, so you may prefer to cycle rather than walk.

reviews.review_heading: The basic idea about IIT Dharwad.
reviews.review_text: Talking about our facilities, we have access to 24/7 Wi-Fi and the library. As it is a 3rd-gen IIT, the infrastructure is not completed yet, so it can take 10 years to be fully developed. The food in the mess is average. The canteen is open till 3:00, so you can go there and enjoy. There is no restriction on roaming; you can roam around the campus. The medical facility here is available 24/7. We have a nurse, and the doctors visit daily, but in restricted time.

reviews.review_heading: Nice infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are fine. But the signal of our sim is not available in the room. For outdoor games, we have to go to another campus named Walami which is near IIT Dharwad. All medical facilities are very nice. There is a separate shop for our general resources.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life at IIT Dharwad.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure here is amazing. As it's a new IIT, it's hostels are far better than the holder IITs. The hostels are equipped with good Wi-Fi but sometimes there may be temporary network issues. The classrooms here are well furnished and equipped with all the necessities required.
Mess food is above average, and there is also a night canteen that remains open till 3:00 am. 
Our campus's main motto is to make it a " Net Zero Campus," which will be self-sufficient for water and electricity and...

reviews.review_heading: The college provides excellent infrastructure and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was excellent. They give free Wi-Fi. Labs, libraries, and classrooms are excellent with smart instruments. We have an indoor facility with a gym, badminton court, squash court, and table tennis court. We have adjusted for the food here. It is not tasty.

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied with the mess, but satisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: The thing that I like the most about my college is its infrastructure. We have a wide area in the library to study in a peaceful environment. But the mess is below average; we also have limited facilities in sports. There are only two hostel blocks for students so in each room there will be four members.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best IITs in south india.
reviews.review_text: As our IIT Dharwad is new generation IIT, which was started in 2016. All the buildings are super good and their infrastructure is super unique but the sad part of our campus is that Wi-Fi is not so good. But our college community assured us that they were going to fix that issue soon.

reviews.review_heading: Our college got good placements, but slightly dissatisfied with the mess.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is best compared among new generation IIT. The hostel facilities are good. We have a very good atmosphere to study in hostel rooms. But we don't have a permanent ground to play. We should go to a temporary campus to play sports like cricket and volleyball.

reviews.review_heading: I am actually satisfied with the faculty, but dissatisfied with the mess food.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very good. The mess food quality is the worst; many times we see insects in our food. But they are trying to improve the quality now. Not even once a week they provide chicken to eat for free. We should buy coupons to eat chicken. Our college gym facilities and medical facilities are good.
