review_summary.college_name: RGIPT Amethi Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Feels a little high than IITs though it is a central government college.

content.Placements: We have a batch strength of 58 students in Electronic Engineering. Around 70 percent of the students are placed in the EE branch. The average package is 10 LPA. There is no company going to come below 8 LPA from this year 2025 according to the director’s instructions. There is an analog company that came to hire at 31 LPA for EE students.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are pretty good. They have provided spacious rooms, clean and the finest. There are proper facilities of Wi-Fi and library, IIT-type classrooms. Labs are fully equipped with machines and instruments. One best thing is the good mess food quality. It feels like homemade food. There are also sports facilities of all kinds, including indoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering (E-Vehicle) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Not very satisfied, but I did not have any other option, so it's okay to study here.

content.Placements: So, talking about placements, the Petroleum and Chemical branches are way better here. We can see PSUs for them, and for CSE, ECE, EV, MNC, and IT, we have quite low numbers. The teaching branches are shifted to the Bangalore Campus for their final year. A few companies visited the campus in Bangalore. Now, for my batch, companies are coming, and hopes are high. The highest till now from our year is Flipkart for 33 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is new, and the facilities are great at the Amethi campus. Food is decent, and labs are fully equipped, but the library is small for the crowd. Now, talking about the Bangalore Campus, the hostel is very new, but there are no good facilities at all. Wi-Fi is horrible here compared to the Amethi campus. Connectivity is okay at Amethi, but at Bangalore, it's very far from the city.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is great, but it has a small campus, and the location is quite far from the city.

content.Placements: Placement ratio for Chemical and Petroleum is almost 98 to 99%. You need to maintain a decent CPI and get good companies like IOCL, and PSU. Also, you can try for off-campus placements and clear exams like GATE, CAT, etc. The tech branches don’t have good placements.
content.Infrastructure: There are outdoor and indoor games in the college with well and good infrastructure. The campus is clean and tidy. It also has a beautiful garden and a statue. There are two academic blocks, and every kind of lab is available in the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Design Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Not at all satisfied, poor.

content.Placements: Placements are so poor. We pay more than 12 lakhs in fees, even though it is a central government college still we do not get a 3 LPA job at TCS. College on campus is very poor. Companies don't come here and they send the CS department to Bangalore in 4th year in the name of exposure. But only we know what the reality is. Recently, a 3rd-year student did suicide but this college is shameless enough to even hold some sympathy.
content.Infrastructure: Construction is still ongoing on and only two academic blocks are there. Wi-Fi doesn't work properly even after complaining a lot they don't fix it. Library is good and classrooms are good too but still, there's a need for more enhancement. Talking about the hostel even after a hefty amount they clean our room only once in 15 days. Wi-Fi is very poor. Medical facilities are the worst in the name of health center, all they have is bitadine and cotton.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Petroleum Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Beyond rankings, a realistic look at the Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology RGIPT.

content.Placements: The average placement rate for Petroleum Engineering students over the last 4 years is around 60 to 70%. The highest package is around 25 LPA cost to the company from ONGC, the lowest is around 6 LPA, and the average package is around 10 LPA. The top recruiting companies are ONGC, OIL, Sunpetro Chemical, Shell CPCL, Torrent Gas, IOAGPL, etc. Over the past 3 years, around 30% of students have get private internships with companies like Selan Exploration, Telesto Energy, ExxonMobil, and Essar, which were later converted into PPOs. The rest of students have interned at PSUs like ONGC and OIL. Roles offered are Graduate Engineering Trainee, Assistant Executive Engineer Drilling, Production, Associate Engineer Process Data, etc.

Campus wide internet connectivity provides students access to online library resources such as Dew, Time, Digit, Down to Earth, PC Quest, Education World, Parents World, Sociological Bulletin, Economic and Political Weekly, and The Economist.
Operational hours for the library are from 10:00 AM to 12:00 midnight, accommodating a broad range of study and research needs.

reviews.review_heading: Feels a little high than IITs though it is a central government college.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are pretty good. They have provided spacious rooms, clean and the finest. There are proper facilities of Wi-Fi and library, IIT-type classrooms. Labs are fully equipped with machines and instruments. One best thing is the good mess food quality. It feels like homemade food. There are also sports facilities of all kinds, including indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Not very satisfied, but I did not have any other option, so it's okay to study here.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is new, and the facilities are great at the Amethi campus. Food is decent, and labs are fully equipped, but the library is small for the crowd. Now, talking about the Bangalore Campus, the hostel is very new, but there are no good facilities at all. Wi-Fi is horrible here compared to the Amethi campus. Connectivity is okay at Amethi, but at Bangalore, it's very far from the city.

reviews.review_heading: College is great, but it has a small campus, and the location is quite far from the city.
reviews.review_text: There are outdoor and indoor games in the college with well and good infrastructure. The campus is clean and tidy. It also has a beautiful garden and a statue. There are two academic blocks, and every kind of lab is available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Not at all satisfied, poor.
reviews.review_text: Construction is still ongoing on and only two academic blocks are there. Wi-Fi doesn't work properly even after complaining a lot they don't fix it. Library is good and classrooms are good too but still, there's a need for more enhancement. Talking about the hostel even after a hefty amount they clean our room only once in 15 days. Wi-Fi is very poor. Medical facilities are the worst in the name of health center, all they have is bitadine and cotton.

reviews.review_heading: Beyond rankings, a realistic look at the Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology RGIPT.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and hostel facilities are good at RGIPT. Wi-Fi connections are average, but laboratories and classrooms are best for the petroleum domain. The space in hostel rooms is good, and the mess food is above average. The canteen is open until 3 AM. Sports and medical facilities are less than average and not that good.

reviews.review_heading: College placements are good for the Chemical and Petroleum branches.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is available everywhere, including classrooms, the library, and hostel rooms. Each classroom has an AC and a projector for teaching. Each hostel room accommodates two students and has two fans. Each floor has washing machines. The mess food is good. The night canteen starts at 10 p.m. and is affordable. There is a health center on our college campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities .
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi in classrooms and hostels, library (9 AM - 12 AM), and state-of-the-art labs (drilling technology, production engineering, reservoir engineering, geology, well testing, and logging lab).
Sports facilities: volleyball, basketball, football, lawn tennis, badminton, table tennis, carrom, snooker, cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Talented students excel through personal efforts.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms, and overall infrastructure are decent. Hostels are functional and above average. Mess food is edible, it's repetitive, and sometimes below expectations. The campus is small but sufficient. It lacks recreational space, making student life less dynamic.

reviews.review_heading: The Farzi and average IIT.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi quality is good, which is available 24 hours, and library access is for 15 hours. Classroom infrastructure is basic. The canteen is not so good, but the mess food is good. Sports facilities are also good, and the college gives free-of-cost medical treatment. Labs are basic, not so advanced. Wi-Fi speed is not so fast.

reviews.review_heading: This college is not for teach branches.
reviews.review_text: Free Wi-Fi is available. There are 2 or 3 washing machines on each floor. A floor consists of 30-35 rooms. The rooms are quite spacious and in good condition. Food quality is so-so and the canteen is also there. A cafe is also inside the campus. For small injuries, there is a medical center, and of course, it is free of cost. Sports facilities need to be improved.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good college, RGIPT - an evolving institute comparable to IITs.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available are good rooms, good LAN and Wi-Fi connection, and good classrooms with projectors. Two-seater rooms are provided with one table, one chair, one cot, and one almirah to every student. There is a health centre, cafeteria, and canteen inside the college. Mess food is good, with a gala dinner held once in a month.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi is available across the college.
Labs are well maintained with working equipment, and classroom infrastructure is very nicely designed. 
The library is full of books, and from time to time new books are added.
Hostel consists of A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H blocks, and mess food is good, and the night canteen is available for students who study late at night. 
Medical facilities are very good. The campus itself has a health center and ambulance facilities for emergency cases. Sports and game...

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied with placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel's Wi-Fi speed is okay, but sometimes the Wi-Fi doesn't work at all. The college infrastructure is better than many NITs. The library is okay but small for the number of students in the college. There is a health centre on campus, but no proper football or cricket ground.

reviews.review_heading: My college is the best in infrastructure. Many sports festivals are held in my college.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is very good. Their Wi-Fi and labs are very well. Classrooms are very systematic and have a very good environment. The faculty is the best, and sports are very good with many opportunities. The canteen is good because their food is very tasty.

reviews.review_heading: College is best, and its infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: My college infrastructure is very good. Their Wi-Fi and labs are very well. The classrooms are very systematic and have a very good environment. The faculty is the best, and sports are very good and very opportunity in sports and canteen is good because their food is very tasty.

content.Placements: Our current placement is better than previous years, the highest package for on campus is somewhat around 8.5–12.5 LPA in Computer Science and other branches also. But this year we got one of our seniors secured job in Google with a CTC around 55 LPA. Companies include Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, and other local startups.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel is good. In 1st and 2nd year we have 3 people in one room, but if you are in top 10 percent of batch, then in 3rd year you get a single seater room; otherwise, every student gets a single room in 4th year. Hostel fee is 10,000 per semester which is affordable. Mess is separate but inside hostel. It costs around 3,000 per month. Food is okay, sometimes good, sometimes average. individual_reviews.title: We go on field visits to different companies and also do field projects.
